2:  * BK7258 raw Mailbox SMP IPI.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <errno.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <strings.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/atomic.h>
14: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
15: 
16: #include "arm_internal.h"
17: #include "sched/sched.h"
18: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
19: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
20: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
21: 
22: #define BK7258_IPI_SCHED        (1u << 0)
23: #define BK7258_IPI_CALL         (1u << 1)
24: #define BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT  1024
25: 
26: #define BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_NOTIFY (BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK + 1u)
27: #define BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_PING   (BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK + 2u)
28: #define BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_ACK    (BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK + 3u)
29: 
30: #define BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_NOTIFY (1u << 0)
31: #define BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_ACK    (1u << 1)
32: 
33: #define BK7258_IPI_TRACE_ENTRY  0xb1000000u
34: #define BK7258_IPI_TRACE_CLAIM  0xb2000000u
35: #define BK7258_IPI_TRACE_SENT   0xb3000000u
36: #define BK7258_IPI_TRACE_FAIL   0xb4000000u
37: 
38: static atomic_t g_ipi_pending[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
39: static atomic_t g_ipi_kicked[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
40: static atomic_t g_boot_ping_received;
41: static uint32_t g_boot_seen;
42: 
43: static void bk7258_smp_trace(uint32_t value)
44: {
45:   if (bk7258_boottrace_primary_stage() == BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_FIRST_IRQ)
46:     {
47:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(4, value);
48:     }
49: }
50: 
51: static int bk7258_smp_boot_send(int cpu, uint32_t command)
52: {
53:   uint32_t data[2] = {command, 0};
54:   int retry;
55: 
56:   UP_DMB();
57:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
58:     {
59:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
60: 
61:       if (ret == OK)
62:         {
63:           return OK;
64:         }
65: 
66:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
67:         {
68:           return ret;
69:         }
70: 
71:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
72:     }
73: 
74:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
75: }
76: 
77: static int bk7258_smp_kick(int cpu, uint32_t pending)
78: {
79:   uint32_t data[2] = {BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK, 0};
80:   int expected = 0;
81:   int retry;
82: 
83:   if ((unsigned int)cpu >= CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS || cpu == this_cpu())
84:     {
85:       return -EINVAL;
86:     }
87: 
88:   bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_ENTRY | (pending & 0xffu));
89:   atomic_or_release(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], pending);
90:   if (!atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], &expected, 1))
91:     {
92:       bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_CLAIM | 0x100u);
93:       return OK;
94:     }
95: 
96:   bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_CLAIM | (cpu & 0xffu));
97:   UP_DMB();
98:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
99:     {
100:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
101: 
102:       if (ret == OK)
103:         {
104:           bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_SENT | (retry & 0xffffu));
105:           return OK;
106:         }
107: 
108:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
109:         {
110:           atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
111:           bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_FAIL |
112:                            ((uint32_t)(-ret) & 0xffffu));
113:           return ret;
114:         }
115: 
116:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
117:     }
118: 
119:   atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
120:   bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_FAIL | 0xffffu);
121:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
122: }
123: 
124: void bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(int irq, void *context, uint32_t command)
125: {
126:   int cpu = this_cpu();
127: 
128:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_NOTIFY)
129:     {
130:       if (cpu == 0)
131:         {
132:           g_boot_seen |= BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_NOTIFY;
133:         }
134: 
135:       return;
136:     }
137: 
138:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_PING)
139:     {
140:       if (cpu == 1)
141:         {
142:           atomic_set_release(&g_boot_ping_received, 1);
143:           if (bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
144:               BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK)
145:             {
146:               bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK);
147:             }
148:         }
149: 
150:       return;
151:     }
152: 
153:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_ACK)
154:     {
155:       if (cpu == 0)
156:         {
157:           g_boot_seen |= BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_ACK;
158:         }
159: 
160:       return;
161:     }
162: 
163:   if (command != BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
164:     {
165:       return;
166:     }
167: 
168:   for (;;)
169:     {
170:       uint32_t pending = atomic_xchg_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
171: 
172:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_CALL) != 0)
173:         {
174:           nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, NULL);
175:         }
176: 
177:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_SCHED) != 0)
178:         {
179:           nxsched_process_delivered(cpu);
180:         }
181: 
182:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
183:       UP_DMB();
184:       if (atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu]) == 0)
185:         {
186:           break;
187:         }
188: 
189:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 1);
190:     }
191: }
192: 
193: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu)
194: {
195:   int ret = bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_SCHED);
196: 
197:   if (ret < 0)
198:     {
199:       return ret;
200:     }
201: 
202:   return ret;
203: }
204: 
205: void bk7258_smp_retry_pending(void)
206: {
207:   if (this_cpu() == 0 && atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[1]) != 0 &&
208:       atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[1]) == 0)
209:     {
210:       (void)bk7258_smp_kick(1, 0);
211:     }
212: }
213: 
214: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset)
215: {
216:   int cpu;
217: 
218:   for (; cpuset != 0; cpuset &= ~(1u << cpu))
219:     {
220:       cpu = ffs((int)cpuset) - 1;
221:       if (cpu != this_cpu() && bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_CALL) < 0)
222:         {
223:           /* The pending call bit remains set for a later coalesced kick. */
224:         }
225:     }
226: }
227: 
228: void bk7258_smp_prepare_boot(void)
229: {
230:   int cpu;
231: 
232:   for (cpu = 0; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
233:     {
234:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
235:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
236:     }
237: 
238:   g_boot_seen = 0;
239:   atomic_set(&g_boot_ping_received, 0);
240:   UP_DMB();
241: }
242: 
243: void bk7258_smp_boot_notify(void)
244: {
245:   if (bk7258_smp_boot_send(0, BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_NOTIFY) < 0)
246:     {
247:       PANIC();
248:     }
249: }
250: 
251: void bk7258_smp_boot_ack(void)
252: {
253:   if (bk7258_smp_boot_send(0, BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_ACK) < 0)
254:     {
255:       PANIC();
256:     }
257: }
258: 
259: bool bk7258_smp_boot_notified(void)
260: {
261:   return (g_boot_seen & BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_NOTIFY) != 0;
262: }
263: 
264: bool bk7258_smp_boot_ping_received(void)
265: {
266:   return atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_ping_received) != 0;
267: }
268: 
269: bool bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete(void)
270: {
271:   return g_boot_seen == (BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_NOTIFY |
272:                          BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_ACK);
273: }
274: 
275: int bk7258_smp_boot_ping(int cpu)
276: {
277:   return bk7258_smp_boot_send(cpu, BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_PING);
278: }

44: static void bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset(void)
45: {
46:   putreg32(getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL) & ~BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE,
47:            BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);
48:   UP_DSB();

50: 
51: static void bk7258_cpu2_release_reset(void)
52: {
53:   putreg32(getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL) | BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE,
54:            BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);

56:   __asm__ volatile("sev" ::: "memory");

59: static void __attribute__((used, noreturn)) bk7258_secondary_idle(void)
60: {
61:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_IDLE);
62:   arm_initialize_stack();
63:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_STACK);
64:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ONLINE);
65:   bk7258_smp_boot_notify();
66:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_NOTIFY);
67:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_IRQ_ON);
68:   up_irq_enable();
69:   sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
70:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_SCHED);
71: 
72:   while (!bk7258_smp_boot_ping_received())
73:     {
74:       __asm__ volatile("nop");

83: static void __attribute__((naked, noreturn))
84: bk7258_secondary_enter(uintptr_t idle_top __attribute__((unused)),
85:                        uintptr_t idle_base __attribute__((unused)))
86: {
87:   __asm__ volatile
88:     (
89:       "msr psp, r0\n"
90: #ifdef CONFIG_ARMV8M_STACKCHECK_HARDWARE
91:       "msr psplim, r1\n"
92: #endif
93:       "mrs r1, control\n"
94:       "orr r1, r1, #2\n"
95:       "msr control, r1\n"
96:       "isb sy\n"
97:       "b bk7258_secondary_idle\n"
98:     );

102:                            target("general-regs-only")))
103: bk7258_secondary_boot(void)

111:   bk7258_irqinitialize_secondary();
112:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_IRQ);
113:   if (bk7258_mbox_secondary_init() < 0)
114:     {
115:       PANIC();
116:     }
117: 
118:   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX);
119: 
120:   tcb = current_task(1);
121:   idle_top = ((uintptr_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr + tcb->adj_stack_size) & ~7u;
122:   bk7258_secondary_enter(idle_top, (uintptr_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr);

130:       "cpsid i\n"
131:       "movs r0, #1\n"
132:       "ldr r1, =0x20000000\n"
133:       "str r0, [r1]\n"
134:       "ldr r0, =__secondary_boot_stack_base\n"
135:       "msr msplim, r0\n"
136:       "b bk7258_secondary_boot\n"
137:     );

140: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
141: {
142:   irqstate_t flags;
143:   uint32_t started;
144:   uint32_t polls = 0;
145:   uint32_t control;
146:   uint32_t status;
147:   bool ping_sent = false;
148: 
149:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_ENTER);
150: 
151:   if (cpu != 1 || this_cpu() != 0)
152:     {
153:       return -EINVAL;
154:     }
155: 
156:   status = getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS);
157:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, status);
158:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, bk7258_mbox_smp_ready());
159:   if ((status & BK7258_CPU_STATUS_CPU2_POWER_DOWN) != 0 ||
160:       !bk7258_mbox_smp_ready())
161:     {
162:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "CPU2 prerequisite failed: status=%08lx mbox=%u\n",
163:              (unsigned long)status, bk7258_mbox_smp_ready());
164:       PANIC();
165:     }
166: 
167:   bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset();
168:   control = getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);
169:   status = getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS);
170:   if ((control & BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE) != 0 ||
171:       (status & BK7258_CPU_STATUS_CPU2_RESET) != 0)
172:     {
173:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "CPU2 reset hold failed: ctrl=%08lx status=%08lx\n",
174:              (unsigned long)control, (unsigned long)status);
175:       PANIC();
176:     }
177: 
178:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_HELD);
179:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, control);
180:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, status);
181: 
182:   bk7258_smp_prepare_boot();
183:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN0);
184:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1);
185:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL, BK7258_CPU2_OFFSET_MASK,
186:               BK7258_CPU2_RXEVT_SEL |
187:               (((uintptr_t)__secondary_vectors_start >> 8) <<
188:                BK7258_CPU2_OFFSET_SHIFT));
189:   UP_DMB();
190:   UP_DSB();
191: 
192:   putreg32(getreg32(NVIC_DEMCR) | NVIC_DEMCR_TRCENA, NVIC_DEMCR);
193:   putreg32(0, DWT_CYCCNT);
194:   putreg32(getreg32(DWT_CTRL) | DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_MASK, DWT_CTRL);
195:   started = getreg32(DWT_CYCCNT);
196:   flags = up_irq_save();
197:   bk7258_cpu2_release_reset();
198:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_RELEASED);
199:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL));
200:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS));
201: 
202:   while (!bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete())
203:     {
204:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
205:       if (bk7258_smp_boot_notified() && !ping_sent)
206:         {
207:           if (bk7258_smp_boot_ping(1) < 0)
208:             {
209:               break;
210:             }
211: 
212:           ping_sent = true;
213:           bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_ONLINE);
214:         }
215: 
216:       if (getreg32(DWT_CYCCNT) - started >= BK7258_CPU2_ONLINE_CYCLES ||
217:           ++polls >= BK7258_CPU2_POLL_LIMIT)
218:         {
219:           break;
220:         }
221:     }
222: 
223:   if (!bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete())
224:     {
225:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL));
226:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS));
227:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, getreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS));
228:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, getreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS));
229:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(4, ping_sent);
230:       bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset();
231:       up_irq_restore(flags);
232:       syslog(LOG_ERR,
233:              "CPU2 online timeout: ctrl=%08lx status=%08lx fifo=%08lx/%08lx ping=%u\n",
234:              (unsigned long)getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL),
235:              (unsigned long)getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS),
236:              (unsigned long)getreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS),
237:              (unsigned long)getreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS), ping_sent);
238:       PANIC();
239:     }
240: 
241:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_IPI_DONE);
242:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, UINT32_MAX);
243:   putreg32(1u << (BK7258_EXTIRQ_MAILBOX & 31),
244:            NVIC_IRQ_CLRPEND(BK7258_EXTIRQ_MAILBOX));
245:   UP_DSB();
246:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_IRQ_RESTORE);
247:   up_irq_restore(flags);
248:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_IRQ_RETURN);
249:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_CPU2_START_DONE);
250:   return OK;
251: }

1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
31: 
32: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
33: PORTNUM=0
34: 
35: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
36: #
37: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
38: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
39: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
40: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
41: # nothing typed into it worked.
42: BAUD=115200
43: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
44: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
45: LOG=/tmp/autoflash.log
46: REBOOT_TRIES=8
47: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
48: 
49: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
50: #
51: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
52: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
53: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
54: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
55: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
56: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
57: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
58: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
59: TEST_ONLY=0
60: 
61: usage() {
62:   cat <<'EOF'
63: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
64: 
65:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
66:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
67:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
68:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
69:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
70:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
71:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
72:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
73:   -h           显示本帮助
74: 
75: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
76:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
77: EOF
78: }
79: 
80: while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
81:   case "$opt" in
82:     i) IMAGE="$OPTARG" ;;
83:     p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
84:     n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
85:     b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
86:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
87:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
88:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
89:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
90:     h) usage; exit 0 ;;
91:     *) usage; exit 2 ;;
92:   esac
93: done
94: 
95: die() { echo "错误: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
96: 
97: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. 前置检查
98: 
99: [ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
100: [ -f "$IMAGE" ]  || die "找不到镜像: $IMAGE"

# 6. Exact shared AP–CP root cause

## CP hard IRQ does not run the logical callback

The CP MBOX0 hard IRQ drains hardware and invokes the adapter:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:34-75`

But `mbox0_rx_isr()` only validates and copies the descriptor into `rx_desc[]`; it does not invoke the registered logical mailbox callback:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:258-340`

The registered callback is invoked only by `bk_mailbox_poll()`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:211-255`

`mb_chnl_poll()` is also responsible for:

- Draining staged descriptors.
- Retrying transport ACKs.
- Detecting the 200 ms physical BUSY timeout.
- Failing pending logical channels.
- Starting RESET recovery.

References:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:1157-1223`

## Runtime poll owner is the console task

Outside the CPU1 boot wait, the only runtime caller is mailbox UART polling:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:1000-1035`

That is called from `ap_bridge_task()`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:210-232`

The console task can then spend substantial time forwarding lines and retrying a full CP shell log queue:

- Per-line retry: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:134-155`
- Drain all available AP console input before returning to poll: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:277-311`

This makes transport progress depend on the service carried by the transport.

### Shared consequence

When `ap_console` is delayed:

1. AP sends PWC, heartbeat, or UART data.
2. CP IRQ stages the descriptor but does not run the logical callback.
3. CP therefore does not generate the transport ACK.
4. AP keeps `g_active.busy`.
5. At 200 ms, AP times out and enters abort/recovery:
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:988-1020`

7. Heartbeat submissions fail or remain pending:
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_ipc_heartbeat.c:151-220`
8. CP heartbeat supervision eventually reaches its multi-second timeout:
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c:33-38`
   - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c:291-300`

This is the exact common execution-context root cause connecting PWC, heartbeat and console failures.

# 7. Stable ACK-slot failure mode

CP sends pointer-based stable mailbox slots. The current source has eight ACK slots:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:10-13`
- Allocation: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:135-190`

The pre-fix behavior retained transport-ACK slots without a dependable final release fence, eventually causing `bk_mailbox_send()` to return `BK_ERR_BUSY`. That prevents the logical ACK queue from progressing and affects every logical service sharing CPU0↔CPU1.

The current source contains candidate reclamation at:

- FIFO-empty quarantine reclamation: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:57-108`
- Later ordinary AP command as a copy fence: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:319-333`
- CP command-completion fence: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:428-455`

However, the FIFO-empty reclamation and ACK retries run only when polling occurs. If `ap_console` is stalled, slot reclamation is stalled too. Also, a 20 ms FIFO-empty quarantine is a timing heuristic, not a formal peer-copy ownership acknowledgement.

# 8. Is the motor worker blocked?

## Before it becomes ready

The motor worker can be waiting for the PWC logical transaction:

- It is **not** waiting on `g_motor_ready_sem`.
- It is **not** holding or waiting on `g_pwc_tx_lock`; the motor bypasses `pwc_send_wait()`.
- It is polling `g_channels[PWC].queued` inside `bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc()`.
- The PWC request may be queued behind the AP transport’s single `g_active` slot.

The bring-up thread, separately, waits on `g_motor_ready_sem`.

## After the ready message

The steady-state worker performs only:

1. GPIO reads.
2. `nxsig_usleep(5 ms)`.
3. A syslog enqueue protected by the shared recursive driver spinlock.
4. A PWM ioctl protected by the PWM upper-half mutex.
5. Short lower-half critical sections.

It does not wait on a mailbox semaphore or transport completion for each press/release.

Therefore:

- **Normal post-ready latency:** approximately 25–30 ms.
- **Not a normal mutex/semaphore delay:** the PWM mutex protects only short calls.
- **Possible pathological stall:** waiting/spinning on the shared AP driver lock or being starved by higher-priority mailbox/recovery workers and IRQ activity.
- **Console observation can lag without physical action lagging**, because syslog is queued asynchronously.

---

# 9. How a physical press/release can appear seconds late

There are three distinct cases.

## A. Press occurs before motor sampling starts

This is the clearest remaining AP scheduling bug.

        wifi_handle_command_list(...);

There is no bounded batch count and no explicit yield inside the inner loop.

The mailbox TX worker is only priority 105 after activation, and the UART worker is 106:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:37-38`

- transport transactions to remain logically queued or active;
- UART TX progress to stall;
- heartbeat or PWC asynchronous messages to be delayed;
- apparent mailbox ACK timeouts even though physical RX polling is occurring.

`bk7258_mbox_kick_rx()` inside the Wi-Fi loop helps consume RX descriptors, but it does not guarantee that the lower-priority TX worker will run.

Use either of these minimal fixes:

1. Bound the Wi-Fi work per iteration, for example process a fixed number of nodes and then yield with `nxsig_usleep(0)` or equivalent; or

The safer change is a bounded batch plus yield. Lowering the Wi-Fi priority alone may increase latency but is simpler.

The same review should be applied to any future high-priority worker that drains a queue in an unbounded loop.

  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:945-968`
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1076-1098`

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/spinlock.h:666-704`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/spinlock.h:1035-1063`

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:314-331`

The README confirms the former PWC recursive-lock problem:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md:589-595`

### Assessment

There is no current unconditional recursive-lock deadlock in this path. The lock is recursive by design.

The concrete remaining risk is that callbacks execute arbitrary code while:

- interrupts are disabled;
- the global driver spinlock is held;
- scheduling is suppressed.

That makes callback execution time part of the mailbox critical section. A future callback that waits on a semaphore, takes a mutex, or invokes a non-recursive lock can deadlock the mailbox IRQ path.

### Minimal change

Do not perform blocking operations from mailbox callbacks. For a stronger fix:

- copy completion state under `g_bk7258_driver_lock`;
- release the lock;
- invoke the callback afterward.

That is more invasive, so the minimal immediate change is to document/enforce that all mailbox callbacks are nonblocking and only enqueue work.

### Link wait

Bring-up starts workers and the physical mailbox:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhineng/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c:56-74`

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhineng/external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md:582-595`

1. **Keep the current CP fix**
   - Retain `mb_chnl_poll()` plus `rtos_delay_milliseconds(1)` in the CPU1 boot loop.
   - Do not restore the original busy AON-RTC-only loop.

2. **Activate AP transport workers earlier**
   - Move `bk7258_mailbox_workers_activate()` and `bk7258_mb_uart_worker_activate()` to immediately after worker creation, or at least before Wi-Fi and other asynchronous services start.

3. **Bound the AP Wi-Fi worker**
   - Add a per-pass work limit and yield in the inner queue-draining loop at:
     - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1419-1461`
   - Alternatively lower its priority below mailbox TX/UART.

4. **Serialize all PWC-channel users**
   - Route the motor worker through the same PWC send/wait mutex used by:
     - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:164-190`
   - The direct motor path at:
     - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_motor.c:78-87`
     should not remain unsynchronized.

5. **Decouple CP mailbox polling from console formatting**
   - Prefer a dedicated bounded mailbox poll task.

6. **Preserve current CPU0 sequencing**
   - Keep CPU2 scheduler readiness polling before affinity changes and worker creation.

     - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:1090-1110`

## Bottom line

- **Historical CP starvation:** real and confirmed; current direct polling plus 1 ms delay fixes it.
- **Current startup ACK consumption:** explicit RX draining means startup does not inherently wait with ACKs unable to be consumed.
- **Current AP scheduling risk:** real; the priority-110 Wi-Fi/PWC consumers can starve priority-105/106 transport workers on CPU0, especially Wi-Fi’s unbounded queue drain.
- **Current locking bug:** the motor PWC path bypasses the PWC mutex and can collide on the single logical PWC channel.

74: 		}

624: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

626: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
627: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
628: 
629: 		return;
630: 	}
631: 
632: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
633: 	{
634: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
635: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
636: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
637: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
638: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
639: 
640: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
641: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
642: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
643: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
644: 	}
645: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
646: 	{
647: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
648: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
649: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
650: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
651: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
652: 
653: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
654: 
655: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
656: 	}
657: 	else
658: 	{
659: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
660: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
661: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
662: 	}
663: 
664: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
665: 	{
666: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
667: 		return;
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
671: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
672: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
673: 
674: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))

677: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
678: 		return;
679: 	}
680: 	return;

211: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
212: {
213: 	u8 dst;
214: 
215: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
216: 	for (dst = 0; dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM; dst++)
217: 	{
218: 		if (dst != MAILBOX_CPU0)
219: 			mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
220: 	}

222: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
223: 
224: 	while (1)
225: 	{
226: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t desc;
227: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t *selected;
228: 
229: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
230: 		if (!rx_count)
231: 		{
232: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
233: 			break;
234: 		}
235: 		selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(true);
236: 		if (!selected)
237: 			selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(false);
238: 		if (!selected ||
239: 			(((selected->data.param0 >> 12) & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 &&
240: 			 upper_rx_ready && !upper_rx_ready()))
241: 		{
242: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
243: 			break;
244: 		}
245: 		desc = *selected;
246: 		selected->used = 0;
247: 		rx_count--;
248: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
249: 		if (mailbox_callback[desc.source])
250: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);
251: 
252: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
253: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
254: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;
266: 
267: 	if (!msg)
268: 		return;
269: 
270: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
271: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
272: 	{
273: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if (ctrl == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
325: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
326: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
327: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
328: 		{
329: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
330: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
331: 		}
332: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
333: 	}
334: 	desc->source = source;
335: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
336: 	desc->used = 1;
337: 	rx_count++;
338: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
339: 
340: }

text:
## Objective
- 修复 BK7258 OpenVela SMP 的 AP-CP mailbox 根本故障，使双 AP 核、480 MHz、启动握手、heartbeat、`ap_console open` 和按键震动稳定运行。
- 保留 motor 直连 PWC 路径作为重要 debug 探针，不修改现有 GPIO 配置，也不将 motor PWC 请求纳入 `g_pwc_tx_lock`。

## Important Details
- CPU 映射：物理 CPU0=Armino CP；物理 CPU1=OpenVela logical CPU0；物理 CPU2=OpenVela logical CPU1。
- logical CPU0 是唯一 SysTick owner；logical CPU1 私有 SysTick 关闭。
- CPU2 `BOOT_ACK` 在线程模式、scheduler-ready 后发送；每颗 AP 核均执行 `arm_fpuconfig()`。
- 用户明确要求 motor PWC 保持独立，用于暴露单槽阻塞、ACK 延迟和 PWC 响应丢失；不得通过 PWC 串行锁掩盖问题。
- 用户确认 GPIO 配置正确；不得按 GPIO52/GPIO13 猜测修改 GPIO。
- 已源码证实物理 mailbox descriptor 由 `TDATA0/TDATA1/TID` 三次 MMIO 写组成，runtime IPI 与 transport 原先缺少共同本地 IRQ 保护。
- CP mailbox 硬 IRQ 主要搬运 descriptor；逻辑 ACK、重试、超时恢复和 slot 回收依赖 `mb_chnl_poll()`，运行态原先由 `ap_console`/boot 路径间接驱动。
- 新增 CP 常驻 `mbox_poll` task 后若启动期立即运行，会造成 `CPU1 boot timeout stage=4`；当前源码改为收到 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5` 后才通过 `mb_chnl_start_service()`启用。
- 将 CP HAL 的 `NOT_EMPTY=bit2` 直接套用于 AP `bk7258_mbox_rx_status()` 是错误假设：实板回归为 `primary=12 secondary=0`、`slot_busy` 持续增长；该源码改动已撤回，但撤回版尚未烧录。
- 稳定启动版本曾显示 `primary=36 secondary=16` 和 `NuttShell (NSH)`，但 AP 未继续输出 `mailbox UART0 link ready`，CP 最终仍报 `CPU1 boot timeout stage=4`。
- `ap_console open` 仍可复现 `AP link down; returned to CP CLI`，约 8 秒后 `IPC[1]heartbeat timeout` 和 `mb_ipc_task:299` assert。
- motor 正常运行时按键 debounce 理论约 30 ms；实测按下/松开延迟数秒更符合共享 mailbox 事务或调度进度阻塞。
- 串口设备为 `/dev/ttyUSB1`；必须先启动串口采集，再发送 `reboot` 获取完整日志。
- 烧录使用 `bash ./autoflash.sh -p /dev/ttyUSB1 -n 1 -b 1500000`。
- 工作树有大量用户/历史改动，不得回退无关内容。

## Work State
### Completed
- 修复 CPU2 启动 ACK 时序、每核 FPU 初始化、CPU0-only SysTick 和 CPU0-only bring-up。
- 增加独立 `g_secondary_ready` atomic release/acquire flag；`wait_secondary_scheduler()` 不再使用 boot trace stage 作为正确性门禁。
- 在 `bk7258_mbox_send()` 内对 status 检查及 `TDATA0/TDATA1/TID` 整段增加本地 IRQ 屏蔽，防止 IPI 与 transport descriptor 撕裂。
- 恢复 CPU0 对 recovery RESET 和 UART STATE 的完整同步非阻
现在继续完成自动化修复任务

1: # BK7258 最终固件构建步骤
2: 
3: 本文记录当前工作区已经验证通过的构建流程。最终固件由以下三部分组成：
4: 
5: ```text
6: OpenVela CPU1/AP nuttx.bin
7: Armino CPU0/CP app.bin
8: Beken bootloader.bin
9:         |
10:         v
11: Beken packager
12:         |
13:         v

18: `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` 完成。不要手工覆盖打包目录中的 `app1.bin`，
19: 应使用已经接入的 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口。
20: 
21: ## 1. 前置条件

24: 
25: ```text
26: /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
27: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
28: ```

161: 
162: ## 6. 构建后校验
163: 
164: 首先确认最终文件存在：
165: 
166: ```bash
167: ls -lh \
168:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin \
169:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl

172: 然后确认 packager 使用了本次构建的 OpenVela AP：

174: ```bash
175: sha256sum \
176:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
177:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
178:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
179: 
180: cmp -s \
181:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
182:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
183: ```
184: 
185: 三个 SHA256 必须一致，`cmp` 必须返回 0。否则生成的 `all-app.bin` 可能仍包含旧 AP。
186: 
187: 检查分区和构建摘要：
188: 
189: ```bash

191: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
192: ```

194: `bk_package.json` 应包含：
195: 
196: ```text
197: bootloader.bin -> bootloader
198: app.bin        -> CPU0/CP app
199: app1.bin       -> CPU1/AP app
200: ```
201: 
202: 注意：`build_summary.txt` 中的 AP memory info 来自构建过程中的 Armino AP
203: 占位镜像 map，不用于证明外部 OpenVela AP 已经打包。外部 AP 是否生效必须以
204: `nuttx.bin`、`build/openvela-ap.bin` 和 `package/tmp/app1.bin` 的哈希及
205: 逐字节比较为准。
206: 
207: ## 7. 常见问题
208: 
209: - OpenVela CMake 构建产物是 `nuttx.bin` 和 `System.map`，不是
210:   `vela_nuttx.bin` 或 `nuttx.map`。
211: - 当前 OpenVela 工作树是 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest`，不是旧的
212:   `openvela_bk7258_dev`。

214:   `/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin`，不能填写宿主机绝对路径。
215: - 修改配置后若增量构建没有加载新配置，先执行 CMake `distclean`。
216: - 最终烧录文件名是 `all-app.bin`，不是 `all_app.bin`。

1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
31: 
32: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
33: PORTNUM=0
34: 
35: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
36: #
37: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
38: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
39: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
40: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
41: # nothing typed into it worked.
42: BAUD=115200
43: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
44: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
45: LOG=/tmp/autoflash.log
46: REBOOT_TRIES=8
47: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
48: 
49: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
50: #
51: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
52: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
53: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
54: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
55: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
56: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
57: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
58: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
59: TEST_ONLY=0
60: 
61: usage() {
62:   cat <<'EOF'
63: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
64: 
65:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
66:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
67:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
68:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
69:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
70:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
71:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
72:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
73:   -h           显示本帮助
74: 
75: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
76:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
77: EOF
78: }
79: 
80: while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
81:   case "$opt" in
82:     i) IMAGE="$OPTARG" ;;
83:     p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
84:     n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
85:     b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
86:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
87:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
88:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
89:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
90:     h) usage; exit 0 ;;
91:     *) usage; exit 2 ;;
92:   esac
93: done
94: 
95: die() { echo "错误: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
96: 
97: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. 前置检查
98: 
99: [ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
100: [ -f "$IMAGE" ]  || die "找不到镜像: $IMAGE"
101: [ -c "$PORT" ]   || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
102: 
103: SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$IMAGE")
104: SHA=$(sha256sum "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
105: 
106: # 10 bits on the wire per byte (8N1 plus start and stop).
107: XFER_SECS=$(( SIZE * 10 / BAUD ))
108: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))
109: 
110: echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
111: echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
112: echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
113: echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
114: echo "  串口   : $PORT"
115: echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
116: echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud（烧完会恢复成这个）"
117: 
118: if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
119:   if [ "$SIZE" -ne "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
120:     die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE。打包可能不完整，用 -s 可跳过此检查"
121:   fi
122:   echo "  字节数校验通过"
123: fi
124: 
125: # ---------------------------------------------------------- 2. 释放串口占用
126: 
127: echo
128: echo "=== 释放串口 ==="
129: HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
130: if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
131:   echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"
132: 
133:   # Detached screen sessions are the usual culprit: Ctrl-A D leaves them
134:   # running and holding the tty.
135:   while read -r sid; do
136:     [ -n "$sid" ] || continue
137:     echo "  关闭 screen 会话 $sid"
138:     screen -X -S "$sid" quit >/dev/null 2>&1
139:   done < <(screen -ls 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '^\s+[0-9]+\.[^ \t]+' | tr -d ' \t')
140: 
141:   pkill -f "cat $PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
142: 
143:   sleep 0.5
144:   HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
145:   if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
146:     die "串口仍被占用: $HOLDERS。手动处理后重试（参考 docs/端口冲突解决办法.md）"
147:   fi
148: fi
149: echo "  串口空闲"
150: 
151: # Console baud, not flash baud: the only thing written through this port
152: # before bk_loader takes over is the "reboot" command, and the firmware's
153: # console is listening at CONSOLE_BAUD.
154: stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
155:   || die "stty 配置失败"
156: 
157: # --------------------------------------------------- 3. 启动 bk_loader 并软复位
158: 
159: echo
160: : > "$LOG"
161: PIDFILE=$(mktemp)
162: 
163: # The in-loop reset works at any -b, and here is why it is safe to rely on:
164: # bk_loader opens the tty at 115200 no matter what -b says, handshakes there,
165: # and only switches to the requested rate once it owns the bus.  Measured from
166: # a real 1500000 run:
167: #
168: #   cmdline: ... bk_loader download -p 0 -b 1500000 ...
169: #   Current port : /dev/ttyUSB0 + BaudRate : 115200 connect success
170: #   Getting Bus... / Gotten Bus... / All Finished Successfully
171: #
172: # So while we are writing "reboot" the line is still at 115200 and the
173: # firmware console decodes it fine.  An earlier version of this script
174: # disabled the retry loop for BAUD != CONSOLE_BAUD on the theory that the port
175: # had already been switched up -- that was reasoning without measurement, and
176: # it broke a mechanism that worked.
177: 
178: if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
179:   echo "=== 只测握手，不写 flash ==="
180:   set -- read -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -f "/tmp/autoflash_probe.bin@0-1000"
181: else
182:   echo "=== 开始烧录（无需按 RST）==="
183:   set -- download -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -s 0 -i "$IMAGE"
184: fi
185: 
186: # Output goes to the terminal *and* the log.
187: #
188: # bk_loader draws its erase/write progress with cli_printf_progress_bar,
189: # which emits "Erasing Flash ... 42%\r" -- carriage return, no newline.  Two
190: # things are needed to see that live: tee, so the bytes reach the terminal at
191: # all, and stdbuf -o0, because with a pipe on stdout glibc would otherwise
192: # block-buffer 4 KB at a time and the bar would arrive in lurches.
193: #
194: # The PID is stashed in a file because with a pipeline $! would be tee's.
195: (
196:   stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout "$OVERALL_TIMEOUT" "$LOADER" "$@" &
197:   echo $! > "$PIDFILE"
198:   wait $!
199: ) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG" &
200: PIPELINE_PID=$!
201: 
202: LOADER_PID=""
203: for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
204:   if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ]; then LOADER_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE"); break; fi
205:   sleep 0.1
206: done
207: [ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] || die "无法获取 bk_loader 进程号"
208: 
209: # Wait for it to actually enter the retry loop before poking the board.
210: for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
211:   grep -q "Getting Bus" "$LOG" && break
212:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
213:   sleep 0.1
214: done
215: 
216: if ! kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
217:   echo "  bk_loader 提前退出:"
218:   tail -5 "$LOG" | sed 's/^/    | /'
219:   wait "$LOADER_PID"; exit 1
220: fi
221: 
222: GOT_BUS=0
223: 
224: echo "  bk_loader 已进入握手循环，开始发送软复位"
225: 
226: for i in $(seq 1 "$REBOOT_TRIES"); do
227:   if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
228:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
229: 
230:   # If the console happens to be bridged to the AP shell, escape back to the
231:   # CP shell first: Ctrl-] then '.'.
232:   #
233:   # The trailing newline after the escape is essential.  Without it the CP
234:   # shell buffers all of it as a single line and sees "\x1d.reboot", answers
235:   # "cmd NOT found: .reboot" and never resets -- which made every attempt here
236:   # fall through to the manual RST prompt.  Measured: with the flush the board
237:   # reboots, without it it never does.
238:   printf '\035' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
239:   printf '.'    > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
240:   printf '\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
241:   printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
242:   echo "  第 $i 次软复位已发出"
243: 
244:   # Poll frequently so we stop writing the instant the bus is taken --
245:   # further bytes would corrupt the download protocol.
246:   for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
247:     if grep -q "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
248:     sleep 0.1
249:   done
250:   [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ] && break
251: done
252: 
253: if [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ]; then
254:   echo "  握手成功，下面是 bk_loader 的实时输出："
255: else
256:   echo "  软复位没能拿到总线 —— 现在请手动按一次 RST（按一下就彻底松手）"
257:   echo "  bk_loader 仍在循环握手，按下去就会接上"
258: fi
259: 
260: # Waiting on the pipeline, not the loader: tee has to finish draining before
261: # the log is complete enough to judge the outcome.
262: wait "$PIPELINE_PID"
263: RC=$?
264: rm -f "$PIDFILE"
265: 
266: # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. 判定
267: 
268: echo
269: echo "=== 结果 ==="
270: if grep -aq "All Finished Successfully" "$LOG"; then
271:   echo "  烧录成功"
272:   grep -aE "Total Test Time|EraseFlash ->pass" "$LOG" \
273:     | tail -3 | sed 's/^/    | /'
274: else
275:   echo "  烧录失败（退出码 $RC）"
276: 
277:   # Distinguish "never got started" from "killed halfway through the write",
278:   # because the second case leaves the board unbootable and must be re-flashed
279:   # before anything else is attempted.
280:   LAST_PCT=$(tr '\r' '\n' < "$LOG" | grep -aoE "Writing Flash \.\.\. [0-9]+%" \
281:              | tail -1)
282:   if [ -n "$LAST_PCT" ]; then
283:     echo
284:     echo "  !! flash 已被擦除但只写到 $LAST_PCT —— 固件不完整，板子起不来。"
285:     echo "     必须重新完整烧录一次才能恢复。"
286:     echo "     此时固件不响应 reboot，软复位无效，需要手动按一次 RST。"
287:   elif [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
288:     echo "  !! 被超时中止（上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s）"
289:   fi
290: 
291:   echo
292:   echo "  完整日志: $LOG"
293:   exit 1
294: fi
295: 
296: # --------------------------------------------------------- 5. 可选挂回串口
297: 
298: # Put the line back to the console rate.  bk_loader left it at BAUD, and if
299: # that is not CONSOLE_BAUD then anything attaching afterwards -- screen, cat,
300: # minicom -- would see garbage and typing would do nothing.

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>

7: #include <errno.h>

15: #include "arm_internal.h"

17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
19: #include "irq.h"
20: 
21: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
22: #define MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET   8u
23: 
24: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
25: {
26:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
27:   uint32_t order;
28:   bool used;
29: };
30: 
31: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
32: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
33: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
34: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
35: static bool g_mbox_ready;
36: static bool g_mbox_smp_ready;
37: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
38: 
39: static void mbox_trace_errors(void)
40: {
41:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(4,
42:     (g_stats.bad_source & 0xffu) |
43:     ((g_stats.bad_length & 0xffu) << 8) |
44:     ((g_stats.bad_address & 0xffu) << 16) |
45:     ((g_stats.descriptor_full & 0xffu) << 24));
46: }
47: 
48: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
49:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
50: 
51: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
52: {
53:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
54:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);
55: }
56: 
57: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
58: {
59:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
60:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
61:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
62: 
63:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
64:     {
65:       g_stats.write_error++;
66:     }
67: 
68:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
69:     {
70:       g_stats.read_error++;
71:     }
72: 
73:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
74:     {
75:       g_stats.write_full++;
76:     }
77: 
78:   if (errors != 0)
79:     {
80:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
81:     }
82: }
83: 
84: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
85:                                 uint32_t length)
86: {
87:   if (source != 0)
88:     {
89:       g_stats.bad_source++;
90:       mbox_trace_errors();
91:       return false;
92:     }
93: 
94:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_length++;
97:       mbox_trace_errors();
98:       return false;
99:     }
100: 
101:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
102:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
103:     {
104:       g_stats.bad_address++;
105:       mbox_trace_errors();
106:       return false;
107:     }
108: 
109:   return true;
110: }

112: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
113: {
114:   irqstate_t flags;
115:   uintptr_t status;
116:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
117: 
118:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
119:     {
120:       return -EINVAL;
121:     }
122: 
123: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
124:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
125:     {
126:       return -EPERM;
127:     }
128: #endif
129: 
130:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
131:    * receive FIFO status register.
132:    */
133: 
134:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
135:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
136:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
137:   flags = up_irq_save();
138:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
139:     {
140:       up_irq_restore(flags);
141:       return -EAGAIN;
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* TDATA0/TDATA1 are staging registers and TID commits the descriptor.
145:    * Keep raw SMP kicks and transport sends from interleaving these writes.
146:    */
147: 
148:   putreg32(data[0], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 :
149:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
150:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
151:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
152:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
153:                                    BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);
154:   up_irq_restore(flags);
155:   return OK;
156: }

158: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
159: {
160:   unsigned int i;
161: 
162:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
163:     {
164:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
165:         {
166:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
167:         }
168:     }
169: 
170:   return NULL;
171: }

173: static bool mbox_priority_message(
174:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
175: {
176:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
177: 
178:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
179: }

181: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
182: {
183:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
184:   unsigned int i;
185: 
186:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
187:     {
188:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
189: 
190:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
191:         {
192:           continue;
193:         }
194: 
195:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
196:         {
197:           oldest = desc;
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201:   return oldest;
202: }

204: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
205: {
206:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
207:   int ret;
208: 
209:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
210:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
211:    */
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
216:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
217:       g_processing_order = 0;
218:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
219:         {
220:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
221:           break;
222:         }
223: 
224:       desc->used = false;
225:     }
226: 
227:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
228:     {
229:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
230:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
231:       g_processing_order = 0;
232:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
233:         {
234:           break;
235:         }
236: 
237:       desc->used = false;
238:     }
239: }

241: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
242: {
243:   uintptr_t rdata0;
244:   uintptr_t rdata1;
245:   uintptr_t sidreg;
246:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
247:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
248: 
249:   (void)irq;
250:   (void)context;
251:   (void)arg;
252: 
253:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
254:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
255:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
256:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
257:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
258:     {
259:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
260:     }
261:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
262:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
263:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
264: 
265:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
266:     {
267:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
268:       uint32_t address;
269:       uint32_t length;
270:       uint8_t source;
271: 
272:       if (cpu == 0)
273:         {
274:           mbox_process_desc();
275:         }
276: 
277:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
278:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
279:         {
280:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
281:           mbox_trace_errors();
282:           break;
283:         }
284: 
285:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
286:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
287:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
288: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
289:       if (length == 0)
290:         {
291:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
292:             {
293:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
294:                 {
295:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
296:                 }
297: 
298:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
299:             }
300:           else
301:             {
302:               if (cpu == 0)
303:                 {
304:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
305:                   mbox_trace_errors();
306:                 }
307:             }
308: 
309:           continue;
310:         }
311: #endif
312: 
313:       if (cpu != 0)
314:         {
315:           continue;
316:         }
317: 
318:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
319:         {
320:           continue;
321:         }
322: 
323:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");

604: {
605: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
606: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
607: 
608: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
609: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
610: 
611: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
612: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
613: 
614: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
615: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
616: 
617: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
618: 
619: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
620: 		return;
621: 
622: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
623: 		return;
624: 
625: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
626: 		return;
627: 
628: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
629: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
630: 
631: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
632: 
633: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 
638: 		return;
639: 	}
640: 
641: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
642: 	{
643: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
644: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
645: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
646: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
647: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
648: 
649: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
650: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
651: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
652: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
653: 	}
654: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
655: 	{
656: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
657: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
658: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
659: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
660: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
661: 
662: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
663: 
664: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
665: 	}
666: 	else
667: 	{
668: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
669: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
670: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
671: 	}
672: 
673: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
674: 	{
675: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
676: 		return;
677: 	}
678: 
679: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
680: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
681: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */

683: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))

686: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
687: 		return;
688: 	}
689: 	return;

692: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
693: {
694: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
695: 
696: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
697: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
698: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
699: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
700: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
701: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
702: 
703: 	/*
704: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
705: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
706: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
707: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
708: 	 */
709: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
710: 	{
711: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
712: 	}
713: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
714: 	{
715: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
716: 	}
717: }

722: 
723: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
724: 
725: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;

733: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;

737: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)

740: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
741: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
742: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
743: 
744: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
745: 
746: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
747: 		{
748: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
749: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
750: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
751: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
752: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
753: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
754: 
755: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
756: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
757: 			}
758: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
759: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
760: 			return ret_code;
761: 		}
762: 	}

764: 	return BK_OK;

1197: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1198: {
1199: 	u8 phy_idx;
1200: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1201: 
1202: 	/* The CPU1 boot transaction may poll directly while ap_console is also
1203: 	 * scheduled.  Serialize the whole poll pass without holding the channel
1204: 	 * lock across callbacks and physical sends.
1205: 	 */
1206: 	if (s_poll_active)
1207: 	{
1208: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1209: 		return;
1210: 	}
1211: 	s_poll_active = 1;
1212: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1213: 
1214: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1215: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1216: 
1217: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1218: 	{
1219: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1220: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1221: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1222: 		u8 log_idx;
1223: 
1224: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1225: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1226: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1227: 		{
1228: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1229: 			continue;
1230: 		}
1231: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1232: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1233: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1234: 
1235: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1236: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);

78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;

82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;

                              │ _core1(prvDisable│     └─────────────────────┘
                              │ InterruptsAnd... │

**要点**：CPU2 在**调度器启动瞬间**被释放（同镜像，非独立 flash 镜像）；tick 固定 core0（`configTICK_CORE=CPU0_CORE_ID`，FreeRTOSConfig.h:127）、随 `xPortStartScheduler` 启动（port.c:1001→1016）；core ID 约定写 `0x20000000`（portmacro.h:247）；CPU0 用 ~1M 循环忙等代替握手协议。

# 时序图 3：当前 bk7258 OpenVela 实现（最新文件）


```
时间轴 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────▶
核            nx_start          nx_smp_start→up_cpu_start         late bring-up
CPU0(nuttx0) ┌─────────┬──────────┬────────────────┬──────────────┬─────────────┐
             │up_timer_│ 内核初始化│ 三轮FIFO握手     │ nx_bringup→   │ mailbox_    │
             │initialize│ board_early│ ①CPU2发NOTIFY   │ board_late_   │ workers_    │
             │ 只注册不使能│ init      │ ②CPU0回PING     │ initialize    │ start():    │
             │[IRQ开]   │ [IRQ开]   │ ③CPU2回ACK      │ (bringup线程)  │ wait_second_│
             └─────────┴──────────┴───┬────────────┴───┬─────────── ary_scheduler│
                                      │ DWT cycle预算+4M│  |          (L171/1090)   │
                                      │ 限界主动轮询    │  |           sched_setaffin│
                                      │ 完成后手动清    │  |           ity CPU0(L1103)│
                                      │ NVIC pending+  │  |           bk7258_timer_ │
                                      │ up_irq_restore │  |           start()开tick │
CPU2(nuttx1) ─────────────────────────┴───────┬────────┴───┬───────── (L1110)[IRQ开] │
      cpsid i → bk7258_secondary_start          │           │                        │
      │写1到0x20000000→切idle栈                │           │                        │
      │→bk7258_secondary_idle:                │           │                        │
      │ sched_note_cpu_started                │           │                        │
      │ ★up_irq_enable() [IRQ开]←握手完成前!  │→ACK       │                        │
      │ nop自旋等PING(②) ──────────────────────┘→回ACK(③)  │                        │
      │ →bk7258_smp_secondary_ready()                    │                        │
      │ →nx_idle_trampoline()                            │→(被4M裸轮询探测到)       │
      └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────┘
```


**要点**：SysTick 被推迟到 **CPU2 online 之后**、由 bring-up 线程手动开启（mailbox_channel.c:1110），启动前靠 4M 裸轮询 + boottrace 探针推进；握手是三轮协议 + 主动轮询（cpustart.c:203-240）；**CPU2 在 PING 等待前就已开中断**（cpustart.c:68）；CPU0 在握手完成处恢复 IRQ（cpustart.c:244-248）——"首 tick 抢占窗口"由此产生。

# 差异对比（按阶段逐项）


| 阶段 | 官方 NuttX | 博通原厂 | 当前实现 | 后果 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tick 启动 | `nx_start` 内立即（rp2040_timerisr.c:97 直接 ENABLE） | 调度器启动时（port.c:1016 `vPortSetupTimerInterrupt`） | **推迟到 bring-up 中段**（mailbox_channel.c:1110） | 启动期无 tick→超时失效→裸轮询；README 全部首 tick/IPI 排障均为自造 |
| tick owner | core0 单 tick | core0 单 tick（configTICK_CORE=CPU0） | core0 单 tick，CPU2 SysTick 关（irq.c 清除 NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL） | **三者一致 ✓** |
| 次核释放时机 | `nx_smp_start`（多任务前） | `xPortStartScheduler` 内（调度前瞬间） | `up_cpu_start`（多任务前，同官方） | 位置一致 ✓ |
| 握手协议 | 单原语：次核 `spin_unlock`（rp2040 core1_boot） | **无握手**：~1M 循环忙等（port.c:1219） | 三轮 FIFO NOTIFY/PING/ACK + DWT/4M 限界轮询（cpustart.c:203-240） | 当前实现协议最复杂→竞态面最大；原厂最粗暴但无协议态 |
| CPU0 握手期间 | 临界区/关中断（spin_lock+irq_save） | 忙等循环（中断保持使能） | 轮询中断开、完成后手动清 pending+restore（cpustart.c:244-248） | 首 tick 抢占窗口仅当前实现存在 |
| 次核中断时机 | 进调度/idle 后（esp32 握手后 `up_irq_enable`） | 次核进调度后 | **PING 握手前就开**（cpustart.c:68） | README secondary=16 Mailbox IRQ 竞态 |
| 次核镜像 | 同镜像 RAM trampoline | 同镜像（`__vector_core1_table`） | 同镜像 + `__secondary_vectors_start` trampoline | **一致 ✓** |
| core ID 约定 | 无 | 写 `0x20000000`（portmacro.h:247） | 写 1 到 `0x20000000`（cpustart.c:133） | 沿用原厂约定 ✓ |
| 原子/锁 | 官方 spinlock（硬件无关，标准 ticket） | FreeRTOS 标准 SMP 原语 | **全局跨核软件 Peterson gate**（hwspinlock.c:44-115，`CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK`） | 当前实现独有：tick 每 tick 过门，次核 wedge 即全核冻结 |
| 传输失败策略 | 不适用 | 不适用 | UART0 失败→`begin_abort` 全局链路恢复（mailbox_channel.c:752） | 当前实现独有：控制台拥堵→全链路 churn 放大 |


**结论**：三者只有两个实质分歧点——**tick 启动时机**（官方/原厂=启动早期，当前=推迟到 bring-up 中段）与**次核握手/中断时序**（官方=单原语+关中断，原厂=忙等无协议，当前=三轮协议+次核提前开中断）。这两个分歧即震动延迟与启动卡顿的根源路径。）

50: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
51: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */

## Objective
- 以 `11:14:xx` 最后一个已验证“Nuttx 成功启动、按键震动可运行”的版本为行为基准，修复 AP log 输出导致的按键震动进程阻塞。

## Important Details
- CPU 映射：物理 CPU0=Armino CP；物理 CPU1=OpenVela logical CPU0；物理 CPU2=OpenVela logical CPU1。
- logical CPU0 是唯一 SysTick owner；用户提供的时序分析指出当前实现将 SysTick 延迟到 `bk7258_mailbox_workers_start()`，并使用三轮 FIFO SMP 握手、次核提前开 IRQ，均偏离 NuttX 官方/博通原厂模式。
- 用户要求优先参考 `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp_original_backup` 和 NuttX 官方 SMP/IRQ 实现，将修复尽量收敛在 OpenVela AP 适配层。
- `11:14:xx` 基线没有独立 Git 提交或保留固件；构建产物已被后续版本覆盖，`git log`/`reflog` 未找到该时间提交。
- 用户确认 `11:14:xx` 版本能启动 Nuttx、运行按键震动，但 AP log 输出异常并导致按键震动进程阻塞。
- CP 原厂 `mailbox_channel.c` 没有常驻 `mbox_poll` task；当前 poll、quiesce/recovery、ACK 池扩展属于后续改动。
- AP log 路径为 `ap_bridge_task` → `shell_log_raw_data()`；原接口使用 `LOG_COMMON_MODE`，缓冲耗尽时最多在 `log_buf_semaphore` 上重试阻塞，可能把 AP log 背压传给 CP shell/其他任务。
- motor PWC 必须保持独立，不纳入 `g_pwc_tx_lock`；不得修改用户确认正确的 GPIO 配置。
- 串口 `/dev/ttyUSB1`；烧录命令为 `bash ./autoflash.sh -p /dev/ttyUSB1 -n 1 -b 1500000`。
- 工作树包含大量用户和历史改动，不得回退无关内容；根 SDK 与项目 `external/bk_avdk_smp` 对应改动需保持同步。

- 定位并移除 `bk7258_mb_uart.c:mb_uart_tx_complete()` 对 `g_bk7258_driver_lock` 的嵌套获取；transport 已在调用 completion callback 时持有该锁。
- 最新已烧录镜像 SHA256 为 `de8a9f31a41d4c4c3cb3e269ec5ba4929cd06805a9cdf6cc16a60e029d40be55`，仍复现 `CPU1 boot timeout stage=4`，trace 为 `primary=35`。

### Active

- 当前源码仍包含常驻 `mbox_poll` task、`mb_chnl_start_service()` 以及启动 AP 前提前启用 poll 的改动，尚未收敛回原厂模型。

262: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
263:                      uint32_t *order)
264: {
265:   uint32_t wire[2];
266:   int ret;
267: 
268:   *order = ++g_send_order;
269:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
270:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
271:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
272:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
273:   if (ret == OK)
274:     {
275:       g_stats.tx++;
276:     }
277:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
278:     {
279:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
280:     }
281: 
282:   if (ret < 0)
283:     {
284:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
285:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
286:         (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
287:         ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
288:         ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
289:         ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
290:     }
291: 
292:   return ret;
293: }

472: static int dispatch_locked(void)
473: {
474:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
475:   struct active_transaction *active;
476:   struct logical_channel *channel;
477:   unsigned int i;
478:   int ret;
479: 
480:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
481: 
482:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
483:     {
484:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
485:         {
486:           continue;
487:         }
488: 
489:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
490:       if (ret < 0)
491:         {
492:           return ret;
493:         }
494: 
495:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
496:     }
497: 
498:   if (g_reset_pending)
499:     {
500:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
501:       if (ret < 0)
502:         {
503:           return ret;
504:         }
505: 
506:       g_reset_pending = false;
507:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
508:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
509:     }
510: 
511:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
512:     {
513:       return OK;
514:     }
515: 
516:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
517:     {
518:       channel = &g_channels[i];
519:       if (!channel->queued)
520:         {
521:           continue;
522:         }
523: 
524:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
525:         {
526:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
527:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
528:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
529:             {
530:               active = &epoch->probe;
531:             }
532:           else
533:             {
534:               continue;
535:             }
536: 
537:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
538:               !epoch->replay)
539:             {
540:               return -ENOLINK;
541:             }
542:         }
543:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
544:         {
545:           active = &g_active;
546:           if (active->quarantine)
547:             {
548:               return -ENOLINK;
549:             }
550:         }
551:       else
552:         {
553:           return OK;
554:         }
555: 
556:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
557:         {
558:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
559:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
560:                  sizeof(active->message));
561:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
562:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
563:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
564:             g_channel_ids[i]);
565:         }
566: 
567:       active->callback = channel->callback;
568:       active->arg = channel->arg;
569:       active->channel_index = i;
570:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
571:       active->busy = true;
572:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
573:       if (ret < 0)
574:         {
575:           active->busy = false;
576:           return ret;
577:         }
578: 
579:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
580:         {
581:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
582:             {
583:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
584:             }
585: 
586:           g_probe_attempts++;
587:           g_stats.probes++;
588:         }
589: 
590:       return OK;
591:     }
592: 
593:   return OK;
594: }

598:   const struct active_transaction *active)
599: {
600:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
601:   uint32_t reason = 0;
602: 
603:   if (!active->busy)
604:     {
605:       return 1u;
606:     }
607: 
608:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
609:     {
610:       reason |= 2u;
611:     }
612:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
613:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
614:     {
615:       reason |= 4u;
616:     }
617:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
618:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
619:     {
620:       reason |= 8u;
621:     }
622:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
623:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
624:     {
625:       reason |= 16u;
626:     }
627: 
628:   return reason;
629: }
