631: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
632: {
633:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
634:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
635:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
636: }
637: 
638: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
639: {
640:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
641:   struct active_transaction *active;
642:   bool replay;
643:   int result;
644:   uint32_t reason;
645: 
646: 
647:   active = busy_probe();
648:   if (active == NULL)
649:     {
650:       active = &g_active;
651:     }
652: 
653:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
654:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
655:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
656:   if (reason != 0)
657:     {
658:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
659:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
660:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
661:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
662:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
663:       return;
664:     }
665: 
666: 
667:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
668:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
669:     {
670:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
671: 
672:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
673:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
674:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
675:       return;
676:     }
677: 
678:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
679:     {
680:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
681:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
682:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
683:       return;
684:     }
685: 
686:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
687:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
688: 
689:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
690:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
691:     {
692:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
693:     }
694: 
695:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
696:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
697:   if (replay)
698:     {
699:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
700:       unsigned int i;
701: 
702:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
703:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
704:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
705:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
706:        */
707: 
708:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
709:       g_active.quarantine = false;
710:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
711:         {
712:           if (i != replay_index)
713:             {
714:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
715:             }
716:         }
717: 
718:       select_recovery_epoch();
719:       (void)dispatch_locked();
720:       return;
721:     }
722: 
723:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
724: 
725:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
726:     {
727:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
728:         {
729:           release_recovery_slots();
730:           g_recovery_index = 0;
731:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
732:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
733:         }
734:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
735:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
736:         {
737:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
738:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
739:            */
740:         }
741:       else
742:         {
743:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
744:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
745:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
746:         }
747:     }
748: 
749:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
750:            result < 0)
751:     {
752:       begin_abort(result);
753:     }
754: 
755:   (void)dispatch_locked();
756: }
757: 
758: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
759: {
760:   struct ack_slot *slot;
761:   unsigned int rx_index;
762:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
763:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
764:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
765:   uint8_t state = 0;
766:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
767: 
768:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
769: 
770:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
771:     {
772:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
773:       if (slot == NULL)
774:         {
775:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
776:           return -EAGAIN;
777:         }
778:     }
779:   else
780:     {
781:       slot = NULL;
782:     }
783: 
784:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
785:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
786:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
787:     {
788:       g_stats.bad_header++;
789:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
790:     }
791:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
792:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
793:     {
794:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
795:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
796:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
797:         {
798:           if (slot != NULL)
799:             {
800:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
801:             }
802: 
803:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
804:           return -EAGAIN;
805:         }
806:       else if (ret < 0)
807:         {
808:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
809:         }
810:     }
811:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
812:     {
813:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
814:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
815:         {
816:           if (slot != NULL)
817:             {
818:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
819:             }
820: 
821:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
822:           return -EAGAIN;
823:         }
824:       else if (ret < 0)
825:         {
826:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
827:         }
828:     }
829:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
830:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
831:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
832:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
833:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
834:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
835:     {
836:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
837:       ack_flags = 2u;
838:       ret = OK;
839:     }
840:   else
841:     {
842:       g_stats.unsupported++;
843:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
844:     }
845: 
846:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
847:     {
848:       return OK;
849:     }
850: 
851:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
852:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
853:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
854:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
855:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
856: 
857:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
858:     {
859:       g_probe_requested = true;
860:     }
861: 
862:   (void)dispatch_locked();
863:   return OK;
864: }
865: 
866: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
867: {
868:   irqstate_t flags;
869:   uint8_t control;
870: 
871:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
872:   g_stats.rx++;
873:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
874: 
875:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
876:     {
877:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
878:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
879:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
880:         {
881:           g_stats.bad_header++;
882:         }
883:       else
884:         {
885:           g_stats.resets++;
886:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
887:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
888:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
889:         }
890:     }
891:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
892:     {
893:       handle_ack(message);
894:     }
895:   else
896:     {
897:       int ret = handle_command(message);
898: 
899:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
900:         {
901:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
902:           return ret;
903:         }
904:     }
905: 
906:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
907:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
908:   return OK;
909: }

911: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
912: {
913:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
914:   int ret;
915: 
916:   (void)argc;
917:   (void)argv;
918:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
919:   if (ret < 0)
920:     {
921:       return -EXDEV;
922:     }
923: 
924:   for (;;)
925:     {
926:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
927:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
928:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
929:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
930:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
931:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
932:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
933:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
934: 
935:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
936:       if (reported == state)
937:         {
938:           continue;
939:         }
940: 
941:       reported = state;
942:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
943:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
944:         {
945:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
946:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
947:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
948:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
949:         }
950: 
951:       if (callback != NULL)
952:         {
953:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
954:         }
955:     }
956: 
957:   return OK;
958: }

960: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
961: {
962:   int ret;
963: 
964:   (void)argc;
965:   (void)argv;
966:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
967:   if (ret < 0)
968:     {
969:       ret = -EXDEV;
970:     }
971: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
972:   else if (!bk7258_smp_secondary_is_ready())
973:     {
974:       ret = -EAGAIN;
975:     }
976: #endif
977:   if (ret < 0)
978:     {
979:       return ret;
980:     }
981: 
982:   for (;;)
983:     {
984:       struct active_transaction *probe;
985:       irqstate_t flags;
986:       bool request_probe;
987: 
988:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
989:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
990: 
991:       probe = busy_probe();
992:       if ((g_active.busy &&
993:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
994:           (probe != NULL &&
995:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
996:         {
997:           g_stats.timeout++;
998:           bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
999:             (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
1000:             ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
1001:             ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
1002:             ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
1003:           if (probe != NULL)
1004:             {
1005:               probe->quarantine = true;
1006:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
1007:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
1008:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
1009:             }
1010:           else
1011:             {
1012:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
1013:             }
1014:         }
1015: 
1016:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
1017:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
1018:         {
1019:           select_recovery_epoch();
1020:         }
1021: 
1022:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1023:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
1024:         {
1025:           g_probe_requested = false;
1026:         }
1027: 
1028:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
1029:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1030:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
1031:       if (request_probe)
1032:         {
1033:           g_probe_requested = false;
1034:         }
1035: 
1036:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1037: 
1038:       if (request_probe)
1039:         {
1040:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1041:         }
1042:     }
1043: 
1044:   return OK;
1045: }

1075: int bk7258_mailbox_workers_start(void)
1076: {
1077:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
1078:   int ret;
1079: 
1080:   if (!g_initialized)
1081:     {
1082:       return -EAGAIN;
1083:     }
1084: 
1085:   if (g_workers_started)
1086:     {
1087:       return OK;
1088:     }
1089: 
1090:   ret = wait_secondary_scheduler();
1091:   if (ret < 0)
1092:     {
1093:       return ret;
1094:     }
1095: 
1096: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
1097:   /* All physical CP descriptors must originate on logical CPU0.  Pin the
1098:    * creator before activating the workers so their inherited affinity is
1099:    * CPU0-only from their first scheduled instruction. */
1100: 
1101:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
1102:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
1103:   ret = sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
1104:   if (ret < 0)
1105:     {
1106:       return ret;
1107:     }
1108: #endif
1109: 
1110:   ret = bk7258_timer_start();
1111:   if (ret < 0)
1112:     {
1113:       return ret;
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_RETURN);
1117: 
1118:   if (!g_tx_worker_created)
1119:     {
1120:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-v2", MB_TX_BOOT_PRIORITY, 2048,
1121:                            mailbox_tx_worker, NULL);
1122:       if (ret < 0)
1123:         {
1124:           return ret;
1125:         }
1126: 
1127:       g_tx_worker_created = true;
1128:       g_tx_worker_pid = ret;
1129:     }
1130: 
1131:   if (!g_diag_worker_created)
1132:     {
1133:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-diag", 80, 1024, mailbox_diag_worker, NULL);
1134:       if (ret < 0)
1135:         {
1136:           return ret;
1137:         }
1138: 
1139:       g_diag_worker_created = true;
1140:     }
1141: 
1142:   g_workers_started = true;
1143:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_READY);
1144:   return OK;
1145: }

1147: int bk7258_mailbox_workers_activate(void)

1184: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
1185:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1186:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
1187: {
1188:   struct logical_channel *channel;
1189:   unsigned int index;
1190:   irqstate_t flags;
1191: 
1192:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
1193:     {
1194:       return -EAGAIN;
1195:     }
1196: 
1197:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1198:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1199:     {
1200:       return -EINVAL;
1201:     }
1202: 
1203:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1204:   channel = &g_channels[index];
1205: 
1206:   if (channel->queued)
1207:     {
1208:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1209:       return -EBUSY;
1210:     }
1211: 
1212:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1213:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
1214:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
1215:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
1216:     {
1217:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1218:       return -ENOLINK;
1219:     }
1220: 
1221:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
1222:     {
1223:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1224:       return -ENOLINK;
1225:     }
1226: 
1227:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
1228:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
1229:   channel->callback = callback;
1230:   channel->arg = arg;
1231:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
1232:   channel->queued = true;
1233: 
1234:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
1235:     {
1236:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1240: 
1241:   /* CPU1 callers only enqueue work.  Physical descriptors to the CP still
1242:    * originate exclusively from logical CPU0.
1243:    */
1244: 
1245:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1246:   return OK;
1247: }

1249: int bk7258_mailbox_register_rx(uint8_t logical_channel,
1250:                                bk7258_mb_channel_rx_t callback, void *arg)
1251: {
1252:   unsigned int index = rx_channel_index(logical_channel);
1253: 
1254:   if (index >= MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1255:     {

1264: int bk7258_mailbox_start_probe(void)
1265: {
1266:   irqstate_t flags;
1267: 
1268:   if (!g_initialized)
1269:     {
1270:       return -EAGAIN;
1271:     }
1272: 
1273:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1274:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN)
1275:     {
1276:       select_recovery_epoch();
1277:     }
1278:   /* A probe request is idempotent once the transport is ready.  The boot
1279:    * wait loop and the UART worker can request a probe concurrently; reopening
1280:    * a READY link here would abort a valid state ACK and race the first PWC
1281:    * transaction. */
1282: 
1283:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
1284:     {
1285:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1286:     }
1287: 
1288:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1289:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);

1334: int bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(unsigned int timeout_ms)
1335: {
1336:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1337:   clock_t next_probe = clock_systime_ticks();
1338: 
1339:   while (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1340:     {
1341:       clock_t now = clock_systime_ticks();
1342: 
1343:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
1344:         {
1345:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1346:         }
1347: 
1348:       /* Keep the boot-time probe self-starting even if the initial
1349:        * ABORTING -> PROBING worker wakeup was consumed before RESET was
1350:        * dispatched.  This only marks STATE pending; normal transaction
1351:        * serialization remains in the mailbox workers. */
1352:       if ((int32_t)(now - next_probe) >= 0)
1353:         {
1354:           /* The TX worker can complete STATE between the loop condition and
1355:            * this retry point.  Do not reopen a link that has just become
1356:            * ready. */
1357:           if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1358:             {

1360:               bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1361:             }
1362:           next_probe = now + MSEC2TICK(100);
1363:         }
1364: 
1365:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1366:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
1367:     }
1368: 
1369:   return OK;
1370: }

246: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
247: {
248: 	/* Keep one ACK slot available for the command currently being handled.
249: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
250: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */
251: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1;

254: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
255: {
256: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
257: 
258: 	while (1)
259: 	{
260: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
261: 		bk_err_t ret;
262: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
263: 
264: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
265: 		{
266: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
267: 			return;
268: 		}
269: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
270: 		ack_sending = 1;
271: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
272: 
273: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
274: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
275: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
276: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
277: 		{
278: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
279: 			ack_sending = 0;
280: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
281: 			return;
282: 		}
283: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
284: 		ack_count--;
285: 		ack_sending = 0;
286: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
287: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
288: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
289: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
290: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
291: 	}
292: }

294: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)

299: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1)
300: 	{
301: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
302: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
303: 		return false;
304: 	}
305: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
306: 	entry->data = *data;
307: 	entry->destination = destination;
308: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
309: 	ack_count++;
310: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
311: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
312: 	return true;

400: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
401: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
402: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
403: 
404: 	__DMB();
405: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
406: 
407: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
408: 
409: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
410: 
411: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
412: 	{
413: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
414: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
415: 
416: 		return ret_code;
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
420: 
421: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
422: 
423: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
424: 	{
425: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	return BK_OK;
429: }

436: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
437: {
438: 	u8		log_chnl;
439: 	u8		ret_code;
440: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
441: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
442: 
443: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
444: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
445: 
446: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
447: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
448: 	{
449: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
450: 
451: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
452: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
453: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
454: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
455: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
456: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
457: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
458: 		{
459: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
460: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
461: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
462: 			return;
463: 		}
464: 
465: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
466: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
467: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
468: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
469: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
470: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
471: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
472: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
473: 		{
474: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
475: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
476: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
477: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
478: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
479: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
480: 			{
481: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
482: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
483: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
484: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
485: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
486: 			}
487: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
488: 		}
489: 		else
490: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
491: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
492: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
493: 		return;
494: 	}
495: 
496: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
497: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
498: 
499: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
500: 
501: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
502: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
503: 		return;
504: 	}
505: 
506: 
507: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
508: 	{
509: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
510: 		return;
511: 	}
512: 
513: 
514: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
515: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
516: 		return;
517: 	}
518: 
519: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
520: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_header = ack_ptr->hdr.data;
521: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;
522: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
523: 
524: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
525: 	{
526: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
527: 		return;
528: 	}
529: 
530: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
531: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
532: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
533: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
534: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
535: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
536: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
537: 	{
538: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
539: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
544: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
545: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
546: 
547: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
548: 
549: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
550: 	{
551: 		/* clear following header members. */
552: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
553: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
554: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
555: 
556: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
557: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
558: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
559: 	} else {
560: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
561: 	}
562: 
563: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
564: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
565: 	{
566: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
567: 		return;
568: 	}
569: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
570: 	{
571: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
572: 			break;
573: 	}
574: 
575: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
576: 	{
577: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
578: 		return;
579: 	}
580: 
581: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
582: 
583: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
584: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
585: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
586: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
587: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
588: 
589: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
590: 
591: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
592: 	{
593: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
594: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
595: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
596: 	}
597: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
598: 
599: 	return;
600: 
601: }

603: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
604: {
605: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
606: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
607: 
608: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
609: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
610: 
611: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
612: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
613: 
614: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
615: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
616: 
617: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
618: 
619: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
620: 		return;
621: 
622: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
623: 		return;
624: 
625: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
626: 		return;
627: 
628: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
629: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
630: 
631: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
632: 
633: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 
638: 		return;
639: 	}
640: 
641: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
642: 	{
643: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
644: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
645: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
646: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
647: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
648: 
649: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
650: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
651: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
652: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
653: 	}
654: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
655: 	{
656: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
657: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
658: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
659: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
660: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
661: 
662: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
663: 
664: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
665: 	}
666: 	else
667: 	{
668: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
669: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
670: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
671: 	}
672: 
673: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
674: 	{
675: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
676: 		return;
677: 	}
678: 
679: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
680: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
681: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
682: 
683: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
684: 	{
685: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
686: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
687: 		return;
688: 	}
689: 	return;
690: }

692: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
693: {
694: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
695: 
696: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
697: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
698: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
699: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
700: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
701: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
702: 
703: 	/*
704: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
705: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
706: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
707: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
708: 	 */
709: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
710: 	{
711: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
712: 	}
713: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
714: 	{
715: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
716: 	}
717: }

719: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
720: {
721: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
722: 
723: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
724: 
725: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
726: 
727: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
728: 
729: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
730: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
731: 
732: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
733: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
734: 
735: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
736: 
737: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
738: 	{
739: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
740: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
741: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
742: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
743: 
744: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
745: 
746: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
747: 		{
748: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
749: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
750: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
751: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
752: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
753: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
754: 
755: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
756: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
757: 			}
758: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
759: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
760: 			return ret_code;
761: 		}
762: 	}
763: 
764: 	return BK_OK;
765: }

767: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
768: 
769: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
770: {
771: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
772: 	u16 			chnl_type;
773: 
774: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
775: 
776: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
777: 
778: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
779: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
780: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
781: #endif
782: 
783: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
784: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
785: 
786: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
787: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
788: 
789: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
790: 
791: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
792: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
793: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
794: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
795: 
796: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
797: 
798: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
799: 
800: 	/*
801: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
802: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
803: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
804: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
805: 	 */
806: 	while(1)
807: 	{
808: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
809: 
810: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
811: 		{
812: 			break;
813: 		}
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	return ret_code;
817: }

820: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
821: /*
822:   * init logical chnanel module.
823:   * return:
824:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
825:   *     failed  : fail code.
826:   *
827:   */
828: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
829: {
830: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
831: 	int				i, j;
832: 
833: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
834: 
835: 	/*
836: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
837: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
838: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
839: 	 * can race here:
840: 	 *
841: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
842: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
843: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
844: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
845: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
846: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
847: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
848: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
849: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
850: 	 *
851: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
852: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
853: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
854: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
855: 	 */
856: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
857: 	{
858: 		return BK_OK;
859: 	}
860: 
861: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
862: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
863: 	{
864: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
865: 		return BK_OK;
866: 	}
867: 
868: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
869: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
870: 	ack_read = 0;
871: 	ack_write = 0;
872: 	ack_count = 0;
873: 	ack_sending = 0;
874: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
875: 	{
876: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
877: 
878: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
879: 
880: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
881:

112: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
113: {
114:   irqstate_t flags;
115:   uintptr_t status;
116:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
117: 
118:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
119:     {
120:       return -EINVAL;
121:     }

123: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
124:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
125:     {
126:       return -EPERM;

128: #endif
129: 
130:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
131:    * receive FIFO status register.
132:    */
133: 
134:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
135:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
136:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
137:   flags = up_irq_save();
138:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
139:     {
140:       up_irq_restore(flags);

144:   /* TDATA0/TDATA1 are staging registers and TID commits the descriptor.
145:    * Keep raw SMP kicks and transport sends from interleaving these writes.

151:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
152:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
153:                                    BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);
154:   up_irq_restore(flags);
155:   return OK;

182: {
183:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
184:   unsigned int i;

186:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
187:     {

190:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
191:         {

193:         }

195:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)

204: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
205: {
206:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
207:   int ret;
208: 
209:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
210:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
211:    */
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
216:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
217:       g_processing_order = 0;
218:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
219:         {
220:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
221:           break;
222:         }
223: 
224:       desc->used = false;
225:     }
226: 
227:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
228:     {
229:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
230:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
231:       g_processing_order = 0;
232:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
233:         {
234:           break;
235:         }
236: 
237:       desc->used = false;
238:     }

241: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
242: {
243:   uintptr_t rdata0;
244:   uintptr_t rdata1;
245:   uintptr_t sidreg;
246:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
247:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
248: 
249:   (void)irq;
250:   (void)context;
251:   (void)arg;
252: 
253:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
254:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
255:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
256:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
257:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
258:     {
259:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
260:     }
261:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
262:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
263:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
264: 
265:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
266:     {
267:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
268:       uint32_t address;
269:       uint32_t length;
270:       uint8_t source;
271: 
272:       if (cpu == 0)
273:         {
274:           mbox_process_desc();
275:         }
276: 
277:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
278:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
279:         {
280:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
281:           mbox_trace_errors();
282:           break;
283:         }
284: 
285:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
286:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
287:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
288: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
289:       if (length == 0)
290:         {
291:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
292:             {
293:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
294:                 {
295:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
296:                 }
297: 
298:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
299:             }
300:           else
301:             {
302:               if (cpu == 0)
303:                 {
304:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
305:                   mbox_trace_errors();
306:                 }
307:             }
308: 
309:           continue;
310:         }
311: #endif
312: 
313:       if (cpu != 0)
314:         {
315:           continue;
316:         }
317: 
318:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
319:         {
320:           continue;
321:         }
322: 
323:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
324:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
325:              sizeof(desc->message));
326:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
327:       desc->used = true;
328:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
329:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, desc->message.header);
330:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, address);
331:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.rx_messages);
332:       mbox_process_desc();
333:     }
334: 
335:   if (cpu == 0)
336:     {
337:       mbox_process_desc();
338:     }
339: 
340:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
341:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
342:     {
343:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
344:     }
345: 
346:   return OK;
347: }

170: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,

183:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
184: 
185:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))

187:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
188:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
189:     }

193:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
194:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
195:     }
196: 
197:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
198:     {
199:       if (!failed)
200:         {
201:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
202:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
203:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
204:         }
205:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)

208:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
209:            */

212:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
213:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
214:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
215:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
216:         }
217:       else
218:         {
219:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
220:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
221:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
222:             {
223:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
224:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
225:                */

227:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;

230:           else

232:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
233:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
234:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
235:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
236:             }
237:         }
238: 
239:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;

55:   int retry;

57:   UP_DMB();
58:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)

61: 
62:       if (ret == OK)
63:         {

65:         }

81:   int expected = 0;
82:   int retry;

87:     }
88: 
89:   bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_ENTRY | (pending & 0xffu));
90:   atomic_or_release(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], pending);
91:   if (!atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], &expected, 1))
92:     {
93:       bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_CLAIM | 0x100u);
94:       return OK;
95:     }
96: 
97:   bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_CLAIM | (cpu & 0xffu));
98:   UP_DMB();

100:     {

102: 
103:       if (ret == OK)
104:         {
105:           bk7258_smp_trace(BK7258_IPI_TRACE_SENT | (retry & 0xffffu));

107:         }

113:                            ((uint32_t)(-ret) & 0xffffu));

116: 
117:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
118:     }

120:   atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);

132:         {
133:           g_boot_seen |= BK7258_BOOT_SEEN_NOTIFY;
134:         }
135: 
136:       return;
137:     }
138: 
139:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_PING)
140:     {
141:       if (cpu == 1)
142:         {
143:           atomic_set_release(&g_boot_ping_received, 1);
144:           if (bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <

149:         }

152:     }

154:   if (command == BK7258_MBOX_BOOT_ACK)

157:         {

159:         }

161:       return;
162:     }

173:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_CALL) != 0)

183:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
184:       UP_DMB();

186:         {
187:           break;
188:         }
189: 
190:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 1);
191:     }

376: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;

378: 	u8 ctrl;

380: 	u8 index = 0;

382: 
383: 	(void)arg;

385: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;

393: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;

412: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);

419: 	}

421: 	{

423: 		adapter_diag.ack_sent++;

428: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
429: {
430: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
431: 	u32 completed_order;
432: 	u8 i;
433: 
434: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
435: 		return;
436: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
437: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
438: 		return;
439: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
440: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
441: 	{
442: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
443: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
444: 	}
445: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
446: 	{
447: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
448: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
449: 	}
450: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
451: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
452: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
453: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
454: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;

449: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
450: {
451: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
452: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
453: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
454: 	u16 		chnl_type;
455: 
456: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
457: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
458: 
459: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
460: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
461: 
462: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
463: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
464: 
465: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
466: 
467: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
468: 		return;
469: 
470: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
471: 		return;
472: 
473: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
474: 		return;
475: 
476: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
477: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
478: 
479: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
480: 
481: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
482: 	{
483: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
484: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
485: 
486: 		return;
487: 	}
488: 
489: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
490: 	{
491: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
492: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
493: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
494: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
495: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
496: 
497: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
498: 
499: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
500: 	}
501: 	else
502: 	{
503: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
507: 	{
508: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
509: 		return;
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
513: 
514: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
515: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
516: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
517: 
518: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
519: 
520: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
521: 
522: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
523: 
524: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
525: 	{
526: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
527: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
528: 
529: 		return;
530: 	}
531: 
532: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
533: 	return;
534: }

536: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)

541: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;

543: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
544: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
545: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */

547: 	/*
548: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
549: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
550: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
551: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).

556: 	}
557: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
558: 	{
559: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
560: 	}

18:

20: #include "nvic.h"
21: #include "irq.h"
22: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
23: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
24: 
25: #define BK7258_SYSTICK_RELOAD \
26:   ((CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ / TICK_PER_SEC) - 1u)
27: 
28: #if CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ % TICK_PER_SEC != 0
29: #  error "BK7258 CPU frequency must divide evenly into the system tick rate"
30: #endif
31: 
32: #if BK7258_SYSTICK_RELOAD > NVIC_MAX_SYSTICK_CNT
33: #  error "BK7258 SysTick reload exceeds the 24-bit counter"
34: #endif
35: 
36: static bool g_first_tick_complete;
37: 
38: static int bk7258_timerisr(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
39: {
40:   bool first_tick = !g_first_tick_complete;
41: 
42:   (void)irq;
43:   (void)context;
44:   (void)arg;
45: 
46:   if (first_tick)
47:     {
48:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 1);
49:     }
50: 
51:   bk7258_smp_retry_pending();
52:   nxsched_process_timer();
53: 
54:   if (first_tick)
55:     {
56:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 2);
57:       g_first_tick_complete = true;
58:     }
59: 
60:   return OK;
61: }
62: 
63: int bk7258_timer_start(void)
64: {
65:   if (up_cpu_index() != 0)
66:     {
67:       return -EXDEV;
68:     }
69: 
70:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
71:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_SYSTICK_STARTED);
72:   putreg32(NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_CLKSOURCE | NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_TICKINT |
73:            NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
74:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK);
75:   return OK;
76: }
77: 
78: void up_timer_initialize(void)
79: {
80:   uint32_t priority;
81: 
82:   /* Match the vendor SMP port's configTICK_CORE contract: only logical CPU0
83:    * owns the global tick.  CPU1 leaves its private SysTick disabled.
84:    */
85: 
86:   DEBUGASSERT(up_cpu_index() == 0);
87: 
88:   priority = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
89:   priority &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR15_MASK;
90:   priority |= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT <<
91:               NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR15_SHIFT;
92:   putreg32(priority, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
93: 
94:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
95:   putreg32(BK7258_SYSTICK_RELOAD, NVIC_SYSTICK_RELOAD);
96:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CURRENT);
97: 
98:   if (irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK, bk7258_timerisr, NULL) < 0)
99:     {
100:       PANIC();
101:     }
102: 
103:   /* nx_start() initializes the clock before nx_smp_start().  Keep SysTick
104:    * stopped until up_cpu_start() has completed the secondary boot transaction.
105:    */
106: }

1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP移植
2: 
3: 本项目将OpenVela/NuttX移植到BK7258 AP核，并保留博通原厂CP固件、Bootloader、分区和最终打包流程。当前已实现AP核启动，以及AP日志通过Mailbox转发到CP UART0输出。
4: 
5: ## 简单使用说明
6: 
7: 本项目需要配合博通`bk_avdk_smp` SMP工程使用：
8: 
9: ```text
10: 工作区/
11: ├── contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12: └── bk_avdk_smp/
13: ```
14: 
15: 构建前，需要将比赛仓`external/bk_avdk_smp/`中的权威覆盖文件同步到
16: `bk_avdk_smp`。完整文件清单、可直接执行的同步脚本、逐字节校验、OpenVela AP
17: 构建、CP构建和最终固件打包步骤见`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。Git协作和
18: 提交规则见`github开发指南.md`。
19: 
20: ## UART0控制台使用
21: 
22: 连接开发板UART0：
23: 
24: ```bash
25: picocom --no-escape -b 115200 --flow n --parity n --databits 8 /dev/ttyUSB0
26: ```
27: 
28: CP启动后可先查看AP链路状态，再进入AP的OpenVela NSH控制台：
29: 
30: ```text
31: ap_console status
32: ap_console open
33: ```
34: 
35: 进入AP控制台后可以直接执行NSH命令，例如：
36: 
37: ```text
38: help
39: uname -a
40: ps
41: free
42: ctrlc_test
43: ```
44: 
45: `ctrlc_test`会持续等待TTY `SIGINT`。按`Ctrl-C`后应打印
46: `ctrlc_test received SIGINT`并返回NSH提示符。
47: 
48: AP控制台支持方向键、Home、End、Delete、Backspace、命令历史，以及
49: `Ctrl-A`、`Ctrl-B`、`Ctrl-D`、`Ctrl-E`、`Ctrl-F`、`Ctrl-H`、`Ctrl-K`、
50: `Ctrl-L`、`Ctrl-N`、`Ctrl-P`和`Ctrl-U`等CLE快捷键。
51: 
52: 退出AP控制台并返回CP命令行时，严格按以下顺序操作：
53: 
54: 1. 按下`Ctrl-]`。
55: 2. 松开按键。
56: 3. 再按`.`。
57: 
58: 返回CP命令行后可再次检查状态：
59: 
60: ```text
61: ap_console status
62: ```
63: 
64: ## 主要目录
65: 
66: ```text
67: board/beken/chips/bk7258/                  BK7258 AP启动、中断、定时器和Mailbox驱动
68: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/       BK7258 AP板级配置、链接脚本和bring-up
69: external/bk_avdk_smp/                      已验证的博通CP覆盖文件
70: logs/                                      AI Coding日志
71: ```
72: 
73: ## 已实现功能
74: 
75: - BK7258物理CPU1/AP启动OpenVela/NuttX。
76: - Cortex-M33启动向量、C运行时、MPU、FPU、IRQ和SysTick基础适配。
77: - Mailbox v2基础传输、logical channel、sequence、ACK、超时和FIFO full恢复。
78: - 原厂兼容HW_CTRL command 1 power-up、command 2两秒heartbeat，以及独立的PWC `0x5/0x11`生命周期握手。
79: - AP日志通过Mailbox UART0转发到CP物理UART0。
80: - GPIO40红灯和GPIO41绿灯由NuttX内核自动LED状态接口接管，用于显示
81:   中断、信号、断言、Panic、空闲和启动状态。
82: - AP、CP和Bootloader通过`bk_avdk_smp`标准打包流程生成`all-app.bin`。
83: - 当前为物理CPU1+CPU2的OpenVela/NuttX SMP，CP保持物理CPU0。

48: /****************************************************************************
49:  * Name: nxthread_create
50:  *
51:  * Description:
52:  *   This function creates and activates a new thread of the specified type
53:  *   with a specified priority and returns its system-assigned ID.  It is the
54:  *   internal, common implementation of task_create() and kthread_create().
55:  *   See comments with task_create() for further information.
56:  *
57:  * Input Parameters:
58:  *   name       - Name of the new task
59:  *   ttype      - Type of the new task
60:  *   priority   - Priority of the new task
61:  *   stack_addr - Address of the stack needed
62:  *   stack_size - Size (in bytes) of the stack needed
63:  *   entry      - Entry point of a new task
64:  *   arg        - A pointer to an array of input parameters.  The array
65:  *                should be terminated with a NULL argv[] value. If no
66:  *                parameters are required, argv may be NULL.
67:  *   envp       - A pointer to an array of environment strings. Terminated
68:  *                with a NULL entry.
69:  *
70:  * Returned Value:
71:  *   Returns the positive, non-zero process ID of the new task or a negated
72:  *   errno value to indicate the nature of any failure.  If memory is
73:  *   insufficient or the task cannot be created -ENOMEM will be returned.
74:  *
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: int nxthread_create(FAR const char *name, int ttype, int priority,
78:                     FAR void *stack_addr, int stack_size, main_t entry,
79:                     FAR char * const argv[], FAR char * const envp[])
80: {
81:   posix_spawnattr_t attr;
82:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb;
83:   pid_t pid;
84:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
85: 
86:   posix_spawnattr_init(&attr);
87:   posix_spawnattr_setstacksize(&attr, (size_t)stack_size);
88:   posix_spawnattr_setstackaddr(&attr, stack_addr);
89:   posix_spawnattr_setpriority(&attr, priority);
90: 
91:   /* Allocate a TCB for the new task. */
92: 
93:   tcb = kmm_zalloc(ttype == TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL ?
94:                    sizeof(struct tcb_s) :
95:                    sizeof(struct tcb_s) + sizeof(struct task_group_s));
96:   if (!tcb)
97:     {
98:       serr("ERROR: Failed to allocate TCB\n");
99:     }
100:   else
101:     {
102:       /* Setup the task type */
103: 
104:       atomic_set(&tcb->flags, ttype | TCB_FLAG_FREE_TCB);
105: 
106:       /* Initialize the task */
107: 
108:       ret = nxtask_init(tcb, name, entry, NULL, &attr, argv, envp);
109:       posix_spawnattr_destroy(&attr);
110:       if (ret < OK)
111:         {
112:           kmm_free(tcb);
113:         }
114:       else
115:         {
116:           /* Get the assigned pid before we start the task */
117: 
118:           pid = tcb->pid;
119: 
120:           /* Activate the task */
121: 
122:           nxtask_activate(tcb);
123: 
124:           ret = pid;
125:         }
126:     }
127: 
128:   return ret;
129: }

## Objective
- 按“CP 尽可能维持博通原厂状态、AP 兼容原厂 CP”的方向调试 mailbox，使 NuttX 稳定启动。
- 在成功启动和按键震动可用的前提下，用非阻塞 AP log 修复日志背压导致的震动进程阻塞。

## Important Details
- CPU 映射：物理 CPU0=Armino CP；物理 CPU1=OpenVela logical CPU0；物理 CPU2=OpenVela logical CPU1。
- logical CPU0 是唯一 SysTick owner；当前重点是 AP SMP、worker、IRQ 和 mailbox 初始化时序。
- 用户要求优先参考 `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp_original_backup` 和 NuttX 官方实现，CP 尽量保持原厂，兼容改动主要放在 AP。
- `11:14:xx` 基线没有对应提交、源码快照或保留固件；已知该版本能进入 `NuttShell (NSH)`、运行按键震动，但 AP log 会阻塞震动进程。
- 历史可启动日志 `/tmp/ap-regression-2.log` 为 `primary=31, secondary=16`，出现 `NuttShell (NSH)`；CP 后续仍曾报 `CPU1 boot timeout stage=4`。
- 最新诊断证明 CP 收到的 4 个 AP descriptor 全是 transport ACK：`cmd_received=0`、`callback_missing=0`、`ack_send_fail=0`；AP 尚未发送 UART STATE command，当前首要断点不在 CP ACK。
- AP trace 阶段含义：`35=BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_RETURN`、`36=BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_READY`、`37=BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_WORKERS`。
- AP 当前到达 `primary=37, secondary=16`，说明 mailbox workers、SysTick 和 secondary IRQ 均已推进；停在 `bk7258_mb_uart_worker_start()` 内，最可能是 `kthread_create("mb-uart0", ...)`。
- AP log 路径为 `ap_bridge_task` → `shell_log_raw_data_nonblock()`，仅 AP log/RAW 回显使用 `LOG_NONBLOCK_MODE`；普通 CP 日志和命令响应保持原模式。
- motor PWC 必须保持独立，不纳入 `g_pwc_tx_lock`；不得修改用户确认正确的 GPIO 配置。
- 串口 `/dev/ttyUSB1`；烧录命令为 `bash ./autoflash.sh -p /dev/ttyUSB1 -n 1 -b 1500000`。
- 工作树包含大量用户和历史改动，不得回退无关内容；根 SDK 与项目 `external/bk_avdk_smp` 的 CP 修改需同步。

## Work State
### Completed
- 已构建并烧录非阻塞 AP log 版本；确认该修复本身不改变此前 `primary=35, secondary=13` 的启动失败。
- CP 启动 AP 前的 `mb_chnl_start_service()` 和 boot wait 中的 `mb_chnl_poll()` 已移除，根 SDK与项目 external 副本已同步。
- CP 常驻 `mbox_poll` task 已从 `mb_chnl_init()` 正常路径移除；`mb_chnl_start_service()` 暂保留为空兼容入口，显式 `mb_chnl_poll()` 仍保留。
- CP adapter 当前实验性改为在 mailbox ISR 接收路径立即调用 logical callback，并增加 command/callback/ACK 诊断。
- AP `bk7258_mailbox_workers_start()` 已改为先创建两个 mailbox workers，再启动 SysTick；实机 trace 从 `primary=35, secondary=13` 推进到 `primary=36/37, secondary=16`。
- 新增 late bring-up trace：`BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_WORKERS`、`BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_UART_WORKER`、`BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_ACTIVATE`、`BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_UART_START`、`BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_LINK_WAIT`、`BK7258_BOOT_BRINGUP_LINK_READY`。
- AP 和 CP 均已多次成功构建、打包、烧录；AP 输入与 `package/tmp/app1.bin` 已逐字节校验一致。
- 最新已烧录 `all-app.bin` SHA256 为 `955db62e56eecb17ea9b86562f767329ded73cb9ee23f1cb82fff2caa6ceb73d`。
- 最新日志 `/tmp/ap-regression-traced-bringup.log` 显示 `primary=37, secondary=16`，但仍有 `CPU1 boot timeout stage=4`。
- `git diff --check` 已通过。

### Active
- 正在定位 `bk7258_mb_uart_worker_start()` 内的停点，需区分进入函数、`kthread_create("mb-uart0", MB_UART_BOOT_PRIORITY, 2048, ...)` 未返回和线程调度/affinity 问题。
- AP mailbox worker/SysTick 顺序调整和 late bring-up trace 当前保留。
- CP ISR 即时 callback、mailbox 诊断和无常驻 poll 模型当前保留，但尚未证明 ISR 即时 callback 是最终必要实现。
- 非阻塞 AP log 修复已包含在当前包中，但因 NuttX 尚未启动，无法验证持续日志下的按键震动。

### Blocked
- `11:14:xx` 对应的 `nuttx.bin`、`all-app.bin` 和源码快照均未保留，无法直接恢复或二进制比较。
- 当前 AP 卡在 `primary=37`，尚未进入 UART worker start 后续阶段，也未出现 `NuttShell (NSH)`。
- 在恢复启动前无法验收按键震动延迟、持续 AP log、heartbeat 和 `ap_console open`。
- CP 当前仍包含 ACK queue、recovery、显式 poll 等较多非原厂扩展，最终需在启动恢复后继续判断哪些是 wire ABI 必需项。

## Next Move
1. 在 `bk7258_mb_uart_worker_start()` 的函数入口、`kthread_create()` 前后增加 boottrace，或直接对照历史可启动实现恢复 MB-UART worker 的创建时机、优先级和 affinity，重新构建烧录确认越过 `primary=37`。
2. NuttX 启动后收敛 CP 实验性诊断/即时 callback 改动，再依次验证 `NuttShell (NSH)`、按键震动、持续 AP log、heartbeat 和 `ap_console open`，保存日志及最终镜像哈希。

170: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
171:                                 int result, void *arg)
172: {
173:   uint8_t command;
174:   bool failed;
175: 
176:   (void)arg;
177:   /* The mailbox transport invokes completion callbacks while holding
178:    * g_bk7258_driver_lock.  Do not reacquire the non-recursive SMP lock here.
179:    */
180:   command = ack == NULL ? g_uart.transaction_command :
181:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);
182:   failed = result < 0 || !valid_ack(ack) ||
183:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
184: 
185:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))
186:     {
187:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
188:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
189:     }
190: 
191:   if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
192:     {
193:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
194:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
195:     }
196: 
197:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
198:     {
199:       if (!failed)
200:         {
201:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
202:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
203:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
204:         }
205:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
206:         {
207:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
208:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
209:            */
210: 
211:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
212:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
213:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
214:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
215:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
216:         }
217:       else
218:         {
219:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
220:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
221:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
222:             {
223:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
224:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
225:                */
226: 
227:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
228:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
229:             }
230:           else
231:             {
232:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
233:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
234:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
235:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
236:             }
237:         }
238: 
239:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
240:     }
241:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
242:     {
243:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
244:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
245:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
246:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
247:        */
248: 
249:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
250:     }
251: 
252:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
253:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
254: }

257:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
258: {
259:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
260:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
261:   uint16_t first;
262:   bool failed = false;
263:   bool malformed = false;
264: 
265:   (void)arg;
266:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
267:     {
268:       return -EINVAL;
269:     }
270: 
271:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
272:     {
273:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
274:       failed = true;
275:       malformed = true;
276:     }
277:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
278:     {
279:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
280:       failed = true;
281:       malformed = true;
282:     }
283:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
284:     {
285:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
286:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
287:       failed = true;
288:       malformed = true;
289:     }
290:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
291:     {
292:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
293:       failed = true;
294:       malformed = true;
295:     }
296: 
297:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
298:     {
299:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
300:         {
301:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
302:           failed = true;
303:           malformed = true;
304:         }
305:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
306:         {
307:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
308:           failed = true;
309:           malformed = true;
310:         }
311:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
312:         {
313:           failed = true;
314:         }
315:       else if (rx_free() < length)
316:         {
317:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
318:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
319:           failed = true;
320:         }
321:       else
322:         {
323:           const uint8_t *source =
324:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
325: 
326:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
327:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
328:           if (first > length)
329:             {
330:               first = length;
331:             }
332: 
333:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
334:           if (first != length)
335:             {
336:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
337:             }
338: 
339:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
340:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
341:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
342:         }
343:     }
344:   else if (!failed)
345:     {
346:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
347:         {
348:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
349:           failed = true;
350:           malformed = true;
351:         }
352:       else
353:         {
354:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (!malformed)
359:     {
360:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
361: 
362:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
363:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
364:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
365:         {
366:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
367:         }
368:     }
369: 
370:   update_local_rts();
371:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
372:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
373:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;

472: static int dispatch_locked(void)
473: {
474:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
475:   struct active_transaction *active;
476:   struct logical_channel *channel;
477:   unsigned int i;
478:   int ret;
479: 
480:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
481: 
482:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
483:     {
484:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
485:         {
486:           continue;
487:         }
488: 
489:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
490:       if (ret < 0)
491:         {
492:           return ret;
493:         }
494: 
495:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
496:     }
497: 
498:   if (g_reset_pending)
499:     {
500:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
501:       if (ret < 0)
502:         {
503:           return ret;
504:         }
505: 
506:       g_reset_pending = false;
507:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
508:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
509:     }
510: 
511:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
512:     {
513:       return OK;
514:     }
515: 
516:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
517:     {
518:       channel = &g_channels[i];
519:       if (!channel->queued)
520:         {
521:           continue;
522:         }
523: 
524:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
525:         {
526:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
527:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
528:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
529:             {
530:               active = &epoch->probe;
531:             }
532:           else
533:             {
534:               continue;
535:             }
536: 
537:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
538:               !epoch->replay)
539:             {
540:               return -ENOLINK;
541:             }
542:         }
543:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
544:         {
545:           active = &g_active;
546:           if (active->quarantine)
547:             {
548:               return -ENOLINK;
549:             }
550:         }
551:       else
552:         {
553:           return OK;
554:         }
555: 
556:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
557:         {
558:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
559:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
560:                  sizeof(active->message));
561:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
562:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
563:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
564:             g_channel_ids[i]);
565:         }
566: 
567:       active->callback = channel->callback;
568:       active->arg = channel->arg;
569:       active->channel_index = i;
570:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
571:       active->busy = true;
572:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
573:       if (ret < 0)
574:         {
575:           active->busy = false;
576:           return ret;
577:         }
578: 
579:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
580:         {
581:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
582:             {
583:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
584:             }
585: 
586:           g_probe_attempts++;
587:           g_stats.probes++;
588:         }
589: 
590:       return OK;
591:     }
592: 
593:   return OK;

596: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
597:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
598:   const struct active_transaction *active)
599: {
600:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
601:   uint32_t reason = 0;
602: 
603:   if (!active->busy)
604:     {
605:       return 1u;
606:     }
607: 
608:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
609:     {
610:       reason |= 2u;
611:     }
612:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
613:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
614:     {
615:       reason |= 4u;
616:     }
617:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
618:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
619:     {
620:       reason |= 8u;
621:     }
622:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
623:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
624:     {
625:       reason |= 16u;
626:     }
627: 
628:   return reason;
629: }

631: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
632: {
633:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
634:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
635:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
636: }

638: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
639: {
640:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
641:   struct active_transaction *active;
642:   bool replay;
643:   int result;
644:   uint32_t reason;
645: 
646: 
647:   active = busy_probe();
648:   if (active == NULL)
649:     {
650:       active = &g_active;
651:     }
652: 
653:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
654:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
655:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
656:   if (reason != 0)
657:     {
658:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
659:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
660:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
661:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
662:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
663:       return;
664:     }
665: 
666: 
667:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
668:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
669:     {
670:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
671: 
672:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
673:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
674:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
675:       return;
676:     }
677: 
678:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
679:     {
680:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
681:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
682:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
683:       return;
684:     }
685: 
686:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
687:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
688: 
689:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
690:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
691:     {
692:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
693:     }
694: 
695:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
696:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
697:   if (replay)
698:     {
699:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
700:       unsigned int i;
701: 
702:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
703:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
704:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
705:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
706:        */
707: 
708:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
709:       g_active.quarantine = false;
710:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
711:         {
712:           if (i != replay_index)
713:             {
714:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
715:             }
716:         }
717: 
718:       select_recovery_epoch();
719:       (void)dispatch_locked();
720:       return;
721:     }
722: 
723:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
724: 
725:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
726:     {
727:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
728:         {
729:           release_recovery_slots();
730:           g_recovery_index = 0;
731:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
732:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
733:         }
734:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
735:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
736:         {
737:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
738:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
739:            */
740:         }
741:       else
742:         {
743:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
744:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
745:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
746:         }
747:     }
748: 
749:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
750:            result < 0)
751:     {
752:       begin_abort(result);
753:     }
754: 
755:   (void)dispatch_locked();
756: }

758: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
759: {
760:   struct ack_slot *slot;
761:   unsigned int rx_index;
762:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
763:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
764:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
765:   uint8_t state = 0;
766:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
767: 
768:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
769: 
770:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
771:     {
772:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
773:       if (slot == NULL)
774:         {
775:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
776:           return -EAGAIN;
777:         }
778:     }
779:   else
780:     {
781:       slot = NULL;
782:     }
783: 
784:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
785:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
786:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
787:     {
788:       g_stats.bad_header++;
789:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
790:     }
791:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
792:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
793:     {
794:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
795:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
796:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
797:         {
798:           if (slot != NULL)
799:             {
800:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
801:             }
802: 
803:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
804:           return -EAGAIN;
805:         }
806:       else if (ret < 0)
807:         {
808:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
809:         }
810:     }
811:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
812:     {
813:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
814:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
815:         {
816:           if (slot != NULL)
817:             {
818:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
819:             }
820: 
821:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
822:           return -EAGAIN;
823:         }
824:       else if (ret < 0)
825:         {
826:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
827:         }
828:     }
829:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
830:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||

832:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
833:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
834:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
835:     {
836:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
837:       ack_flags = 2u;
838:       ret = OK;
839:     }
840:   else
841:     {
842:       g_stats.unsupported++;
843:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
844:     }
845: 
846:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
