107: void __attribute__((noinline, target("general-regs-only")))
108: bk7258_cpu_private_initialize(bool primary)
109: {
110:   const size_t region_count = sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
111:                               sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]);
112: 
113:   if (!primary)
114:     {
115:       arm_fpuconfig();
116:     }
117: 
118:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
119:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
120:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
121:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
122:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
123:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
124:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
125:   UP_DSB();
126:   UP_ISB();
127: 
128:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
129:   UP_DSB();
130:   UP_ISB();
131: 
132: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
133:   {
134:     const uint32_t hardware_regions =
135:       (getreg32(MPU_TYPE) & MPU_TYPE_DREGION_MASK) >>
136:       MPU_TYPE_DREGION_SHIFT;
137: 
138:     if (hardware_regions < region_count)
139:       {
140:         for (; ; )
141:           {
142:             __asm__ volatile("wfi");
143:           }
144:       }
145: 
146:     mpu_reset();
147:     mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions, region_count, false, true);
148: 
149:   }
150: #endif
151: 
152:   (void)primary;
153: }
154: 
155: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
156:                            target("general-regs-only")))
157: bk7258_start(void)
158: {
159:   const uint8_t *src;
160:   uint8_t *dest;
161: 
162:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_C);
163: 
164:   /* Configure the FPU before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use
165:    * it.  arm_fpuconfig() does not depend on BSS-backed synchronization.
166:    */
167: 
168:   arm_fpuconfig();
169:   UP_DSB();
170:   UP_ISB();
171:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_CPACR);
172: 
173:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
174:     {
175:       *dest++ = *src++;
176:     }
177: 
178:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_DATA);
179: 
180:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
181:     {
182:       *dest++ = 0;
183:     }
184: 
185:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_BSS);
186: 
187:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
188:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
189:     {
190:       *dest++ = *src++;
191:     }
192: 
193:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_VECTORS);
194: 
195: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
196:   bk7258_hwspinlock_initialize();
197: #endif
198:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_SPINLOCK);
199:   bk7258_cpu_private_initialize(true);
200:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_PRIVATE);
201:   arm_initialize_stack();
202: 
203:   /* Install the buffered AP log channel before normal NuttX startup. */
204:   (void)bk7258_syslog_initialize();
205: 
206: #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
207:   arm_earlyserialinit();
208: #endif
209: 
210:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PRIMARY_NXSTART);
211:   nx_start();
212:   for (; ; )
213:     {
214:     }
215: }
216: 
217: void __attribute__((naked, noreturn, section(".start_text"))) __start(void)
218: {
219:   __asm__ volatile
220:     (
221:       "cpsid i\n"
222:       "movs r0, #0\n"
223:       "ldr r1, =0x20000000\n"
224:       "str r0, [r1]\n"
225:       "ldr r1, =0x2800ffe0\n"
226:       "ldr r2, =0x41505452\n"
227:       "str r2, [r1]\n"
228:       "movs r2, #1\n"
229:       "str r2, [r1, #4]\n"
230:       "movs r2, #0\n"
231:       "str r2, [r1, #8]\n"
232:       "str r2, [r1, #12]\n"
233:       "str r2, [r1, #16]\n"
234:       "str r2, [r1, #20]\n"
235:       "str r2, [r1, #24]\n"
236:       "str r2, [r1, #28]\n"
237:       "dmb sy\n"
238:       "ldr r0, =__idle_stack_base\n"
239:       "msr msplim, r0\n"
240:       "b bk7258_start\n"
241:     );
242: }

261: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
262:                      uint32_t *order)
263: {
264:   uint32_t wire[2];
265:   int ret;
266: 
267:   *order = ++g_send_order;
268:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
269:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
270:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
271:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
272:   if (ret == OK)
273:     {
274:       g_stats.tx++;
275:     }
276:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
277:     {
278:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
279:     }
280: 
281:   if (ret < 0)
282:     {
283:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
284:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
285:         (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
286:         ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
287:         ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
288:         ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
289:     }
290: 
291:   return ret;
292: }

329: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
330:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
331:                                  int result)
332: {
333:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
334: 
335:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
336:     {
337:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
338:       channel->queued = false;
339:       channel->result = result;
340:     }
341: 
342:   active->busy = false;
343:   if (result == OK)
344:     {
345:       release_acks_before(active->order);
346:     }
347: 
348:   if (active->callback != NULL)
349:     {
350:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
351:     }
352: }

365:           channel->result = result;

367:             {

369:             }
370:         }
371:     }

385: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
386: {
387:   unsigned int i;
388:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
389: 
390:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
391:     {
392:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
393:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
394:         {
395:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
396:           g_recovery_index = i;
397:           break;
398:         }
399:     }
400: 
401:   if (epoch == NULL)
402:     {
403:       uint32_t newest = 0;
404: 
405:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
406:         {
407:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
408:             {
409:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
410:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
411:               g_recovery_index = i;
412:             }
413:         }
414: 
415:       epoch->replay = true;
416:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
417:     }
418:   else
419:     {
420:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
421:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
422:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
423:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
424:     }
425: 
426:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
427:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
428:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
429:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
430:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
431: }

433: static void begin_abort(int result)
434: {
435:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
436: 
437:   if (g_active.busy)
438:     {
439:       g_active.quarantine = true;
440:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
441:     }
442: 
443:   if (probe != NULL)
444:     {
445:       probe->quarantine = true;
446:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
447:     }
448: 
449:   fail_pending(result);
450:   g_probe_requested = false;
451:   select_recovery_epoch();
452: }

455: {
456:   unsigned int i;
457: 
458:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
459:     {
460:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
461:         {

466:

471: static int dispatch_locked(void)
472: {
473:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
474:   struct active_transaction *active;
475:   struct logical_channel *channel;
476:   unsigned int i;
477:   int ret;
478: 
479:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
480: 
481:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
482:     {
483:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
484:         {
485:           continue;
486:         }
487: 
488:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
489:       if (ret < 0)
490:         {
491:           return ret;
492:         }
493: 
494:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
495:     }
496: 
497:   if (g_reset_pending)
498:     {
499:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
500:       if (ret < 0)
501:         {
502:           return ret;
503:         }
504: 
505:       g_reset_pending = false;
506:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
507:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
508:     }
509: 
510:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
511:     {
512:       return OK;
513:     }
514: 
515:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
516:     {
517:       channel = &g_channels[i];
518:       if (!channel->queued)
519:         {
520:           continue;
521:         }
522: 
523:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
524:         {
525:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
526:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
527:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
528:             {
529:               active = &epoch->probe;
530:             }
531:           else
532:             {
533:               continue;
534:             }
535: 
536:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
537:               !epoch->replay)
538:             {
539:               return -ENOLINK;
540:             }
541:         }
542:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
543:         {
544:           active = &g_active;
545:           if (active->quarantine)
546:             {
547:               return -ENOLINK;
548:             }
549:         }
550:       else
551:         {
552:           return OK;
553:         }
554: 
555:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
556:         {
557:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
558:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
559:                  sizeof(active->message));
560:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
561:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
562:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
563:             g_channel_ids[i]);
564:         }
565: 
566:       active->callback = channel->callback;
567:       active->arg = channel->arg;
568:       active->channel_index = i;
569:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
570:       active->busy = true;
571:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
572:       if (ret < 0)
573:         {
574:           active->busy = false;
575:           return ret;
576:         }
577: 
578:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
579:         {
580:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
581:             {
582:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
583:             }
584: 
585:           g_probe_attempts++;
586:           g_stats.probes++;
587:         }
588: 
589:       return OK;
590:     }
591: 
592:   return OK;
593: }

595: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
596:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
597:   const struct active_transaction *active)
598: {
599:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
600:   uint32_t reason = 0;
601: 
602:   if (!active->busy)
603:     {
604:       return 1u;
605:     }
606: 
607:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
608:     {
609:       reason |= 2u;
610:     }
611:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
612:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
613:     {
614:       reason |= 4u;
615:     }
616:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
617:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
618:     {
619:       reason |= 8u;
620:     }
621:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
622:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
623:     {
624:       reason |= 16u;
625:     }
626: 
627:   return reason;
628: }

630: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
631: {
632:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
633:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
634:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
635: }
636: 
637: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
638: {
639:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
640:   struct active_transaction *active;
641:   bool replay;
642:   int result;
643:   uint32_t reason;
644: 
645: 
646:   active = busy_probe();
647:   if (active == NULL)
648:     {
649:       active = &g_active;
650:     }
651: 
652:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
653:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
654:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
655:   if (reason != 0)
656:     {
657:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
658:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
659:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
660:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
661:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
662:       return;
663:     }
664: 
665: 
666:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
667:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
668:     {
669:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
670: 
671:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
672:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
673:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
674:       return;
675:     }
676: 
677:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
678:     {
679:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
680:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
681:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
682:       return;
683:     }
684: 
685:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
686:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
687: 
688:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
689:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
690:     {
691:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
692:     }
693: 
694:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
695:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
696:   if (replay)
697:     {
698:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
699:       unsigned int i;
700: 
701:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
702:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
703:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
704:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
705:        */
706: 
707:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
708:       g_active.quarantine = false;
709:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
710:         {
711:           if (i != replay_index)
712:             {
713:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
714:             }
715:         }
716: 
717:       select_recovery_epoch();
718:       (void)dispatch_locked();
719:       return;
720:     }

802:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
803:           return -EAGAIN;
804:         }
805:       else if (ret < 0)
806:         {
807:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
808:         }

170: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
171:                                 int result, void *arg)
172: {
173:   uint8_t command;
174:   bool failed;
175: 
176:   (void)arg;
177:   /* The mailbox transport invokes completion callbacks while holding
178:    * g_bk7258_driver_lock.  Do not reacquire the non-recursive SMP lock here.
179:    */
180:   command = ack == NULL ? g_uart.transaction_command :
181:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);
182:   failed = result < 0 || !valid_ack(ack) ||
183:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
184: 
185:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))
186:     {
187:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
188:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
189:     }
190: 
191:   if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
192:     {
193:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
194:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
195:     }
196: 
197:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
198:     {
199:       if (!failed)
200:         {
201:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
202:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
203:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
204:         }
205:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
206:         {
207:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
208:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
209:            */
210: 
211:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
212:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
213:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
214:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
215:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
216:         }
217:       else
218:         {
219:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
220:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
221:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
222:             {
223:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
224:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
225:                */
226: 
227:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
228:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
229:             }
230:           else
231:             {
232:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
233:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
234:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
235:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
236:             }
237:         }
238: 
239:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
240:     }
241:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
242:     {
243:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
244:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
245:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
246:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
247:        */
248: 
249:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
250:     }
251: 
252:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
253:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
254: }

256: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
257:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
258: {
259:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
260:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
261:   uint16_t first;
262:   bool failed = false;
263:   bool malformed = false;
264: 
265:   (void)arg;
266:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
267:     {
268:       return -EINVAL;
269:     }
270: 
271:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
272:     {
273:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
274:       failed = true;
275:       malformed = true;
276:     }
277:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
278:     {
279:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
280:       failed = true;
281:       malformed = true;
282:     }
283:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
284:     {
285:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
286:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
287:       failed = true;
288:       malformed = true;
289:     }
290:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
291:     {
292:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
293:       failed = true;
294:       malformed = true;
295:     }
296: 
297:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
298:     {
299:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
300:         {
301:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
302:           failed = true;
303:           malformed = true;
304:         }
305:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
306:         {
307:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
308:           failed = true;
309:           malformed = true;
310:         }
311:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
312:         {
313:           failed = true;
314:         }
315:       else if (rx_free() < length)
316:         {
317:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
318:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
319:           failed = true;
320:         }
321:       else
322:         {
323:           const uint8_t *source =
324:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
325: 
326:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
327:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
328:           if (first > length)
329:             {
330:               first = length;
331:             }
332: 
333:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
334:           if (first != length)
335:             {
336:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
337:             }
338: 
339:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
340:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
341:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
342:         }
343:     }
344:   else if (!failed)
345:     {
346:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
347:         {
348:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
349:           failed = true;
350:           malformed = true;
351:         }
352:       else
353:         {
354:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (!malformed)
359:     {
360:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
361: 
362:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
363:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
364:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
365:         {
366:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
367:         }
368:     }
369: 
370:   update_local_rts();
371:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
372:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
373:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
374: }

376: static int send_state_locked(void)
377: {
378:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
379:   int ret;
380: 
381:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
382:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_STATE, 0, 0, 0,
383:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
384:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
385:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
386:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
387:   if (ret == OK)
388:     {
389:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
390:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_STATE;
391:       g_uart.state_pending = false;
392:       g_uart.stats.state_tx++;
393:     }
394: 
395:   return ret;
396: }
397: 
398: static int send_data_locked(void)
399: {
400:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
401:   uint8_t *destination =
402:     (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
403:   uint16_t length = tx_count();
404:   uint16_t first;
405:   int ret;
406: 
407:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
408:     {
409:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
410:     }
411: 
412:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)
413:     {
414:       return -EAGAIN;
415:     }
416: 
417:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
418:   if (first > length)
419:     {
420:       first = length;
421:     }
422: 
423:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
424:   if (first != length)
425:     {
426:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
427:     }
428: 
429:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
430:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
431:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
432:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
433:   message.payload_length = length;
434:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
435:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
436:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
437:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
438:   if (ret == OK)
439:     {
440:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
441:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
442:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
443:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
444:     }
445: 
446:   return ret;
447: }

449: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
450: {
451:   int ret;
452: 
453:   (void)argc;
454:   (void)argv;
455:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
456:   if (ret < 0)
457:     {
458:       return -EXDEV;
459:     }
460: 
461:   for (;;)
462:     {
463:       bk7258_mb_uart_callback_t callback;
464:       void *callback_arg;
465:       irqstate_t flags;
466: 
467:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
468:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
469:       nxsem_reset(&g_uart.worker_sem, 0);
470:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
471: 
472:       if (!g_uart.transaction_busy)
473:         {
474:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
475: 
476:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
477:             {
478:               (void)send_state_locked();
479:             }
480:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
481:             {
482:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
483:                 {
484:                   (void)send_state_locked();
485:                 }
486:               else
487:                 {
488:                   (void)send_data_locked();
489:                 }
490:             }
491:         }
492: 
493:       callback = g_uart.callback;
494:       callback_arg = g_uart.callback_arg;
495:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
496: 
497:       if (callback != NULL)
498:         {
499:           callback(callback_arg);
500:         }
501:     }
502: 
503:   return OK;
504: }

506: void bk7258_mbox_uart_early_init(void)
507: {
508:   /* The zero-initialized TX ring accepts bounded early logs before MBOX0 is
509:    * available.  Full rings return an accurate short write.
510:    */
511: }

513: int bk7258_mb_uart_init(void)
514: {
515:   int ret;
516: 
517:   if (g_uart.initialized)
518:     {
519:       return OK;
520:     }
521: 
522:   /* Keep early TX data and its indices. */
523: 
524:   g_uart.rx_read = 0;
525:   g_uart.rx_write = 0;
526:   g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
527:   g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
528:   g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
529:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
530:   g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_STATE;
531:   g_uart.state_pending = true;
532:   g_uart.local_rts = false;
533:   g_uart.upper_rts = false;
534:   g_uart.peer_rts = false;
535:   g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
536:   memset(&g_uart.stats, 0, sizeof(g_uart.stats));
537:   nxsem_init(&g_uart.worker_sem, 0, 0);
538:   g_worker_created = false;
539:   g_worker_pid = -1;
540: 
541:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_register_rx(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX,
542:                                     mb_uart_receive, NULL);
543:   if (ret < 0)
544:     {
545:       return ret;
546:     }
547:   g_uart.initialized = true;
548:   return OK;
549: }

551: int bk7258_mb_uart_worker_start(void)
552: {
553:   int ret;
554: 
555:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_UART_WORKER_ENTER);
556: 
557:   if (!g_uart.initialized)
558:     {
559:       return -EAGAIN;
560:     }
561: 
562:   if (!g_worker_created)
563:     {
564:       bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_UART_CREATE_ENTER);
565:       /* Early console writes may have posted before this worker existed.
566:        * Collapse those stale wakeups; the TX ring and state_pending retain
567:        * all work that must actually be processed. */
568: 
569:       nxsem_reset(&g_uart.worker_sem, 0);
570:       ret = kthread_create("mb-uart0", MB_UART_PRIORITY, 2048,
571:                            mb_uart_worker, NULL);
572:       if (ret < 0)
573:         {
574:           return ret;
575:         }
576: 
577:       bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_UART_CREATE_RETURN);
578:       g_worker_created = true;
579:       g_worker_pid = ret;
580:     }
581: 
582:   return OK;
583: }

585: int bk7258_mb_uart_worker_activate(void)
586: {
587:   struct sched_param param;
588: 
589:   if (!g_worker_created || g_worker_pid < 0)
590:     {
591:       return -EAGAIN;
592:     }
593: 
594:   param.sched_priority = MB_UART_PRIORITY;
595:   return sched_setparam(g_worker_pid, &param) < 0 ? -errno : OK;
596: }

633: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
634: {
635:   irqstate_t flags;
636:   uint16_t available;
637:   uint16_t written;
638:   uint16_t first;
639: 
640:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)
641:     {
642:       return -EINVAL;
643:     }
644: 
645:   if (length == 0)
646:     {
647:       return 0;
648:     }
649: 
650:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
651:   available = tx_free();
652:   written = length > available ? available : length;
653:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
654:   if (first > written)
655:     {
656:       first = written;
657:     }
658: 
659:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
660:   if (first != written)
661:     {
662:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
663:     }
664: 
665:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
666:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
667:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
668:   if (written < length)
669:     {
670:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
671:     }
672: 
673:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
674:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
675:     {
676:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
677:     }
678: 
679:   return written;
680: }

682: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_read(uint8_t *data, size_t length,
683:                               unsigned int *status)
684: {
685:   irqstate_t flags;
686:   uint16_t available;
687:   uint16_t count;
688:   uint16_t first;
689: 
690:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
691:     {
692:       return -EINVAL;
693:     }
694: 
695:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
696:   available = rx_count();
697:   count = length > available ? available : length;
698:   first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_read;
699:   if (first > count)
700:     {
701:       first = count;
702:     }
703: 
704:   memcpy(data, &g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_read], first);
705:   if (first != count)
706:     {
707:       memcpy(data + first, g_uart.rx_ring, count - first);
708:     }
709: 
710:   g_uart.rx_read = (g_uart.rx_read + count) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
711:   if (status != NULL)
712:     {
713:       *status = g_uart.sticky_status;
714:       g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
715:     }
716: 
717:   if (!g_uart.upper_rts && g_uart.local_rts &&
718:       rx_count() < MB_UART_RTS_RELEASE)
719:     {
720:       update_local_rts();
721:     }
722: 
723:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
724:   if (g_uart.initialized && count != 0)
725:     {
726:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
727:     }
728: 
729:   return count;
730: }

781: int bk7258_mbox_uart_flush(unsigned int timeout_ms)
782: {
783:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
784: 
785:   if (!g_uart.initialized || !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
786:     {
787:       return -EAGAIN;
788:     }
789: 
790:   while (!bk7258_mbox_uart_txempty())
791:     {
792:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
793:         {
794:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
795:         }
796: 
797:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
798:     }
799: 
800:   return OK;
801: }

803: void bk7258_mbox_uart_dump_stats(void)
804: {
805:   irqstate_t flags;
806:   struct mb_uart_stats stats;
807:   uint16_t tx;
808:   uint16_t rx;
809:   bool local_rts;
810:   bool peer_rts;
811: 
812:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
813:   stats = g_uart.stats;
814:   tx = tx_count();
815:   rx = rx_count();
816:   local_rts = g_uart.local_rts;
817:   peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
818:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
819: 
820:   printf("mb-uart0: txq=%u rxq=%u rts=%u cts=%u data=%lu/%lu "
821:          "state=%lu/%lu short=%lu overflow=%lu bad=%lu/%lu/%lu/%lu/%lu "
822:          "remote=%lu retry=%lu/%lu unknown=%lu reset=%lu\n",

290: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
291: {
292:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
293:   struct pwc_message message;
294:   unsigned int next;
295: 
296:   if (bytes == NULL)
297:     {
298:       return -EINVAL;

301:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
302:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
303:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
304: 
305:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
306:   if (next == g_tail)
307:     {
308:       return -EAGAIN;
309:     }
310: 
311:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
312:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
313:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
314:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
315:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
316:   g_head = next;
317:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
318:   return OK;

321: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
322: {

326:   (void)argv;

329:   /* bk7258_mailbox_workers_start() pinned the bring-up thread to CPU0.

331:    * running PWC worker's affinity here is redundant and can trigger another

333: 
334:   g_worker_result = OK;
335:   g_worker_ready = true;
336:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_READY);
337:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);

342:       irqstate_t flags;
343: 
344:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
345:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
346:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
347:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
348:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
350:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
351:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
352: 
353:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();

355:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)

358:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
359:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
360:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
361:               {
362:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
363:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
364:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
365:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
366:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
367:               }
368:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
369:             break;
370: 
371:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
372:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
373:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
374:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
375:               {
376:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
377:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
378:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
379:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
380:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
381:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
382:               }
383:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
384:             break;
385: 
386: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
387:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
388:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
389:               {
390:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
391:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
392:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
393:                 if (ret != OK)
394:                   {

396:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
397:                   }
398:               }
399:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
400:               {
401:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
402: 
403:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
404:               }

406: 
407:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:

411:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
412:             {

428:                 }
429:             }

431: #endif
432: 
433:           default:
434:             break;

436:     }
437:   return 0;

1188: int bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(unsigned int timeout_ms)
1189: {
1190:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1191:   clock_t next_probe = clock_systime_ticks();
1192: 
1193:   while (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1194:     {
1195:       clock_t now = clock_systime_ticks();
1196: 
1197:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
1198:         {
1199:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1200:         }
1201: 
1202:       /* Keep the boot-time probe self-starting even if the initial
1203:        * ABORTING -> PROBING worker wakeup was consumed before RESET was
1204:        * dispatched.  This only marks STATE pending; normal transaction
1205:        * serialization remains in the mailbox workers. */
1206:       if ((int32_t)(now - next_probe) >= 0)
1207:         {
1208:           /* The TX worker can complete STATE between the loop condition and
1209:            * this retry point.  Do not reopen a link that has just become
1210:            * ready. */
1211:           if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1212:             {
1213:               bk7258_mailbox_start_probe();

414: 
415: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)

396: 		{

404: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);

406: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) ==
407: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON;
408: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
409: 				!power_voted)
410: 			{
411: 				ret = ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
412: 				goto rollback;
413: 			}
414: 
415: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
416: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
417: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
418: 			reset_forward_log_status();
419: 			#endif
420: 
421: 			start_cpu1_core();
422: 
423: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
424: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
425: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
426: 			{
427: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
428: 				{
429: 					break;
430: 				}
431: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
432: 				rtos_delay_milliseconds(1);
433: 			}
434: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
435: 			{
436: 				LOGE("CPU1 boot timeout\r\n");
437: 				ret = BK_ERR_TIMEOUT;
438: 				goto rollback;
439: 			}
440: 		}
441: 	}
442: 	return BK_OK;
443:

177: ## 3. 正确构建链条
178: 
179: 最终固件链条固定为：
180: 
181: ```text
182: OpenVela nuttx.bin
183:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
184:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
185:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
186:   -> package/all-app.bin
187: 
188: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
189:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
190: ```
191: 
192: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
193: 
194: - `ram_regions.csv`
195: - AP/CP `config`
196: - Kconfig 默认值
197: - 分区生成脚本
198: - SoC 链接脚本
199: 
200: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
201: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
202: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
203: 
204: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
205: 
206: ```bash
207: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
208: ./build.sh \
209:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
210:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
211: 
212: cp \
213:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
214:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
215: ```
216: 
217: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
218: 
219: ```bash
220: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
221: make -C projects/app_ab clean
222: 
223: podman run --rm \
224:   --userns=keep-id \
225:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \

303: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
304: 
305: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
306: 
307: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
308: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
309: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
310: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
311: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
312: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
313: 
314: 本覆盖中的CP `0x7`协议要求request `param3=PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1`；response `param1`回显
315: ON/OFF state、`param2`返回真实PSRAM driver结果、`param3`回显version。CP BOOT与
316: OpenVela使用独立owner，初始化失败不置owner bit。`0xc`已提供frequency/divider、
317: speed、voltage、CPU power/reset和PSRAM owner只读诊断；device ID和actual capacity
318: 仍未暴露，因此alias probe和整颗器件实板测试仍是容量门禁。AP board必须同步发送
319: V1 version并检查真实ret/version后才能联调；本CP侧任务未修改AP board代码。
320: 
321: 本轮已放弃 SMP，PWC 现行摘要保留 PSRAM V1 `0x7` 和
322: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5`；`0x5` 只解除 CP boot worker 等待，不应解释为 SMP
323: commit。`PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 及其 PSRAM/clock/SMP commit 契约已废弃，不再是
324: 现行必需协议；相关设计、联调结论和当时产物 hash 仅见
325: `BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md` 第 15 节历史记录。正常 recovery 的 INIT/拒绝会
326: 取消 shutdown 并恢复 boot vote；只有 FINISH 才进入 shutdown。CP 不实现 runtime
327: DVFS/P1，也不在 recovery INIT 路径直接停止 CPU2。

169: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
170: {
171:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
172:   struct pwc_message message;
173:   unsigned int next;
174: 
175:   if (bytes == NULL)
176:     {
177:       return -EINVAL;
178:     }
179: 
180:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks with interrupts disabled.
181:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section.
182:    */
183: 
184:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
185:   if (next == g_tail)
186:     {
187:       return -EAGAIN;
188:     }
189: 
190:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
191:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
192:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
193:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
194:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
195:   g_head = next;
196:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
197:   return OK;
198: }

200: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
201: {
202:   int ret = OK;
203: 
204:   (void)argc;
205:   (void)argv;
206: 
207:   g_worker_result = OK;
208:   g_worker_ready = true;
209:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
210: 
211:   for (;;)
212:     {
213:       struct pwc_message message;
214:       irqstate_t flags;
215: 
216:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
217:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
218:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
219:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
220:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
221:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
222:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
223:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
224: 
225:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
226:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
227:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
228:         {
229:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
230:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
231:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
232:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
233:               {
234:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
235:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
236:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
237:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
238:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
239:               }
240:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
241:             break;
242: 
243: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
244:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
245:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
246:               {
247:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
248:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
249:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
250:                 if (ret != OK)
251:                   {
252:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
253:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
254:                   }
255:               }
256:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
257:               {
258:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
259: 
260:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
261:               }
262:             break;
263: 
264:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
265:             bk7258_psram_dump();
266:             break;
267: 
268:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
269:             {

271: 
272:               ret = pwc_send_wait(
273:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
274:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
275:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
276:               if (ret != OK)
277:                 {
278:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
279:                 }
280:             }
281:             break;
282: #endif
283: 
284:           default:
285:             break;
286:         }
287:     }
288:   return 0;
289: }

53: #define AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MAX    3
54: #define AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MS     10
55: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RX         0x01
56: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX         0x02
57: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_MODE       0x04
58: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN       0x08
59: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET      0x10
60: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT    0x20
61: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_READY      0x40
62: #define AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_SYSTEM     0x80
63: #define AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL        (AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART | \
64: 				    AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)
65: #define AP_BRIDGE_MODE_TIMEOUT_MS  200

74: 	u16 tx_wr;

76: 	volatile u8 link_ready;
77: 	volatile u8 output_mode;

79: 	volatile u8 ready_flags;
80: 	volatile u8 ready_set;
81: 	volatile u8 ready_clear;
82: 	volatile u32 mode_generation;
83: 	volatile u32 mode_applied_generation;
84: 	u32 last_down_log_ms;
85: 	ap_console_bridge_stats_t stats;

129: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN);
130: 		ap_console_bridge_ready_update(AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART, false);

134: static void ap_bridge_log_output(const u8 *line, u16 length, bool prefix_line)
135: {
136: 	static const u8 prefix[] = "ap0: ";
137: 	u8 output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
138: 	u16 output_length;
139: 	u8 retry;
140: 
141: 	output_length = 0;
142: 	if (prefix_line)
143: 	{
144: 		memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
145: 		output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1;
146: 	}
147: 	memcpy(output + output_length, line, length);
148: 	output_length += length;
149: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
150: 	{
151: 		if (shell_log_raw_data_nonblock(output, output_length))
152: 			return;
153: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MS);
154: 	}
155: 	s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
156: }

158: static u16 ap_bridge_tx_count(void)
159: {
160: 	if (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd <= s_ap_bridge.tx_wr)
161: 		return s_ap_bridge.tx_wr - s_ap_bridge.tx_rd;
162: 	return sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring) - (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd - s_ap_bridge.tx_wr);
163: }

165: static void ap_bridge_drain_tx(void)
166: {
167: 	u8 data[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
168: 	u16 count;
169: 	u16 length;
170: 	u16 written;
171: 	u16 i;
172: 
173: 	while (s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
174: 	{
175: 		rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
176: 		count = ap_bridge_tx_count();
177: 		if (!count)
178: 		{
179: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
180: 			break;
181: 		}
182: 		length = MIN(count, (u16)sizeof(data));
183: 		length = MIN(length, bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0));
184: 		if (!length)
185: 		{
186: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
187: 			break;
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		for (i = 0; i < length; i++)
191: 			data[i] = s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[(s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + i) %
192: 							 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring)];
193: 
194: 		written = bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, data, length);
195: 		if (!written)
196: 		{
197: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
198: 			break;
199: 		}
200: 		if (written < length)
201: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_partial++;
202: 
203: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
204: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
205: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
206: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
207: 	}
208: }

210: static void ap_bridge_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
211: {
212: 	u8 input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
213: 	u8 line[AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
214: 	u16 line_length = 0;
215: 	u8 active_mode = AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG;
216: 	bool line_continues = false;
217: 
218: 	(void)arg;
219: 	for (;;)
220: 	{
221: 		u32 events;
222: 		u32 flags;
223: 		u16 input_length;
224: 		u16 index;
225: 		u8 ready_set;
226: 		u8 ready_clear;
227: 		u8 ready_before;
228: 		bk_err_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem,
229: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);
230: 
231: 		bk_mb_uart_poll(MB_UART0);
232: 
233: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
234: 		events = s_ap_bridge.events;
235: 		s_ap_bridge.events = 0;
236: 		ready_set = s_ap_bridge.ready_set;
237: 		ready_clear = s_ap_bridge.ready_clear;
238: 		ready_before = s_ap_bridge.ready_flags;
239: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_set = 0;
240: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_clear = 0;
241: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
242: 
243: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
244: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
245: 		{
246: 			ready_clear |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
247: 		}
248: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= ready_set;
249: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~ready_clear;
250: 		/* poll() may complete recovery in the same iteration that consumes an
251: 		 * older timeout/reset event.  The driver's current state is the final
252: 		 * authority for the MBUART gate, so a stale event cannot clear a newer
253: 		 * READY notification permanently.
254: 		 */
255: 		if (bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
256: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
257: 		else
258: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
259: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready =
260: 			(s_ap_bridge.ready_flags & AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL) ==
261: 			AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL && bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0);
262: 
263: 		if (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation !=
264: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_generation)
265: 		{
266: 			if (line_length)
267: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
268: 			line_length = 0;
269: 			line_continues = false;
270: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.requested_mode;
271: 			s_ap_bridge.output_mode = active_mode;
272: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation =
273: 				s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
274: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
275: 		}
276: 
277: 		do
278: 		{
279: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
280: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
281: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
282: 			{
283: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data_nonblock(input, input_length))
284: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
285: 				continue;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
289: 			{
290: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
291: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
292: 				{
293: 					bool complete = input[index] == '\n';
294: 
295: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length,
296: 							     !line_continues);
297: 					line_length = 0;
298: 					line_continues = !complete;
299: 				}
300: 			}
301: 		} while (input_length != 0);
302: 
303: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
304: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
305: 		{
306: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
307: 			line_length = 0;
308: 			line_continues = true;
309: 		}
310: 
311: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
312: 
313: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
314: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
315: 		{
316: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
317: 
318: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
319: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
320: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
321: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
322: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
323: 			if ((ready_before & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC |
324: 					     AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) ==
325: 				(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC) &&
326: 				(u32)(now - s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms) >= 1000)
327: 			{
328: 				s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms = now;
329: 				BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG,
330: 					"link down event=%x queued=%u ready=%x\r\n",
331: 					events, ap_bridge_tx_count(),
332: 					s_ap_bridge.ready_flags);
333: 			}
334: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
335: 		}
336: 	}
337: }

339: bk_err_t ap_console_bridge_init(void)
340: {
341: 	bk_err_t ret;
342: 
343: 	memset(&s_ap_bridge, 0, sizeof(s_ap_bridge));
344: 	ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX, 0, 0);
345: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
346: 		return ret;
347: 	ret = rtos_init_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
348: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
349: 		goto init_fail_vote;
350: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem, 1);
351: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
352: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
353: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem, 1);
354: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
355: 		goto init_fail_sem;
356: 
357: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread,
358: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
359: 					 "ap_console", ap_bridge_task, 3072, NULL);
360: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
361: 	{
362: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
363: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
364: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
365: 	}
366: 
367: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
368: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
369: 	{
370: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread);
371: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
372: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
373: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
374: 	}
375: 
376: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_bridge_mb_rx, NULL);
377: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
378: 		ret = bk_mb_uart_register_tx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_bridge_mb_tx, NULL);
379: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
380: 		ret = bk_mb_uart_register_event_callback(MB_UART0, ap_bridge_mb_event, NULL);
381: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
382: 	{
383: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
384: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread);
385: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
386: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
387: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RX | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
391: 	BK_LOGI(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "init owner=MB_UART0 tx_ring=%u mode=LOG\r\n",
392: 		(unsigned)sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring));
393: 	return BK_OK;
394: 
395: init_fail_sem:
396: 	rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
397: init_fail_mutex:
398: 	rtos_deinit_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
399: init_fail_vote:
400: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX, 1, 0);
401: 	return ret;
402: }

404: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
405: {
406: 	u16 written = 0;
407: 
408: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
409: 		return 0;
410: 
411: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
412: 	while (written < length)
413: 	{
414: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
415: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
416: 			break;
417: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
418: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
419: 	}
420: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
421: 	if (written < length)
422: 	{
423: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
424: 	}
425: 	if (written)
426: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
427: 	return written;
428: }

430: void ap_console_bridge_purge_tx(void)
431: {
432: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
433: 	s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += ap_bridge_tx_count();
434: 	s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = s_ap_bridge.tx_wr;
435: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
436: }

438: bk_err_t ap_console_bridge_set_output_mode(ap_console_output_mode_t mode)
439: {
440: 	u32 generation;
441: 
442: 	if (mode > AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
443: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
444: 	s_ap_bridge.requested_mode = mode;
445: 	generation = ++s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
446: 	ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_MODE);
447: 	while (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation != generation)
448: 	{
449: 		if (rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem,
450: 				       AP_BRIDGE_MODE_TIMEOUT_MS) != BK_OK)
451: 			return BK_ERR_TIMEOUT;
452: 	}
453: 	return BK_OK;
454: }

461: void ap_console_bridge_get_stats(ap_console_bridge_stats_t *stats)
462: {
463: 	mb_chnl_diag_t diag;
464: 	mbox0_adapter_diag_t adapter;
465: 
466: 	if (!stats)
467: 		return;
468: 	*stats = s_ap_bridge.stats;
469: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
470: 	stats->tx_queued = ap_bridge_tx_count();
471: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
472: 	stats->mb_tx_free = bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0);
473: 	stats->mb_rx_ready = bk_mb_uart_read_ready(MB_UART0);
474: 	stats->mb_status = bk_mb_uart_get_status(MB_UART0);
475: 	stats->link_ready = ap_console_bridge_is_ready();
476: 	stats->output_mode = s_ap_bridge.output_mode;
477: 	stats->ready_flags = s_ap_bridge.ready_flags;
478: 	stats->transport_state = bk_mb_uart_get_link_state(MB_UART0);
479: 	bk_mailbox_get_diag(&adapter);
480: 	stats->bad_envelope = adapter.bad_sid + adapter.bad_length +
481: 		adapter.bad_alignment + adapter.bad_address +
482: 		adapter.descriptor_overflow;
483: 	if (mb_chnl_get_diag(MAILBOX_CPU1, &diag) == BK_OK)
484: 	{
485: 		stats->active_busy = diag.busy;
486: 		stats->active_channel = diag.logical_chnl;
487: 		stats->active_sequence = diag.sequence;
488: 		stats->active_command = diag.command;
489: 		stats->ack_retry = diag.ack_retry;
490: 		stats->ack_queue_full = diag.ack_queue_full;
491: 		stats->reset_bad = diag.reset_bad;
492: 	}
493: }

495: void ap_console_bridge_ready_update(ap_console_ready_flag_t flag, bool ready)
496: {
497: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
498: 
499: 	if (ready)
500: 	{
501: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_set |= flag;
502: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_clear &= ~flag;
503: 	}
504: 	else
505: 	{
506: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_clear |= flag;
507: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_set &= ~flag;
508: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready = 0;
509: 	}
510: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
511: 	if (ready && (flag & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) &&
512: 		!bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
513: 		bk_mb_uart_probe(MB_UART0);
514: 	ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_SYSTEM);
515: }

203: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
204: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)

208: 
209: 	if (data)
210: 	{
211: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
212: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
213: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
214: 			return false;
215: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
216: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
220: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
221: }

223: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
224: {
225: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
226: 
227: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
228: 
229: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
230: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
231: 
232: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
233: 	{
234: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
235: 	}
236: 	else
237: 	{
238: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
242: 	{
243: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
244: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
250: 	{
251: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
252: 		tx_fail = 1;
253: 
254: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
258: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
259: 	#endif
260: 
261: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
262: 
263: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
264: 
265: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
266: 	{
267: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
268: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
269: 	}
270: 	else
271: 	{
272: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
273: 
274: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
275: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
276: 
277: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
278: 		{
279: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
280: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
281: 		}
282: 		else
283: 		{
284: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
285: 
286: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
287: 			{
288: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
296: 
297: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
300: 	}

622: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
623: 
624: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
625: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
626: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
627: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
628: 	}
629: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
630: 	{
631: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
632: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
634: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
635: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
636: 
637: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
638: 
639: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
640: 	}
641: 	else
642: 	{
643: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
644: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
645: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
649: 	{
650: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
651: 		return;
652: 	}
653: 
654: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
655: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
656: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
657: 
658: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
659: 	{
660: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
661: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
662: 		return;
663: 	}
664: 	return;
665: }

667: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
668: {
669: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
670: 
671: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
672: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
673: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
674: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
675: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
676: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
677: 
678: 	/*
679: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
680: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
681: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
682: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
683: 	 */
684: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
685: 	{
686: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
687: 	}
688: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
689: 	{
690: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
691: 	}
692: }

694: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)

702: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
703: 
704: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
705: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
706: 
707: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
708: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
709: 
710: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
711: 
712: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
713: 	{
714: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
715: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
716: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
717: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
718: 
719: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
720: 
721: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
722: 		{
723: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
724: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
725: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
726: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
727: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
728: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
729: 
730: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
731: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
732: 			}
733: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
734: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
735: 			return ret_code;
736: 		}
737: 	}
738: 
739: 	return BK_OK;
740: }

745: {

749: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;

751: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;

756: #endif

775: 	/*
776: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,

795: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
796: /*
797:   * init logical chnanel module.
798:   * return:
799:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
800:   *     failed  : fail code.
801:   *
802:   */
803: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
804: {
805: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
806: 	int				i, j;
807: 
808: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
809: 
810: 	/*
811: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
812: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
813: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
814: 	 * can race here:
815: 	 *
816: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
817: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
818: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
819: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
820: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
821: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
822: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
823: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
824: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
825: 	 *
826: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
827: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
828: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
829: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
830: 	 */
831: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
832: 	{
833: 		return BK_OK;
834: 	}
835: 
836: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
837: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
838: 	{
839: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
840: 		return BK_OK;
841: 	}
842: 
843: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
844: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
845: 	ack_read = 0;
846: 	ack_write = 0;
847: 	ack_count = 0;
848: 	ack_sending = 0;
849: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
850: 	{
851: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
852: 
853: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
854: 
855: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
856: 
857: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
858: 		{
859: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
860: 		}
861: 	}
862: 
863: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
864: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
865: 	{
866: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
867: 		return ret_code;
868: 	}
869: 
870: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
871: 
872: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
873: 	{
874: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
875: 
876: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
880: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
881: 
882: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
883: 
884: 	return BK_OK;
885: }

153: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
154: {
155: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
156: 
157: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE
158: 	for (u16 i = 0; i < len; i++)
159: 	{
160: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
161: 	}
162: #endif
163: 
164: 	return (crc);
165: }

203: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
204: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)
205: {
206: 	if (uart_cmd->resvd || uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3)
207: 		return false;
208: 
209: 	if (data)
210: 	{
211: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
212: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
213: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
214: 			return false;
215: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
216: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
220: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
221: }

223: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
224: {
225: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
226: 
227: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
228: 
229: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
230: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
231: 
232: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
233: 	{
234: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
235: 	}
236: 	else
237: 	{
238: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
242: 	{
243: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
244: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
250: 	{
251: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
252: 		tx_fail = 1;
253: 
254: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
258: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
259: 	#endif
260: 
261: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
262: 
263: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
264: 
265: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
266: 	{
267: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
268: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
269: 	}
270: 	else
271: 	{
272: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
273: 
274: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
275: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
276: 
277: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
278: 		{
279: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
280: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
281: 		}
282: 		else
283: 		{
284: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
285: 
286: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
287: 			{
288: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
296: 
297: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
300: 	}
301: 
302: rx_isr_data_xit:
303: 
304: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
305: 	{
306: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
307: 	}
308: 
309: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
310: 
311: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
312: 
313: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
314: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
315: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
316: 	 */
317: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
318: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
319: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
320: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
321: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
323: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
324: 
325: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
326: 	{
327: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
328: 		{
329: 			/* trigger send! */
330: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
331: 		}
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	return;
335: }

337: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
338: {
339: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
340: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
341: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
342: 
343: 	if (!invalid)
344: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
345: 	else
346: 	{
347: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
348: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
352: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
353: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
354: 	 */
355: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
356: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
357: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
358: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
359: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
360: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
361: 
362: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
363: 	{
364: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
365: 		{
366: 			/* trigger send! */
367: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
368: 		}
369: 	}
370: 
371: 	return;
372: }

374: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
375: {
376: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
377: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
378: 	 */
379: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
380: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
381: 
382: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
383: 	{
384: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
385: 	}
386: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
387: 	{
388: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
389: 	}
390: 	else
391: 	{
392: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
393: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
394: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
395: 		 */
396: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
397: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
398: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
399: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
400: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
402: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
403: 	}
404: 
405: 	return;
406: }

408: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
409: {
410: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
411: 
412: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
413: 
414: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
415: 
416: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
417: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
418: 	{
419: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
420: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
421: 		return;
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
425: 
426: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
429: 	}
430: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
431: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = 1;
434: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
435: 	}
436: 	else
437: 	{
438: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
442: 	{
443: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
444: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
445: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
447: 	}
448: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
449: 	{
450: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
451: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
452: 		{
453: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
454: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
455: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
456: 			mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
457: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
458: 		}
459: 	}
460: 
461: 	if (tx_fail)
462: 	{
463: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
464: 		{
465: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
466: 			{
467: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
468: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
469: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
470: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
471: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
472: 			}
473: 			else
474: 			{
475: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
476: 			}
477: 		}
478: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
479: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
480: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
481: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
482: 		{
483: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
484: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
485: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
486: 		}
487: 		else
488: 		{
489: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
491: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
492: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
493: 		}
494: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
495: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
496: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
497: 		return;
498: 	}
499: 
500: 	/* try next Tx. */
501: 
502: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
503: 
504: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
505: 	{
506: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
507: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
508: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
509: 	}
510: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
511: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
512: 
513: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
514: 	{
515: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
516: 	}
517: 
518: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
519: 	{
520: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	return;
524: }
