1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: RUNTIME_DIR="$ROOT/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/runtime"
31: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
32: 
33: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
34: PORTNUM=0
35: 
36: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
37: #
38: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
39: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
40: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
41: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
42: # nothing typed into it worked.
43: BAUD=115200
44: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
45: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
46: LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.log"
47: REBOOT_TRIES=8
48: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
49: 
50: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
51: #
52: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
53: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
54: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
55: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
56: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
57: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
58: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
59: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
60: TEST_ONLY=0
61: 
62: usage() {
63:   cat <<'EOF'
64: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
65: 
66:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
67:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
68:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
69:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
70:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
71:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
72:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
73:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
74:   -h           显示本帮助
75: 
76: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
77:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
78: EOF
79: }
80: 
81: while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
82:   case "$opt" in
83:     i) IMAGE="$OPTARG" ;;
84:     p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
85:     n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
86:     b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
87:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
88:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
89:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
90:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
91:     h) usage; exit 0 ;;
92:     *) usage; exit 2 ;;
93:   esac
94: done
95: 
96: die() { echo "错误: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
97: 
98: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. 前置检查
99: 
100: [ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
101: [ -f "$IMAGE" ]  || die "找不到镜像: $IMAGE"
102: [ -c "$PORT" ]   || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
103: mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR" || die "无法创建运行记录目录: $RUNTIME_DIR"
104: 
105: SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$IMAGE")
106: SHA=$(sha256sum "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
107: 
108: # 10 bits on the wire per byte (8N1 plus start and stop).
109: XFER_SECS=$(( SIZE * 10 / BAUD ))
110: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))
111: 
112: echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
113: echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
114: echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
115: echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
116: echo "  串口   : $PORT"
117: echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
118: echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud（烧完会恢复成这个）"
119: 
120: if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
121:   if [ "$SIZE" -ne "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
122:     die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE。打包可能不完整，用 -s 可跳过此检查"
123:   fi
124:   echo "  字节数校验通过"
125: fi
126: 
127: # ---------------------------------------------------------- 2. 释放串口占用
128: 
129: echo
130: echo "=== 释放串口 ==="
131: HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
132: if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
133:   echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"
134: 
135:   pkill -f "picocom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
136:   pkill -f "minicom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
137: 
138:   sleep 0.5
139:   HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
140:   if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
141:     die "串口仍被占用: $HOLDERS。手动处理后重试（参考 docs/端口冲突解决办法.md）"
142:   fi
143: fi
144: echo "  串口空闲"
145: 
146: # Console baud, not flash baud: the only thing written through this port
147: # before bk_loader takes over is the "reboot" command, and the firmware's
148: # console is listening at CONSOLE_BAUD.
149: stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
150:   || die "stty 配置失败"
151: 
152: # --------------------------------------------------- 3. 启动 bk_loader 并软复位
153: 
154: echo
155: : > "$LOG"
156: PIDFILE="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.$$.pid"
157: : > "$PIDFILE"
158: 
159: # The in-loop reset works at any -b, and here is why it is safe to rely on:
160: # bk_loader opens the tty at 115200 no matter what -b says, handshakes there,
161: # and only switches to the requested rate once it owns the bus.  Measured from
162: # a real 1500000 run:
163: #
164: #   cmdline: ... bk_loader download -p 0 -b 1500000 ...
165: #   Current port : /dev/ttyUSB0 + BaudRate : 115200 connect success
166: #   Getting Bus... / Gotten Bus... / All Finished Successfully
167: #
168: # So while we are writing "reboot" the line is still at 115200 and the
169: # firmware console decodes it fine.  An earlier version of this script
170: # disabled the retry loop for BAUD != CONSOLE_BAUD on the theory that the port
171: # had already been switched up -- that was reasoning without measurement, and
172: # it broke a mechanism that worked.
173: 
174: if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
175:   echo "=== 只测握手，不写 flash ==="
176:   set -- read -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash_probe.bin@0-1000"
177: else
178:   echo "=== 开始烧录（无需按 RST）==="
179:   set -- download -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -s 0 -i "$IMAGE"
180: fi
181: 
182: # Output goes to the terminal *and* the log.
183: #
184: # bk_loader draws its erase/write progress with cli_printf_progress_bar,
185: # which emits "Erasing Flash ... 42%\r" -- carriage return, no newline.  Two
186: # things are needed to see that live: tee, so the bytes reach the terminal at
187: # all, and stdbuf -o0, because with a pipe on stdout glibc would otherwise
188: # block-buffer 4 KB at a time and the bar would arrive in lurches.
189: #
190: # The PID is stashed in a file because with a pipeline $! would be tee's.
191: (
192:   stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout "$OVERALL_TIMEOUT" "$LOADER" "$@" &
193:   echo $! > "$PIDFILE"
194:   wait $!
195: ) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG" &
196: PIPELINE_PID=$!
197: 
198: LOADER_PID=""
199: for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
200:   if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ]; then LOADER_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE"); break; fi
201:   sleep 0.1
202: done
203: [ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] || die "无法获取 bk_loader 进程号"
204: 
205: # Wait for it to actually enter the retry loop before poking the board.
206: for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
207:   grep -q "Getting Bus" "$LOG" && break
208:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
209:   sleep 0.1
210: done
211: 
212: if ! kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
213:   echo "  bk_loader 提前退出:"
214:   tail -5 "$LOG" | sed 's/^/    | /'
215:   wait "$LOADER_PID"; exit 1
216: fi
217: 
218: GOT_BUS=0
219: 
220: echo "  bk_loader 已进入握手循环，开始发送软复位"
221: 
222: for i in $(seq 1 "$REBOOT_TRIES"); do
223:   if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
224:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
225: 
226:   # If the console happens to be bridged to the AP shell, escape back to the
227:   # CP shell first: Ctrl-] then '.'.
228:   #
229:   # The trailing newline after the escape is essential.  Without it the CP
230:   # shell buffers all of it as a single line and sees "\x1d.reboot", answers
231:   # "cmd NOT found: .reboot" and never resets -- which made every attempt here
232:   # fall through to the manual RST prompt.  Measured: with the flush the board
233:   # reboots, without it it never does.
234:   printf '\035' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
235:   printf '.'    > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
236:   printf '\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
237:   printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
238:   echo "  第 $i 次软复位已发出"
239: 
240:   # Poll frequently so we stop writing the instant the bus is taken --
241:   # further bytes would corrupt the download protocol.
242:   for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
243:     if grep -q "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
244:     sleep 0.1
245:   done
246:   [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ] && break
247: done
248: 
249: if [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ]; then
250:   echo "  握手成功，下面是 bk_loader 的实时输出："
251: else
252:   echo "  软复位没能拿到总线 —— 现在请手动按一次 RST（按一下就彻底松手）"
253:   echo "  bk_loader 仍在循环握手，按下去就会接上"
254: fi
255: 
256: # Waiting on the pipeline, not the loader: tee has to finish draining before
257: # the log is complete enough to judge the outcome.
258: wait "$PIPELINE_PID"
259: RC=$?
260: rm -f "$PIDFILE"
261: 
262: # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. 判定
263: 
264: echo
265: echo "=== 结果 ==="
266: if grep -aq "All Finished Successfully" "$LOG"; then
267:   echo "  烧录成功"
268:   grep -aE "Total Test Time|EraseFlash ->pass" "$LOG" \
269:     | tail -3 | sed 's/^/    | /'
270: else
271:   echo "  烧录失败（退出码 $RC）"
272: 
273:   # Distinguish "never got started" from "killed halfway through the write",
274:   # because the second case leaves the board unbootable and must be re-flashed
275:   # before anything else is attempted.
276:   LAST_PCT=$(tr '\r' '\n' < "$LOG" | grep -aoE "Writing Flash \.\.\. [0-9]+%" \
277:              | tail -1)
278:   if [ -n "$LAST_PCT" ]; then
279:     echo
280:     echo "  !! flash 已被擦除但只写到 $LAST_PCT —— 固件不完整，板子起不来。"
281:     echo "     必须重新完整烧录一次才能恢复。"
282:     echo "     此时固件不响应 reboot，软复位无效，需要手动按一次 RST。"
283:   elif [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
284:     echo "  !! 被超时中止（上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s）"
285:   fi
286: 
287:   echo
288:   echo "  完整日志: $LOG"
289:   exit 1
290: fi
291: 
292: # --------------------------------------------------------- 5. 可选挂回串口
293: 
294: # Put the line back to the console rate.  bk_loader left it at BAUD, and if
295: # that is not CONSOLE_BAUD then anything attaching afterwards -- screen, cat,
296: # minicom -- would see garbage and typing would do nothing.
297: if [ "$BAUD" != "$CONSOLE_BAUD" ]; then
298:   stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
299:     2>/dev/null
300:   echo "  串口已从 ${BAUD} 恢复为控制台的 ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
301: fi
302: 
303: if [ "$ATTACH_SERIAL" -eq 1 ]; then
304:   echo
305:   command -v picocom >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "找不到 picocom"
306:   echo "=== 挂上串口（Ctrl-A Ctrl-X 退出）==="
307:   sleep 1
308:   exec picocom -b "$CONSOLE_BAUD" --flow n --parity n --databits 8 "$PORT"
309: fi
310: 
311: echo
312: echo "  接串口看日志: picocom -b $CONSOLE_BAUD --flow n --parity n --databits 8 $PORT"

84:  * Description:

86:  *
87:  * Input Parameters:
88:  *   dev    - The device driver structure to use in the send operation

90:  *

99: static void sendto_request(FAR struct net_driver_s *dev,
100:                            FAR struct icmp_sendto_s *pstate)
101: {
102:   FAR struct icmp_hdr_s *icmp;
103: 
104: #ifdef CONFIG_NET_JUMBO_FRAME
105:   netdev_iob_prepare_dynamic(dev, pstate->snd_buflen + IPv4_HDRLEN);
106: #endif
107: 
108:   /* Set-up to send that amount of data. */
109: 
110:   devif_send(dev, pstate->snd_buf, pstate->snd_buflen, IPv4_HDRLEN);
111:   if (dev->d_sndlen != pstate->snd_buflen)
112:     {
113:       return;
114:     }
115: 
116:   IFF_SET_IPv4(dev->d_flags);
117: 
118:   /* The total length to send is the size of the application data plus the
119:    * IP and ICMP headers (and, eventually, the Ethernet header)
120:    */
121: 
122:   dev->d_len = IPv4_HDRLEN + pstate->snd_buflen;
123: 
124:   /* Initialize the IP header. */
125: 
126:   ipv4_build_header(IPv4BUF, dev->d_len, IP_PROTO_ICMP,
127:                     &dev->d_ipaddr, &pstate->snd_toaddr,
128:                     IP_TTL_DEFAULT, 0, NULL);
129: 
130:   /* Copy the ICMP header and payload into place after the IPv4 header */
131: 
132:   icmp = IPBUF(IPv4_HDRLEN);
133:

182:

186:

196:        *   by a sendto event handler serving a different thread)
197:        * -OR-
198:        *   If the output buffer currently contains unprocessed incoming
199:        *   data.
200:        * -OR-

202:        *
203:        * In the first two cases, we will just have to wait for the next

205:        */
206: 
207:       if (dev->d_sndlen <= 0 &&           /* Packet available */
208:           (flags & ICMP_NEWDATA) == 0)    /* No incoming data */

211:

197: static struct wifi_command_slot *wifi_command_alloc(void)
198: {
199:   unsigned int i;
200: 
201:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
202:     {
203:       uint32_t *pattern = (uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes;
204: 
205:       if (!g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
206:           !g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending &&
207:           *pattern == BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE)
208:         {
209:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = true;
210:           *pattern = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_BUSY;
211:           return &g_wifi.command[i];
212:         }
213:     }
214: 
215:   return NULL;
216: }

218: static void wifi_command_reap(void)
219: {
220:   unsigned int i;
221: 
222:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
223:     {
224:       uint32_t pattern = *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes;
225: 
226:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
227:           !g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending &&
228:           pattern == BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE)
229:         {
230:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
231:         }
232:     }
233: }

235: static void wifi_command_transport_complete(
236:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
237: {
238:   struct wifi_command_slot *slot = arg;
239:   bool wake = false;
240:   irqstate_t flags;
241: 
242:   (void)ack;
243:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
244:   if (slot->transport_pending)
245:     {
246:       slot->transport_pending = false;
247:       if (result == -EREMOTEIO && slot->owned)
248:         {
249:           *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
250:           slot->owned = false;
251:           if (g_wifi.waiting_id ==
252:                 slot->command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
253:               g_wifi.waiting_sequence == slot->sequence)
254:             {
255:               g_wifi.command_result = -EREMOTEIO;
256:               g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
257:               wake = true;
258:             }
259:         }
260:     }
261:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
262: 
263:   if (wake)
264:     {
265:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
266:     }
267: }

269: static int wifi_command(uint16_t command, const void *payload,
270:                          uint16_t payload_length, void *result,
271:                          uint16_t result_size, uint16_t *result_length)
272: {
273:   struct wifi_command_slot *slot;
274:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
275:   struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *header;
276:   uint16_t sequence;
277:   int ret;
278: 
279:   if (payload_length > BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(uint32_t) -
280:                        sizeof(*cpdu) - sizeof(*header))
281:     {
282:       return -E2BIG;
283:     }
284: 
285:   if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
286:     {
287:       return -ENOLINK;
288:     }
289: 
290:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
291:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
292:   wifi_command_reap();
293:   slot = wifi_command_alloc();
294:   if (slot == NULL)
295:     {
296:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
297:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
298:       return -ENOMEM;
299:     }
300: 
301:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(slot->bytes + sizeof(uint32_t));
302:   header = (struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *)(cpdu + 1);
303:   sequence = ++g_wifi.next_sequence;
304:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length);
305:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length;
306:   header->cmd_id = command;
307:   header->cmd_sn = sequence;
308:   header->length = payload_length;
309:   slot->command = command;
310:   slot->sequence = sequence;
311:   slot->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
312:   slot->transport_pending = true;
313:   if (payload != NULL && payload_length != 0)
314:     {
315:       memcpy(header + 1, payload, payload_length);
316:     }
317: 
318:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_wifi.command_sem) == OK)
319:     {
320:     }
321: 
322:   {
323:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
324: 
325:     g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
326:     g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
327:     g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
328:     g_wifi.command_length = 0;
329:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
330:   }
331:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
332:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
333:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
334:                        wifi_command_transport_complete, slot);
335:   if (ret < 0)
336:     {
337:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
338:       slot->owned = false;
339:       slot->transport_pending = false;
340:       {
341:         irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
342: 
343:         if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
344:             g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
345:           {
346:             g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
347:           }
348:         rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       }
350:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
351:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
352:       return ret;
353:     }
354:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
355: 
356:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
357:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
358:   {
359:     irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
360: 
361:     if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
362:         g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
363:       {
364:         g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
365:       }
366:     if (ret >= 0)
367:       {
368:         ret = g_wifi.command_result;
369:       }
370:     rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
371:   }
372: 
373:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)
374:     {
375:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?
376:                       g_wifi.command_length : result_size;
377:       memcpy(result, g_wifi.command_data, copy);
378:     }
379:   if (ret >= 0 && result_length != NULL)
380:     {
381:       *result_length = g_wifi.command_length;
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
385:   wifi_command_reap();
386:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
387:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
388:   return ret;
389: }

440: static bool wifi_sync_reset_generation(void)
441: {
442:   struct wifi_pending_node nodes[WIFI_NODE_QUEUE];
443:   uint32_t generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
444:   bool wake_command = false;
445:   unsigned int kept = 0;
446:   unsigned int i;
447:   irqstate_t flags;
448: 
449:   if (generation == g_wifi.reset_generation)
450:     {
451:       return false;
452:     }
453: 
454:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
455:   if (g_wifi.waiting_id != 0)
456:     {
457:       g_wifi.command_result = -ECONNRESET;
458:       g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
459:       wake_command = true;
460:     }
461: 
462:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
463:   if (wake_command)
464:     {
465:       nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
466:     }
467: 
468:   wifi_set_carrier(false);
469:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
470:   wifi_scan_cache_clear();
471:   g_wifi.scan_running = false;
472:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
473: 
474:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
475:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
476:   generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
477: 
478:   /* A peer generation change proves the old CP can no longer reference AP
479:    * command slots.  TX slots remain quarantined because DMA completion is
480:    * not proven by a CP reset.
481:    */
482: 
483:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOTS; i++)
484:     {
485:       if (g_wifi.command[i].owned &&
486:           g_wifi.command[i].generation != generation)
487:         {
488:           *(uint32_t *)g_wifi.command[i].bytes =
489:             BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
490:           g_wifi.command[i].owned = false;
491:           g_wifi.command[i].transport_pending = false;
492:         }
493:     }
494:   g_wifi.reset_generation = generation;
495:   for (i = 0; i < g_wifi.node_count; i++)
496:     {
497:       unsigned int index = (g_wifi.node_head + i) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
498: 
499:       if (g_wifi.nodes[index].generation == generation)
500:         {
501:           nodes[kept++] = g_wifi.nodes[index];
502:         }
503:     }
504:   memcpy(g_wifi.nodes, nodes, kept * sizeof(nodes[0]));
505:   g_wifi.node_head = 0;
506:   g_wifi.node_tail = kept % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
507:   g_wifi.node_count = kept;
508:   g_wifi.packet_head = 0;
509:   g_wifi.packet_tail = 0;
510:   g_wifi.packet_count = 0;
511:   for (i = 0; i < WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE; i++)
512:     {
513:       if (g_wifi.recycle[i].state != WIFI_RECYCLE_FREE &&
514:           g_wifi.recycle[i].generation != generation)
515:         {
516:           g_wifi.recycle[i].state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
517:         }
518:     }
519:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
520:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
521:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
522:   return true;
523: }

553: static int wifi_scan_cache_build_record(
554:   const struct bk7258_wifi_scan_record *record)
555: {
556:   struct iw_event event;
557:   struct iw_quality quality;
558:   struct iw_freq frequency;
559:   uint16_t flags;
560:   size_t ssid_length;
561:   size_t padded_length;
562:   size_t event_length;
563:   int ret;
564: 
565:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
566:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWAP;
567:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr);
568:   event.u.ap_addr.sa_family = ARPHRD_ETHER;
569:   memcpy(event.u.ap_addr.sa_data, record->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
570:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
571:   if (ret < 0)
572:     {
573:       return ret;
574:     }
575: 
576:   ssid_length = strnlen(record->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
577:   padded_length = (ssid_length + 3u) & ~3u;
578:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
579:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWESSID;
580:   event.u.essid.flags = IW_ESSID_ON;
581:   event.u.essid.length = ssid_length;
582:   event.u.essid.pointer = (void *)(uintptr_t)sizeof(struct iw_point);
583:   event_length = offsetof(struct iw_event, u) + sizeof(struct iw_point) +
584:                  padded_length;
585:   event.len = event_length;
586:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, offsetof(struct iw_event, u) +
587:                                sizeof(struct iw_point));
588:   if (ret < 0)
589:     {
590:       return ret;
591:     }
592:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(record->ssid, ssid_length);
593:   if (ret < 0)
594:     {
595:       return ret;
596:     }
597:   if (padded_length != ssid_length)
598:     {
599:       uint32_t padding = 0;
600:       ret = wifi_scan_cache_append(&padding, padded_length - ssid_length);
601:       if (ret < 0)
602:         {
603:           return ret;
604:         }
605:     }
606: 
607:   memset(&quality, 0, sizeof(quality));
608:   quality.level = (uint8_t)record->rssi;
609:   quality.updated = IW_QUAL_DBM;
610:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(IWEVQUAL, &quality, sizeof(quality));
611:   if (ret < 0)
612:     {
613:       return ret;
614:     }
615: 
616:   memset(&frequency, 0, sizeof(frequency));
617:   frequency.m = record->channel;
618:   ret = wifi_scan_cache_event(SIOCGIWFREQ, &frequency, sizeof(frequency));
619:   if (ret < 0)
620:     {
621:       return ret;
622:     }
623: 
624:   flags = record->security == 0 ? IW_ENCODE_DISABLED : IW_ENCODE_ENABLED;
625:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
626:   event.cmd = SIOCGIWENCODE;
627:   event.len = IW_EV_LEN(data);
628:   event.u.data.flags = flags;
629:   return wifi_scan_cache_append(&event, event.len);
630: }

632: static int wifi_scan_cache_fetch(void)
633: {
634:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_request request;
635:   struct bk7258_wifi_scan_page_response response;
636:   uint16_t start = 0;
637:   uint16_t total = 0;
638:   uint16_t result_length;
639:   int ret;
640: 
641:   g_wifi.scan_cache = kmm_malloc(WIFI_SCAN_CACHE_LIMIT);
642:   if (g_wifi.scan_cache == NULL)
643:     {
644:       return -ENOMEM;
645:     }
646: 
647:   do
648:     {
649:       memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
650:       request.start = start;
651:       request.max_records = BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS;
652:       memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
653:       ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE,
654:                          &request, sizeof(request), &response,
655:                          sizeof(response), &result_length);
656:       if (ret < 0)
657:         {
658:           printf("wifi scan page transport failed: %d\n", ret);
659:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
660:           return ret;
661:         }
662:       if (result_length != sizeof(response) || response.status != 0 ||
663:           response.page.start != start ||
664:           response.page.count > BK7258_WIFI_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS ||
665:           response.page.reserved != 0 ||
666:           response.page.total < start ||
667:           response.page.count > response.page.total - start)
668:         {
669:           printf("wifi scan page invalid: status=%ld start=%u count=%u "
670:                  "total=%u length=%u\n",
671:                  (long)response.status, response.page.start,
672:                  response.page.count, response.page.total, result_length);
673:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
674:           return response.status != 0 ? response.status : -EPROTO;
675:         }
676: 
677:       if (start == 0)
678:         {
679:           total = response.page.total;
680:         }
681:       else if (response.page.total != total)
682:         {
683:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
684:           return -EPROTO;
685:         }
686: 
687:       for (uint8_t i = 0; i < response.page.count; i++)
688:         {
689:           ret = wifi_scan_cache_build_record(&response.page.records[i]);
690:           if (ret < 0)
691:             {
692:               wifi_scan_cache_clear();
693:               return ret;
694:             }
695:         }
696: 
697:       start += response.page.count;
698:       if (response.page.more != (start < total) ||
699:           (response.page.count == 0 && start < total))
700:         {
701:           wifi_scan_cache_clear();
702:           return -EPROTO;
703:         }
704:     }
705:   while (start < total);
706: 
707:   g_wifi.scan_cached = true;
708:   return OK;
709: }

723: static void wifi_handle_command(uint32_t cpdu_address,
724:                                 uint32_t generation)
725: {
726:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
727:   struct bk7258_wifi_event_hdr event;
728:   uint8_t data[sizeof(g_wifi.command_data)];
729:   uint32_t event_address;
730:   uint16_t length;
731:   uint16_t copied;
732:   irqstate_t flags;
733: 
734:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
735:   if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
736:       !wifi_cp_pointer(cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu)))
737:     {
738:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
739:       return;
740:     }
741: 
742:   memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address, sizeof(cpdu));
743:   event_address = cpdu_address + sizeof(cpdu);
744:   if (cpdu.length < sizeof(cpdu) + sizeof(event) ||
745:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address, sizeof(event)))
746:     {
747:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
748:       return;
749:     }
750: 
751:   memcpy(&event, (const void *)(uintptr_t)event_address, sizeof(event));
752:   length = event.length;
753:   if (length > cpdu.length - sizeof(cpdu) - sizeof(event) ||
754:       !wifi_cp_range(event_address + WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET, length))
755:     {
756:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
757:       return;
758:     }
759: 
760:   copied = length < sizeof(data) ? length : sizeof(data);
761:   if (copied != 0)
762:     {
763:       memcpy(data, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(event_address +
764:                                               WIFI_EVENT_DATA_OFFSET),
765:              copied);
766:     }
767:   wifi_release_cp_command(cpdu_address);
768:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
769: 
770:   if (event.id >= BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET)
771:     {
772:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
773: 
774:       if (event.id == g_wifi.waiting_id &&
775:           event.sequence == g_wifi.waiting_sequence)
776:         {
777:           if (copied != 0)
778:             {
779:               memcpy(g_wifi.command_data, data, copied);
780:             }
781:           g_wifi.command_length = copied;
782:           g_wifi.command_result = OK;
783:           g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
784:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
785:           nxsem_post(&g_wifi.command_sem);
786:         }
787:       else
788:         {
789:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
790:         }
791:     }
792:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_IPV4_IND)
793:     {
794:       wifi_set_carrier(true);
795:     }
796:   else if (event.id == BK7258_WIFI_EVT_WIFI_EVENT_IND && copied >= 4)
797:     {
798:       uint16_t event_id;
799: 
800:       memcpy(&event_id, data, sizeof(event_id));
801:       if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_CONNECTED)
802:         {
803:           wifi_set_carrier(true);
804:         }
805:       else if (event_id == BK7258_WIFI_EVENT_DISCONNECTED)
806:         {
807:           wifi_set_carrier(false);
808:         }
809:     }
810:   else if (event.id == 3u)
811:     {
812:       wifi_set_carrier(false);
813:     }
814:   else if (event.id == 8u)
815:     {
816:       g_wifi.scan_running = false;
817:     }
818: 
819: }

859: static void wifi_handle_command_list(const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
860:                                      uint32_t generation)
861: {
862:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
863:   uint32_t address = node->head;
864:   unsigned int count;
865: 
866:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
867:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
868:     {
869:       return;
870:     }
871: 
872:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
873:     {
874:       uint32_t next;
875:       unsigned int previous;
876: 
877:       if (!wifi_validate_command(address, &next, generation))
878:         {
879:           return;
880:         }
881:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
882:         {
883:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
884:             {
885:               return;
886:             }
887:         }
888:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
889:         {
890:           return;
891:         }
892: 
893:       addresses[count] = address;
894:       address = next;
895:     }
896: 
897:   if (address != 0)
898:     {
899:       return;
900:     }
901: 
902:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
903:     {
904:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
905:         {
906:           return;
907:         }
908: 
909:       wifi_handle_command(addresses[count], generation);
910:     }
911: }

1003:       cpdu_address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START + sizeof(pbuf))

1017:       pbuf.len > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME || pbuf.tot_len != pbuf.len ||
1018:       pbuf.ref == 0 || pbuf.ref == UINT8_MAX ||
1019:       !wifi_cp_pointer(pbuf.payload, pbuf.len))
1020:     {

1027:       packet->length = pbuf.len;
1028:     }

1032: static void wifi_recycle_append(struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node,
1033:                                 uint32_t cpdu_address)

1036:     (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(uintptr_t)cpdu_address;
1037:   uint32_t pbuf_address;
1038:   struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *pbuf;

1040:   pbuf_address = cpdu_address - sizeof(*pbuf);
1041:   pbuf = (struct bk7258_wifi_pbuf *)(uintptr_t)pbuf_address;
1042:

1045:   pbuf->ref++;

1048:   if (node->tail != 0)
1049:     {

1051:         cpdu_address;
1052:     }
1053:   else
1054:     {

1056:     }
1057: 
1058:   node->tail = cpdu_address;
1059:   node->num++;

1086: static void wifi_flush_recycle(void)
1087: {
1088:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry;
1089:   irqstate_t flags;
1090:   int ret;
1091: 
1092:   for (;;)
1093:     {
1094:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1095:       if (g_wifi.recycle_count == 0)
1096:         {
1097:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1098:           return;
1099:         }
1100: 
1101:       entry = &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_head];
1102:       if (entry->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1103:         {
1104:           entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1105:         }
1106: 
1107:       if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD)
1108:         {
1109:           memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1110:           g_wifi.recycle_head = (g_wifi.recycle_head + 1) %
1111:                                 WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1112:           g_wifi.recycle_count--;
1113:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1114:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1115:           continue;
1116:         }
1117: 
1118:       if (entry->state != WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED ||
1119:           !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1120:         {
1121:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1122:           return;
1123:         }
1124: 
1125:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING;
1126:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1127:       ret = wifi_send_node_async(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, &entry->node,
1128:                                  wifi_recycle_complete, entry);
1129:       if (ret < 0)
1130:         {
1131:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1132:           if (entry->state == WIFI_RECYCLE_SENDING)
1133:             {
1134:               entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1135:             }
1136:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1137:         }
1138: 
1139:       return;
1140:     }
1141: }

1143: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct wifi_pending_node *pending,
1144:                              struct wifi_net_notifications *notifications)
1145: {
1146:   const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node = &pending->node;
1147:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1148:   bool cp_owned[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
1149:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *recycle;
1150:   uint32_t address = node->head;
1151:   uint8_t packet_added = 0;
1152:   unsigned int count;
1153:   irqstate_t flags;
1154: 
1155:   if (!pending->recycle_reserved || node->channel != 2 ||
1156:       node->num == 0 || node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1157:     {
1158:       return;
1159:     }
1160: 
1161:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1162:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1163:   recycle = &g_wifi.recycle[pending->recycle_index];
1164:   if (pending->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation ||
1165:       pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1166:     {
1167:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1168:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1169:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1170:       return;
1171:     }
1172:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1173: 
1174:   /* First pass validates the complete list without changing either core's
1175:    * ownership.  A malformed list is left untouched.
1176:    */
1177: 
1178:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1179:     {
1180:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
1181:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
1182:       uint32_t next;
1183:       unsigned int previous;
1184: 
1185:       if (address == 0)
1186:         {
1187:           goto invalid;
1188:         }
1189: 
1190:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
1191:         {
1192:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
1193:             {
1194:               goto invalid;
1195:             }
1196:         }
1197: 
1198:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
1199:         {
1200:           goto invalid;
1201:         }
1202: 
1203:       addresses[count] = address;
1204:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
1205:       if (tx != NULL)
1206:         {
1207:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
1208:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1209: 
1210:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0)
1211:             {
1212:               goto invalid;
1213:             }
1214: 
1215:           cp_owned[count] = false;
1216:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
1217:         }
1218:       else
1219:         {
1220:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1221:           if (pending->generation !=
1222:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
1223:               !wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
1224:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL))
1225:             {
1226:               rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1227:               goto invalid;
1228:             }
1229: 
1230:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
1231:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1232:           cp_owned[count] = true;
1233:           next = cpdu.next;
1234:         }
1235: 
1236:       address = next;
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   if (address != 0)
1240:     {
1241:       goto invalid;
1242:     }
1243: 
1244:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1245:     {
1246:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1247:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
1248:         {
1249:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1250:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1251: 
1252:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1253:           if (pending->generation ==
1254:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() &&
1255:               wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index]))
1256:             {
1257:               packet_added++;
1258:             }
1259:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1260:         }
1261:     }
1262: 
1263:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1264:   if (pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1265:     {
1266:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1267:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1268:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1269:       return;
1270:     }
1271: 
1272:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
1273:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
1274:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1275:     {
1276:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1277:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1278:         {
1279:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
1280:         }
1281:     }
1282: 
1283:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
1284:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
1285:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1286:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1287:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1288:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
1289: 
1290:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1291:     {
1292:       if (!cp_owned[count])
1293:         {
1294:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
1295: 
1296:           notifications->tx_packets[notifications->tx_count++] = tx->packet;
1297:           tx->packet = NULL;
1298:           tx->active = false;
1299:           tx->transport_rejected = false;
1300:         }
1301:     }
1302:   if (packet_added != 0)
1303:     {
1304:       notifications->rxready = true;
1305:     }
1306:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1307:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1308:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1309:   return;
1310: 
1311: invalid:
1312:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1313:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1314:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1315:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1316: }

1319: static int wifi_mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1320:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
1321: {
1322:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
1323:   struct wifi_pending_node *pending;
1324:   irqstate_t flags;
1325: 
1326:   (void)ack_flags;
1327:   (void)arg;
1328:   memcpy(&node, message, sizeof(node));
1329:   if (node.num == 0 || node.num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1330:     {
1331:       return -EINVAL;
1332:     }
1333: 
1334:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1335:   if (g_wifi.node_count == WIFI_NODE_QUEUE ||
1336:       (node.channel == 2 &&
1337:        g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE))
1338:     {
1339:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1340:       return -EAGAIN;
1341:     }
1342: 
1343:   pending = &g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_tail];
1344:   memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
1345:   pending->node = node;
1346:   pending->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
1347:   if (node.channel == 2)
1348:     {
1349:       struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry =
1350:         &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_tail];
1351: 
1352:       memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1353:       entry->generation = pending->generation;
1354:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_RESERVED;
1355:       pending->recycle_index = g_wifi.recycle_tail;
1356:       pending->recycle_reserved = true;
1357:       g_wifi.recycle_tail = (g_wifi.recycle_tail + 1) %
1358:                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1359:       g_wifi.recycle_count++;
1360:     }
1361: 
1362:   g_wifi.node_tail = (g_wifi.node_tail + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1363:   g_wifi.node_count++;
1364:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1365:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1366:   return OK;
1367: }

1379: static int wifi_worker(int argc, char **argv)
1380: {
1381:   (void)argc;
1382:   (void)argv;
1383:   g_worker_result = OK;
1384:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.ready_sem);
1385: 
1386:   for (;;)
1387:     {
1388:       struct wifi_pending_node pending;
1389:       struct wifi_net_notifications notifications;
1390:       irqstate_t flags;
1391: 
1392:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.work_sem,
1393:                                            WIFI_WORK_INTERVAL);
1394:       memset(&notifications, 0, sizeof(notifications));
1395:       (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();
1396:       wifi_collect_rejected_tx(&notifications);
1397:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1398:       for (;;)
1399:         {
1400:           if (bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() !=
1401:               g_wifi.reset_generation)
1402:             {
1403:               (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();
1404:             }
1405: 
1406:           nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1407:           flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1408:           if (g_wifi.node_count == 0)
1409:             {
1410:               rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1411:               nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1412:               break;
1413:             }
1414: 
1415:           pending = g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head];
1416:           g_wifi.node_head = (g_wifi.node_head + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1417:           g_wifi.node_count--;
1418:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1419:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1420:           if (pending.generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1421:             {
1422:               if (pending.recycle_reserved)
1423:                 {
1424:                   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1425:                   g_wifi.recycle[pending.recycle_index].state =
1426:                     WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1427:                   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1428:                 }
1429:             }
1430:           else if (pending.node.channel == 0)
1431:             {
1432:               wifi_handle_command_list(&pending.node,
1433:                                        pending.generation);
1434:             }
1435:           else if (pending.node.channel == 2)
1436:             {
1437:               wifi_handle_data(&pending, &notifications);
1438:             }
1439:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1440:         }
1441: 
1442:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1443:       wifi_notify_network(&notifications);
1444:     }
1445: 
1446:   return OK;
1447: }

1462: static int wifi_transmit(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower, netpkt_t *packet)
1463: {
1464:   struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = NULL;
1465:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
1466:   unsigned int length;
1467:   unsigned int i;
1468:   int ret;
1469: 
1470:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1471:   length = netpkt_getdatalen(lower, packet);
1472:   if (!g_wifi.carrier || !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1473:     {
1474:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1475:       return -ENETDOWN;
1476:     }
1477:   if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME)
1478:     {
1479:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1480:       return -EMSGSIZE;
1481:     }
1482: 
1483:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
1484:     {
1485:       if (!g_wifi.tx[i].active && !g_wifi.tx[i].transport_pending)
1486:         {
1487:           tx = &g_wifi.tx[i];
1488:           break;
1489:         }
1490:     }
1491:   if (tx == NULL)
1492:     {
1493:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1494:       return -EBUSY;
1495:     }
1496: 
1497:   memset(&tx->pbuf, 0, sizeof(tx->pbuf));
1498:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1499:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu));
1500:   tx->pbuf.payload = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)tx->frame;
1501:   tx->pbuf.tot_len = length;
1502:   tx->pbuf.len = length;
1503:   tx->pbuf.type_internal = WIFI_PBUF_TYPE_RAM;
1504:   tx->pbuf.ref = 1;
1505:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + length;
1506:   cpdu->type_dst = 2u;
1507:   ret = netpkt_copyout(lower, tx->frame, packet, length, 0);
1508:   if (ret < 0)
1509:     {
1510:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1511:       return ret;
1512:     }
1513: 
1514:   tx->packet = packet;
1515:   tx->active = true;
1516:   tx->transport_pending = true;
1517:   tx->transport_rejected = false;
1518:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, 2,
1519:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
1520:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
1521:                        wifi_tx_transport_complete, tx);
1522:   if (ret < 0)
1523:     {
1524:       tx->packet = NULL;
1525:       tx->active = false;
1526:       tx->transport_pending = false;
1527:     }
1528:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1529:   return ret;
1530: }

101:  *
102:  * Parameters:
103:  *   ifname   The name of the interface to use
104:  *
105:  * Return:
106:  *   0 on success
107:  *   Negative integer on failure
108:  *
109:  ****************************************************************************/
110: 
111: static int dhcp_obtain_statefuladdr(FAR const char *ifname)
112: {
113:   struct dhcpc_state ds;
114:   FAR void *handle;
115:   int ret;
116:   uint8_t mac[IFHWADDRLEN];
117: 
118: #ifdef CONFIG_NET_ETHERNET
119:   ret = netlib_getmacaddr(ifname, mac);
120:   if (ret < 0)
121:     {
122:       nerr("ERROR: get MAC address failed for '%s' : %d\n", ifname, ret);
123:       return ret;
124:     }
125: #else
126:   bzero(mac, sizeof(mac));
127: #endif
128: 
129:   /* Set up the DHCPC modules */
130: 
131:   handle = dhcpc_open(ifname, &mac, IFHWADDRLEN);
132:   if (handle == NULL)
133:     {
134:       nerr("ERROR: dhcpc open failed for '%s'\n", ifname);
135:       return -EINVAL;
136:     }
137: 
138:   /* Get an IP address.  Note that there is no logic for renewing the
139:    * IP address in this example. The address should be renewed in
140:    * (ds.lease_time / 2) seconds.
141:    */
142: 
143:   ret = dhcpc_request(handle, &ds);
144:   if (ret == OK)
145:     {
146:       ret = dhcp_setup_result(ifname, &ds);
147:     }
148:   else
149:     {
150:       nerr("ERROR: dhcpc request failed: %d\n", ret);
151:     }
152: 
153:   dhcpc_close(handle);
154:   return ret;
155: }

171:  * Return:

173:  *   Negative integer on failure

177: int netlib_obtain_ipv4addr(FAR const char *ifname)

737: /****************************************************************************
738:  * Name: netinit_monitor
739:  *
740:  * Description:
741:  *   Monitor link status, gracefully taking the link up and down as the
742:  *   link becomes available or as the link is lost.
743:  *
744:  ****************************************************************************/
745: 
746: #ifdef CONFIG_NETINIT_MONITOR
747: static int netinit_monitor(void)
748: {
749:   struct timespec abstime;
750:   struct timespec reltime;
751:   struct ifreq ifr;
752:   struct sigaction act;
753:   struct sigaction oact;
754:   bool devup;
755:   int ret;
756:   int sd;
757: 
758:   ninfo("Entry\n");
759: 
760:   /* Initialize the notification semaphore */
761: 
762:   DEBUGVERIFY(sem_init(&g_notify_sem, 0, 0));
763: 
764:   /* Get a socket descriptor that we can use to communicate with the network
765:    * interface driver.
766:    */
767: 
768:   sd = socket(NET_SOCK_FAMILY, NET_SOCK_TYPE, NET_SOCK_PROTOCOL);
769:   if (sd < 0)
770:     {
771:       ret = -errno;
772:       DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
773: 
774:       nerr("ERROR: Failed to create a socket: %d\n", ret);
775:       goto errout;
776:     }
777: 
778:   /* Attach a signal handler so that we do not lose PHY events */
779: 
780:   act.sa_sigaction = netinit_signal;
781:   act.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
782: 
783:   ret = sigaction(CONFIG_NETINIT_SIGNO, &act, &oact);
784:   if (ret < 0)
785:     {
786:       ret = -errno;
787:       DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
788: 
789:       nerr("ERROR: sigaction() failed: %d\n", ret);
790:       goto errout_with_socket;
791:     }
792: 
793:   /* Now loop, waiting for changes in link status */
794: 
795:   for (; ; )
796:     {
797:       /* Configure to receive a signal on changes in link status */
798: 
799:       memset(&ifr, 0, sizeof(struct ifreq));
800:       strlcpy(ifr.ifr_name, NET_DEVNAME, IFNAMSIZ);
801: 
802:       ifr.ifr_mii_notify_event.sigev_notify = SIGEV_SIGNAL;
803:       ifr.ifr_mii_notify_event.sigev_signo  = CONFIG_NETINIT_SIGNO;
804: 
805:       ret = ioctl(sd, SIOCMIINOTIFY, (unsigned long)&ifr);
806:       if (ret < 0)
807:         {
808:           ret = -errno;
809:           DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
810: 
811:           nerr("ERROR: ioctl(SIOCMIINOTIFY) failed: %d\n", ret);
812:           goto errout_with_sigaction;
813:         }
814: 
815:       /* Does the driver think that the link is up or down? */
816: 
817:       ret = ioctl(sd, SIOCGIFFLAGS, (unsigned long)&ifr);
818:       if (ret < 0)
819:         {
820:           ret = -errno;
821:           DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
822: 
823:           nerr("ERROR: ioctl(SIOCGIFFLAGS) failed: %d\n", ret);
824:           goto errout_with_notification;
825:         }
826: 
827:       devup = ((ifr.ifr_flags & IFF_UP) != 0);
828: 
829:       /* Get the current PHY address in use.  This probably does not change,
830:        * but just in case...
831:        *
832:        * NOTE: We are assuming that the network device name is preserved in
833:        * the ifr structure.
834:        */
835: 
836:       ret = ioctl(sd, SIOCGMIIPHY, (unsigned long)&ifr);
837:       if (ret < 0)
838:         {
839:           ret = -errno;
840:           DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
841: 
842:           nerr("ERROR: ioctl(SIOCGMIIPHY) failed: %d\n", ret);
843:           goto errout_with_notification;
844:         }
845: 
846:       /* Read the PHY status register */
847: 
848:       ifr.ifr_mii_reg_num = MII_MSR;
849: 
850:       ret = ioctl(sd, SIOCGMIIREG, (unsigned long)&ifr);
851:       if (ret < 0)
852:         {
853:           ret = -errno;
854:           DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
855: 
856:           nerr("ERROR: ioctl(SIOCGMIIREG) failed: %d\n", ret);
857:           goto errout_with_notification;
858:         }
859: 
860:       ninfo("%s: devup=%d PHY address=%02x MSR=%04x\n",
861:             ifr.ifr_name, devup, ifr.ifr_mii_phy_id, ifr.ifr_mii_val_out);
862: 
863:       /* Check for link up or down */
864: 
865:       if ((ifr.ifr_mii_val_out & MII_MSR_LINKSTATUS) != 0)
866:         {
867:           /* Link up... does the drive think that the link is up? */
868: 
869:           if (!devup)
870:             {
871:               /* No... We just transitioned from link down to link up.
872:                * Bring the link up.
873:                */
874: 
875:               ninfo("Bringing the link up\n");
876: 
877:               ifr.ifr_flags = IFF_UP;
878:               ret = ioctl(sd, SIOCSIFFLAGS, (unsigned long)&ifr);
879:               if (ret < 0)
880:                 {
881:                   ret = -errno;
882:                   DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
883: 
884:                   nerr("ERROR: ioctl(SIOCSIFFLAGS) failed: %d\n", ret);
885:                   goto errout_with_notification;
886:                 }
887: 
888: #ifdef CONFIG_NET_ICMPv6_AUTOCONF
889:               /* Perform ICMPv6 auto-configuration */
890: 
891:               netlib_icmpv6_autoconfiguration(ifr.ifr_name);
892: #endif
893:               /* And wait for a short delay.  We will want to recheck the
894:                * link status again soon.
895:                */
896: 
897:               reltime.tv_sec  = SHORT_TIME_SEC;
898:               reltime.tv_nsec = 0;
899:             }
900:           else
901:             {
902:               /* The link is still up.  Take a long, well-deserved rest */
903: 
904:               reltime.tv_sec  = LONG_TIME_SEC;
905:               reltime.tv_nsec = 0;
906:             }
907:         }
908:       else
909:         {
910:           /* Link down... Was the driver link state already down? */
911: 
912:           if (devup)
913:             {
914:               /* No... we just transitioned from link up to link down.  Take
915:                * the link down.
916:                */
917: 
918:               ninfo("Taking the link down\n");
919: 
920:               ifr.ifr_flags = 0;
921:               ret = ioctl(sd, SIOCSIFFLAGS, (unsigned long)&ifr);
922:               if (ret < 0)
923:                 {
924:                   ret = -errno;
925:                   DEBUGASSERT(ret < 0);
926: 
927:                   nerr("ERROR: ioctl(SIOCSIFFLAGS) failed: %d\n", ret);
928:                   goto errout_with_notification;
929:                 }
930:             }
931: 
932:           /* In either case, wait for the short, configurable delay */
933: 
934:           reltime.tv_sec  = CONFIG_NETINIT_RETRYMSEC / 1000;
935:           reltime.tv_nsec = (CONFIG_NETINIT_RETRYMSEC % 1000) * 1000000;
936:         }
937: 
938:       /* Now wait for either the semaphore to be posted for a timed-out to
939:        * occur.
940:        */
941: 
942:       sched_lock();
943:       DEBUGVERIFY(clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &abstime));
944: 
945:       abstime.tv_sec  += reltime.tv_sec;
946:       abstime.tv_nsec += reltime.tv_nsec;
947:       if (abstime.tv_nsec >= 1000000000)
948:         {
949:           abstime.tv_sec++;
950:           abstime.tv_nsec -= 1000000000;
951:         }
952: 
953:       sem_timedwait(&g_notify_sem, &abstime);
954:       sched_unlock();
955:     }
956: 
957:   /* TODO: Stop the PHY notifications and remove the signal handler. */
958: 
959: errout_with_notification:
960:   ifr.ifr_mii_notify_event.sigev_notify = SIGEV_NONE;
961:   ioctl(sd, SIOCMIINOTIFY, (unsigned long)&ifr);
962: errout_with_sigaction:
963:   sigaction(CONFIG_NETINIT_SIGNO, &oact, NULL);
964: errout_with_socket:
965:   close(sd);
966: errout:
967:   nerr("ERROR: Aborting\n");
968:   return ret;
969: }
970: #endif

44: 		NuttX is brought up through a series of sequential initialization
45: 		steps.  This includes networking. If the network is available on
46: 		reset, then there is really no issue.  Negotiating the link will
47: 		take only a second or so and the delay to application startup is
48: 		normally acceptable.
49: 
50: 		But if there is no network connected, then the start-up delay can
51: 		be very long depending upon things like the particular PHY, driver
52: 		timeout delay times and number of retries.  A failed negotiation
53: 		can potentially take a very long time, perhaps as much as a
54: 		minute... Long enough that you might think that the board would
55: 		never come up!
56: 
57: 		One solution is enabled by this option.  If NETINIT_THREAD
58: 		is selected, the network bring-up will occur in parallel with
59: 		the application on a separate thread.  In this case, the application
60: 		will start immediately with the network becoming available some time
61: 		later (if at all).  This thread will terminate once it successfully
62: 		initializes the network.

64: 		NOTES:  If no network is connected, the network bring-up will fail
65: 		and the network initialization thread will simply exit.  There are
66: 		no retries and no mechanism to know if the network initialization
67: 		was successful.  Furthermore, there is currently no support for

485: #### WAPI 命令使用示例
486: 
487: 以下是 WAPI 命令的常见使用场景：
488: 
489: **AP 模式**
490: 
491: ```Bash
492: wapi disconnect wlan0
493: ifup wlan0
494: wapi mode wlan0 3
495: wapi psk wlan0 <psk> 3
496: wapi essid wlan0 <ssid> 1
497: dhcpd wlan0 &
498: ```
499: 
500: **STA 模式**
501: 
502: 1. 通过 ESSID 连接：
503: 
504:     ```Bash
505:     ifup wlan0
506:     wapi mode wlan0 2
507:     wapi psk wlan0 <psk> 3
508:     wapi freq wlan0 1 1
509:     wapi essid wlan0 <ssid> 1
510:     renew wlan0
511:     ```
512: 
513: 2. 通过 BSSID 连接：
514: 
515:     ```Bash
516:     ifup wlan0
517:     wapi mode wlan0 2
518:     wapi psk wlan0 <psk> 3
519:     wapi freq wlan0 1 1
520:     wapi ap wlan0 <bssid>
521:     renew wlan0
522:     ```
523: 
524: **配置保存与加载**
525:

527: wapi save_config wlan0   # 保存当前配置到 wapi.conf

可以打开自动 DHCP，但需要区分两种模式。

**NuttX 原厂设计**
NuttX 的完整自动联网流程是：

```text
NSH 启动
→ netinit_bringup()
→ ifup wlan0
→ 加载 Wi-Fi 凭据并关联热点
→ DHCP 获取 IP、掩码、网关
```

相关代码：

- NSH 启动时调用 `netinit_bringup()`：[nsh_init.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/apps/nshlib/nsh_init.c:158)
- 自动执行 `ifup`、Wi-Fi 关联、DHCP：[netinit.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/apps/netutils/netinit/netinit.c:634)
- 凭据来自配置文件或 `CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_SSID/PASSPHRASE`：[netinit_associate.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/apps/netutils/netinit/netinit_associate.c:46)

当前板子配置为：

```text
CONFIG_NSH_NETINIT=y
CONFIG_NETUTILS_NETINIT=y
CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL=y
CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPC=y
# CONFIG_NETINIT_DHCPC is not set
CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_SSID=""
CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_PASSPHRASE=""
```

其中 `CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL=y` 明确表示：

- 不自动 `ifup`
- 不自动关联热点
- 不自动 DHCP
- DHCP 留给 `renew wlan0`

这正是 NuttX Kconfig 的原始定义：[Kconfig](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/apps/netutils/netinit/Kconfig:16)。所以当前手工流程符合原厂设计：

```sh
wapi essid wlan0 <SSID> 1
renew wlan0
```

**开启开机自动 DHCP**
如果热点固定，可以配置：

```text
# CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL is not set
CONFIG_NETINIT_DHCPC=y
CONFIG_NETINIT_THREAD=y
CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_SSID="<SSID>"
CONFIG_NETINIT_WAPI_PASSPHRASE="<密码>"
```

这样开机后会自动关联并执行 DHCP。`CONFIG_NETINIT_THREAD=y` 可以避免联网过程阻塞 NSH 启动，但原厂线程失败后不会自动重试。

**推荐方案**
对于比赛设备，SSID 和密码通常运行时输入，不建议写入 `defconfig`。更合适的是：

```text
保留 CONFIG_NETINIT_NETLOCAL=y
应用完成 wapi 关联
→ 检测 RUNNING/carrier
→ 自动调用 netlib_obtain_ipv4addr("wlan0")
```

也就是让网络管理应用自动完成现在的 `renew wlan0`。这样既不把密码编译进固件，也符合 NuttX 的分层：Wi-Fi 负责关联，DHCP 客户端负责三层地址。

当前 WAPI 原厂命令本身不会在 `wapi essid` 后自动启动 DHCP，官方文档同样要求随后执行 `renew wlan0`：[net_driver_guide.md](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/docs/zh-cn/device_dev_guide/connection/network/driver/net_driver_guide.md:500)。

1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP移植
2: 
3: 本项目将OpenVela/NuttX移植到BK7258 AP核，并保留博通原厂CP固件、Bootloader、分区和最终打包流程。当前已实现AP核启动，以及AP日志通过Mailbox转发到CP UART0输出。
4: 
5: ## 简单使用说明
6: 
7: 本项目需要配合博通`bk_avdk_smp` SMP工程使用：
8: 
9: ```text
10: 工作区/
11: ├── contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12: └── bk_avdk_smp/
13: ```
14: 
15: 构建前，需要将比赛仓`external/bk_avdk_smp/`中的权威覆盖文件同步到
16: `bk_avdk_smp`。完整文件清单、可直接执行的同步脚本、逐字节校验、OpenVela AP
17: 构建、CP构建和最终固件打包步骤见`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。Git协作和
18: 提交规则见`github开发指南.md`。
19: 
20: ## UART0控制台使用
21: 
22: 连接开发板UART0：
23: 
24: ```bash
25: picocom --no-escape -b 115200 --flow n --parity n --databits 8 /dev/ttyUSB0
26: ```
27: 
28: CP启动后可先查看AP链路状态，再进入AP的OpenVela NSH控制台：
29: 
30: ```text
31: ap_console status
32: ap_console open
33: ```
34: 
35: 进入AP控制台后可以直接执行NSH命令，例如：
36: 
37: ```text
38: help
39: uname -a
40: ps
41: free
42: ctrlc_test
43: ```
44: 
45: `ctrlc_test`会持续等待TTY `SIGINT`。按`Ctrl-C`后应打印
46: `ctrlc_test received SIGINT`并返回NSH提示符。
47: 
48: AP控制台支持方向键、Home、End、Delete、Backspace、命令历史，以及
49: `Ctrl-A`、`Ctrl-B`、`Ctrl-D`、`Ctrl-E`、`Ctrl-F`、`Ctrl-H`、`Ctrl-K`、
50: `Ctrl-L`、`Ctrl-N`、`Ctrl-P`和`Ctrl-U`等CLE快捷键。
51: 
52: 退出AP控制台并返回CP命令行时，严格按以下顺序操作：
53: 
54: 1. 按下`Ctrl-]`。
55: 2. 松开按键。
56: 3. 再按`.`。
57: 
58: 返回CP命令行后可再次检查状态：
59: 
60: ```text
61: ap_console status
62: ```
63: 
64: ## 主要目录
65: 
66: ```text
67: board/beken/chips/bk7258/                  BK7258 AP启动、中断、定时器和Mailbox驱动
68: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/       BK7258 AP板级配置、链接脚本和bring-up
69: external/bk_avdk_smp/                      已验证的博通CP覆盖文件
70: logs/                                      AI Coding日志
71: ```
72: 
73: ## 已实现功能
74: 
75: - BK7258物理CPU1/AP启动OpenVela/NuttX。
76: - Cortex-M33启动向量、C运行时、MPU、FPU、IRQ和SysTick基础适配。
77: - Mailbox v2基础传输、logical channel、sequence、ACK、超时和FIFO full恢复。
78: - 原厂兼容HW_CTRL command 1 power-up、command 2两秒heartbeat，以及独立的PWC `0x5/0x11`生命周期握手。
79: - AP日志通过Mailbox UART0转发到CP物理UART0。
80: - GPIO40红灯和GPIO41绿灯由NuttX内核自动LED状态接口接管，用于显示
81:   中断、信号、断言、Panic、空闲和启动状态。
82: - AP、CP和Bootloader通过`bk_avdk_smp`标准打包流程生成`all-app.bin`。
83: - 当前为物理CPU1+CPU2的OpenVela/NuttX SMP，CP保持物理CPU0。
84:

285: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
286: 
287: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
288: 
289: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
290: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
291: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
292: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
293: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
294: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
295: 
296: 本覆盖中的CP `0x7`协议要求request `param3=PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1`；response `param1`回显
297: ON/OFF state、`param2`返回真实PSRAM driver结果、`param3`回显version。CP BOOT与
298: OpenVela使用独立owner，初始化失败不置owner bit。`0xc`已提供frequency/divider、
299: speed、voltage、CPU power/reset和PSRAM owner只读诊断；device ID和actual capacity
300: 仍未暴露，因此alias probe和整颗器件实板测试仍是容量门禁。AP board必须同步发送
301: V1 version并检查真实ret/version后才能联调；本CP侧任务未修改AP board代码。
302: 
303: 本轮已放弃 SMP，PWC 现行摘要保留 PSRAM V1 `0x7` 和
304: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5`；`0x5` 只解除 CP boot worker 等待，不应解释为 SMP
305: commit。`PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 及其 PSRAM/clock/SMP commit 契约已废弃，不再是
306: 现行必需协议；相关设计、联调结论和当时产物 hash 仅见
307: `BK7258_OPENVELA_SMP_PORTING_PLAN.md` 第 15 节历史记录。正常 recovery 的 INIT/拒绝会
308: 取消 shutdown 并恢复 boot vote；只有 FINISH 才进入 shutdown。runtime DVFS 不由 AP 发起；
309: CP 保留单核 CPU1 的固定 480 MHz vote，以及 DVFS 错误传播、readback 和 rollback 修复。
310:

322: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
323: 
324: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
325: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
326: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
327: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
328: 
329: ```text
330: ap_console status
331: ap_console open
332: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
333: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
334: ap_console status
335: ```
336: 
337: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
338: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出时按下`Ctrl-]`、松开，再按`.`；该转义不依赖行首状态。
339: 链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
340: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
341: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。

1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: RUNTIME_DIR="$ROOT/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/runtime"
31: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
32: 
33: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
34: PORTNUM=0
35: 
36: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
37: #
38: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
39: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
40: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
41: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
42: # nothing typed into it worked.
43: BAUD=115200
44: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
45: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
46: LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.log"
47: REBOOT_TRIES=8
48: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
49: 
50: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
51: #
52: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
53: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
54: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
55: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
56: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
57: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
58: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
59: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
60: TEST_ONLY=0
61: 
62: usage() {
63:   cat <<'EOF'
64: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
65: 
66:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
67:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
68:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
69:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
70:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
71:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
72:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
73:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
74:   -h           显示本帮助
75: 
76: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
77:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
78: EOF
79: }

84:     p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
85:     n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
86:     b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
87:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
88:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
89:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
90:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;

165: #   Current port : /dev/ttyUSB0 + BaudRate : 115200 connect success
166: #   Getting Bus... / Gotten Bus... / All Finished Successfully

182: # Output goes to the terminal *and* the log.
183: #
184: # bk_loader draws its erase/write progress with cli_printf_progress_bar,

226:   # If the console happens to be bridged to the AP shell, escape back to the

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/jpeg_test/jpeg_test_main.c
3:  *
4:  * Exercise the BK7258 V4L2 M2M JPEG encoder without a camera.
5:  *
6:  * The encoder takes raw YUV from memory, so it can be driven entirely from a
7:  * synthetic frame -- which is the point: this validates the codec while the
8:  * camera capture path is still being built, and keeps the two pieces of work
9:  * independent.
10:  *
11:  * The generated frame is deliberately not noise.  Colour bars plus a
12:  * vertical luma ramp compress the way a real photo does (flat regions, hard
13:  * edges) and, more importantly, are recognisable by eye: after 'dump' the
14:  * JPEG can be
15:  * rebuilt on a PC and a wrong plane order, a swapped Cb/Cr, or an off-by-one
16:  * stride is obvious at a glance rather than hidden behind a plausible
17:  * compression ratio.
18:  *
19:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
20:  ****************************************************************************/
21:

66: /* How long to wait for an encoded frame before giving up.  Software JPEG at
67:  * 320x240 is milliseconds of work, so anything approaching this means the
68:  * work queue never ran.
69:  */
70: 
71: /* Kept under the CP heartbeat's 2 s window on purpose.  A 5 s wait here plus
72:  * one frame of encoding added up to the six seconds of silence that made CP
73:  * assert and reset the board -- a test tool must fail its own run, not take
74:  * the system down with it.  A 320x240 frame measures ~830 ms, so 1500 ms is
75:  * generous while still bailing out before the heartbeat is at risk.
76:  */
77:

80:  * Measured cost is roughly 11 us per pixel (820 ms for 320x240), so a fixed
81:  * budget either starves large frames or lets a wedged driver hang the shell.
82:  * Scale it, with a floor for tiny frames.
83:  */
84: 
85: #define JPEG_TEST_TIMEOUT_FLOOR 1000
86: #define JPEG_TEST_US_PER_PIXEL  40
87: #define JPEG_TEST_POLL_MS       20

90:  * characters, which stays clear of the console's line length.

text:
`apps/nshlib/nsh_command.c` 中存在 builtin 索引边界判断错误：

```c
if (index > 0)
```

应为：

```c
if (index >= 0)
```

`renew` 恰好是 builtin 表中的第 0 项。当前判断会把合法索引 `0` 当成未找到，导致 `help` 能显示 `renew`，但执行 `renew wlan0` 时却报：

```text
nsh: renew: command not found
```

该问题只影响启用 `CONFIG_NSH_BUILTIN_AS_COMMAND=y` 时 builtin 表第一个应用的直接命令分派。
这个属于哪一部分的问题

这是 **openvela/NuttX 公共仓库 `apps/nshlib` 的 NSH 命令分派问题**，具体在：

```text
apps/nshlib/nsh_command.c
```

属于 **NSH shell 的 builtin 应用命令解析/调度部分**，不是 BK7258 板级驱动、Wi-Fi 驱动或比赛仓业务代码的问题。

按仓库职责，它应在公共 `apps` 仓库中修复并单独提交，比赛仓不应复制或直接修改该文件。
这个归谁管

归 **openvela 的 NuttX Apps/NSH 维护者** 管，代码归属是公共 `apps` 仓库的 `nshlib` 模块：

```text
仓库：open-vela/apps
模块：nshlib
文件：nshlib/nsh_command.c
```

不是 Beken/BK7258 驱动团队的职责。修复应向 `open-vela/apps` 的 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支单独提交 PR，并由该仓库的 CODEOWNERS 或 NSH 维护者评审。
输出问题的简短报告

**问题报告：NSH 无法执行首个 Builtin 应用**

- **归属模块**：openvela 公共 `apps/nshlib`
- **问题文件**：`apps/nshlib/nsh_command.c`
- **触发条件**：启用 `CONFIG_NSH_BUILTIN_AS_COMMAND=y`
- **问题现象**：`help` 能列出 `renew`，但执行 `renew wlan0` 提示：
  ```text
  nsh: renew: command not found
  ```
- **根因**：`builtin_isavail()` 返回从 `0` 开始的合法索引，但代码使用：
  ```c
  if (index > 0)
  ```
  导致 builtin 表第 0 项被误判为不存在。
- **建议修复**：
  ```c
  if (index >= 0)
  ```
- **影响范围**：仅影响 builtin 表中的第一个应用；本次为 `renew` DHCP 命令。
- **临时规避**：关闭 `CONFIG_NSH_BUILTIN_AS_COMMAND`，使用标准 builtin task 执行路径。
- **修复归属**：应向 `open-vela/apps` 的 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支单独提交 PR。

321: 同步前先检查：
322: 
323: ```bash
324: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
325: repo status
326: ```
327: 
328: 同步：
329: 
330: ```bash
331: repo sync -c -j8
332: ```
333: 
334: 不要在未确认本地修改可丢弃时执行：
335: 
336: ```bash
337: git reset --hard
338: git checkout -- .
339: repo sync --force-sync
340: ```
341: 
342: ### 7.2 比赛仓同步上游
343: 
344: 比赛仓的 fork 分支必须定期与上游 `open-vela` 保持同步。同步时只能使用 rebase，不能使用 merge：
345: 
346: ```bash
347: cd ~/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing
348: 
349: # 获取上游最新
350: git fetch openvela
351: 
352: # 确认工作区干净
353: git status --short
354: 
355: # rebase 到上游最新
356: git rebase openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
357: 
358: # 如果有冲突，按第 3.1 节处理
359: 
360: # 推送到 fork
361: git push --force-with-lease fork dev-ai-contest-2026
362: ```
363: 
364: 禁止以下做法：
365: 
366: - 不要使用 `git merge openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026`，会产生 merge commit，导致 GitHub 的 `Rebase and merge` 失败。
367: - 不要在 fork 网页上点击 `Sync fork` 后直接使用 `Merge` 方式同步。
368: - 不要在 fork 中保留与上游内容重复的提交。
369: 
370: ## 8. 标签和日志
371: 
372: 阶段完成后可在比赛仓创建标签：
373: 
374: ```bash
375: git tag -a bk7258-startup -m "BK7258 startup baseline"
376: git tag
377: ```
378: 
379: AI Coding 日志放在：
380: 
381: ```text
382: contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/
383: ```
384: 
385: 不要把日志放到 `.repo/`，也不要提交构建临时日志。
386: 
387: ## 9. Fork PR 与分支历史整理
388: 
389: 本仓库只允许 `Rebase and merge`。如果 PR 分支包含 merge commit、重复历史或与目标分支分叉，GitHub 会提示：
390: 
391: ```text
392: This branch cannot be rebased due to conflicts
393: ```
394: 
395: 这通常不是代码内容冲突，而是提交历史结构导致无法逐个 rebase。
396: 
397: ### 9.1 常见原因
398: 
399: - fork 分支和 upstream 目标分支各自有一套内容相同但提交不同的历史。
400: - 网页解决冲突时产生了 merge commit。
401: - PR 分支长期未与目标分支同步。
402: - 使用过多个分支（如 feature 分支）发起 PR。
403: 
404: ### 9.2 解决方法
405: 
406: 将 fork 分支重建为目标分支之上只保留有效新增提交：
407: 
408: ```bash
409: cd ~/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing
410: 
411: # 确认远端最新
412: git fetch --all --prune
413: 
414: # 确认工作树干净
415: git status --short --branch
416: 
417: # 创建本地备份分支，保存当前完整历史
418: git branch backup/dev-ai-contest-2026-before-rebase HEAD
419: 
420: # 重置到目标分支最新提交
421: git reset --hard openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
422: 
423: # 挑选需要保留的有效提交
424: git cherry-pick <commit-hash>
425: 
426: # 确认重建前后文件内容一致
427: test "$(git rev-parse backup/dev-ai-contest-2026-before-rebase^{tree})" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"
428: 
429: # 使用带 lease 的强制推送更新 fork 分支。旧 commit 必须来自本次
430: # git fetch --all --prune 之后记录的 fork/dev-ai-contest-2026。
431: git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/dev-ai-contest-2026:<fetch前记录的fork旧commit> \
432:   fork dev-ai-contest-2026
433: ```
434: 
435: 推送后 PR 会自动更新为 upstream 之上的线性提交序列，`Rebase and merge` 即可使用。
436: 
437: ### 9.3 注意事项
438: 
439: - `--force-with-lease` 会检查远端分支是否仍为预期旧版本，比直接 `--force` 更安全。
440: - 重写历史前必须创建备份分支。
441: - 重写后必须比较 tree 哈希，确认代码内容没有丢失。
442: - 旧 PR 会因为源分支重写而自动关闭或失效，需要新建 PR。
443: - 不要在网页上反复 `Accept incoming change`，如果代码内容本身没有冲突，应先整理分支历史。
444: - 统一使用 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支开发和发起 PR，不要使用 feature 分支。
445: 
446: ### 9.4 验证 PR 是否可以合入
447: 
448: ```bash
449: # 确认目标分支是 PR 分支的祖先
450: git merge-base --is-ancestor openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026 dev-ai-contest-2026
451: 
452: # 确认只有基于 upstream 的新增提交
453: git rev-list --left-right --count openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026...dev-ai-contest-2026
454: # 预期输出：0 N，N 为本地真正新增的提交数
455: ```
456: 
457: 如果输出为 `0 N`，且 `N` 只包含本次真正新增的提交，可以直接创建或更新 PR。
458: 如果左值不为 `0`、出现 merge commit 或 N 包含重复提交，必须先整理历史，不能直接推送。
459: 
460: ## 10. 最终原则
461: 
462: - 比赛仓是参赛代码的唯一提交仓库。
463: - Git 管理比赛仓源码和 manifest；manifest 管理工作区映射。
464: - 软链接或 linkfile 只是构建入口，不是另一份源码。
465: - 每次提交前检查 `git diff --cached --name-only`。
466: - 每个阶段完成后检查 `repo status`。
467: - 公共仓库需要修改时，单独管理、单独提交、单独发 PR。
468: - 统一使用 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支开发，不使用 feature 分支。
469: - 每次开发前必须 `git fetch openvela` 并 `git rebase openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026`，确保基于上游最新提交开发。
470: - 禁止使用 `git merge` 同步上游，只能使用 `git rebase`，避免产生 merge commit 导致 `Rebase and merge` 失败。
471: - 不要在 fork 中保留与上游内容重复的提交；rebase 时遇到重复提交应使用 `git rebase --skip` 跳过。
472: - 推送前必须验证 `git rev-list --left-right --count openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026...HEAD` 输出为 `0 N`，确保不落后上游。
473: - 每次推送前必须 `git fetch --all --prune`，记录 fork 旧 commit，并使用带明确 lease 的 `git push --force-with-lease`。
474: - 推送后必须验证 `git rev-list --left-right --count fork/dev-ai-contest-2026...HEAD` 输出为 `0 0`。
475: - GitHub 提示 `Discard 1 commit` 时，先判断是否为重复提交，禁止直接点击网页 `Discard` 或创建 feature 分支绕过。

1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP移植
2: 
3: 本项目将OpenVela/NuttX移植到BK7258 AP核，并保留博通原厂CP固件、Bootloader、分区和最终打包流程。当前已实现AP核启动，以及AP日志通过Mailbox转发到CP UART0输出。
4: 
5: ## 简单使用说明
6: 
7: 本项目需要配合博通`bk_avdk_smp` SMP工程使用：
8: 
9: ```text
10: 工作区/
11: ├── contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12: └── bk_avdk_smp/
13: ```
14: 
15: 构建前，需要将比赛仓`external/bk_avdk_smp/`中的权威覆盖文件同步到
16: `bk_avdk_smp`。完整文件清单、可直接执行的同步脚本、逐字节校验、OpenVela AP
17: 构建、CP构建和最终固件打包步骤见`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。Git协作和
18: 提交规则见`github开发指南.md`。
19: 
20: ## UART0控制台使用
21: 
22: 连接开发板UART0：
23: 
24: ```bash
25: picocom --no-escape -b 115200 --flow n --parity n --databits 8 /dev/ttyUSB0
26: ```
27: 
28: CP启动后可先查看AP链路状态，再进入AP的OpenVela NSH控制台：
29: 
30: ```text
31: ap_console status
32: ap_console open
33: ```
34: 
35: 进入AP控制台后可以直接执行NSH命令，例如：
36: 
37: ```text
38: help
39: uname -a
40: ps
41: free
42: ctrlc_test
43: ```
44: 
45: `ctrlc_test`会持续等待TTY `SIGINT`。按`Ctrl-C`后应打印
46: `ctrlc_test received SIGINT`并返回NSH提示符。
47: 
48: AP控制台支持方向键、Home、End、Delete、Backspace、命令历史，以及
49: `Ctrl-A`、`Ctrl-B`、`Ctrl-D`、`Ctrl-E`、`Ctrl-F`、`Ctrl-H`、`Ctrl-K`、
50: `Ctrl-L`、`Ctrl-N`、`Ctrl-P`和`Ctrl-U`等CLE快捷键。
51: 
52: 退出AP控制台并返回CP命令行时，严格按以下顺序操作：
53: 
54: 1. 按下`Ctrl-]`。
55: 2. 松开按键。
56: 3. 再按`.`。
57: 
58: 返回CP命令行后可再次检查状态：
59: 
60: ```text
61: ap_console status
62: ```
63: 
64: ## 主要目录
65: 
66: ```text
67: board/beken/chips/bk7258/                  BK7258 AP启动、中断、定时器和Mailbox驱动
68: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/       BK7258 AP板级配置、链接脚本和bring-up
69: external/bk_avdk_smp/                      已验证的博通CP覆盖文件
70: logs/                                      AI Coding日志
71: ```
72: 
73: ## 已实现功能
74: 
75: - BK7258物理CPU1/AP启动OpenVela/NuttX。
76: - Cortex-M33启动向量、C运行时、MPU、FPU、IRQ和SysTick基础适配。
77: - Mailbox v2基础传输、logical channel、sequence、ACK、超时和FIFO full恢复。
78: - 原厂兼容HW_CTRL command 1 power-up、command 2两秒heartbeat，以及独立的PWC `0x5/0x11`生命周期握手。
79: - AP日志通过Mailbox UART0转发到CP物理UART0。
80: - GPIO40红灯和GPIO41绿灯由NuttX内核自动LED状态接口接管，用于显示
81:   中断、信号、断言、Panic、空闲和启动状态。
82: - AP、CP和Bootloader通过`bk_avdk_smp`标准打包流程生成`all-app.bin`。
83: - 当前为物理CPU1+CPU2的OpenVela/NuttX SMP，CP保持物理CPU0。

159: ## 3. 正确构建链条
160: 
161: 最终固件链条固定为：
162: 
163: ```text
164: OpenVela nuttx.bin
165:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
166:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
167:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
168:   -> package/all-app.bin
169: 
170: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
171:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
172: ```
173: 
174: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做增量构建：
175: 
176: - `ram_regions.csv`
177: - AP/CP `config`
178: - Kconfig 默认值
179: - 分区生成脚本
180: - SoC 链接脚本
181: 
182: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
183: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
184: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
185: 
186: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 Armino 工作树：
187: 
188: ```bash
189: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
190: ./build.sh \
191:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
192:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
193: 
194: cp \
195:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
196:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
197: ```
198: 
199: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
200: 
201: ```bash
202: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
203: make -C projects/app_ab clean
204: 
205: podman run --rm \
206:   --userns=keep-id \
207:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
208:   -w /armino \
209:   -e EXTRA_CFLAGS=-Werror \
210:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
211:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
212:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
213:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin

217: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。

235: 频率项和显式关闭 SARADC mailbox），完整生成配置只存在于 build 目录，不回写比赛仓。

285: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
286: 
287: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
288: 
289: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
290: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
291: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
292: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
293: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
294: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
295: 
296: 本覆盖中的CP `0x7`协议要求request `param3=PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1`；response `param1`回显
297: ON/OFF state、`param2`返回真实PSRAM driver结果、`param3`回显version。CP BOOT与
298: OpenVela使用独立owner，初始化失败不置owner bit。`0xc`已提供frequency/divider、
299: speed、voltage、CPU power/reset和PSRAM owner只读诊断；device ID和actual capacity
300: 仍未暴露，因此alias probe和整颗器件实板测试仍是容量门禁。AP board必须同步发送
301: V1 version并检查真实ret/version后才能联调；本CP侧任务未修改AP board代码。
302:

1: # Wi-Fi 使用说明
2: 
3: 当前固件使用手工配网。进入 AP 的 NSH 后执行：
4: 
5: ```sh
6: ifup wlan0
7: wapi psk wlan0 <密码> 3
8: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
9: renew wlan0
10: ping -c 4 8.8.8.8
11: ```
12: 
13: `renew wlan0` 用于通过 DHCP 获取热点分配的 IP、掩码和默认网关，不能省略。
14: 
15: 检查连接状态：
16: 
17: ```sh
18: ifconfig wlan0
19: ```
20: 
21: 接口显示 `RUNNING` 且 `ping` 收到回复，表示 Wi-Fi 连接和公网访问正常。
22: 
23: 不要把真实 Wi-Fi 密码提交到仓库或测试日志中。
